jobs.title: Brand Manager (B2B)
jobs.description:
Brand Manager (B2B)

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Role overview 🌟

Alan has passed 1M members, works with 40K+ companies and operates in seven countries. New products and a flagship international event are coming, and the Brand team is investing in bigger campaigns. So far brand spend has gone mostly to broad awareness. We now need targeted B2B campaigns for specific verticals (for example TNS, retirees, very small company owners), run alongside the broad campaigns to reinforce them.

You'll own these vertical B2B brand campaigns for France, plus a portfolio of other brand projects. You'll work closely with the Brand Lead, Product Marketing, Growth, segment owners and Sales. This is an individual-contributor role at C1-D level.

What you'll do

  • Vertical campaigns: Define the audience, message, proof points and channels for each priority vertical. Choose priorities and objectives with segment owners, Growth and Product Marketing. Run each campaign from brief to post-mortem, and build reusable toolkits (messaging, assets, case studies) for other teams.

  • Product and offer launches: Support the launch of new product features (e.g. Mo, Alan Précision) and new offers (e.g. Alan retirees) in France. Work in strong collaboration with the Product teams to build a creative, impactful go-to-market that stands out in the market. Turn product positioning into launch plans and assets.

  • Partnerships and events: Run vertical-specific events, sponsorships, ambassador and creator partnerships that build credibility with each audience.

  • Local markets: Give feedback on local briefs and plans. Spot French initiatives that could scale to other markets and capture them in playbooks.

  • Measurement: Set KPIs for every project (reach in the target, qualified leads, pipeline influenced, brand perception). Run test-and-learn with Growth and Data. Manage budgets, vendors and deadlines.

You're a good fit if you

  • Have 7+ years of in-house brand marketing (B2C, B2B or B2B2C). Paid media or media planning is a big plus.

  • Have led at least two B2B campaigns or brand projects end to end, and can walk us through the problem, your choices and the measurable result.

  • Have managed agencies and budgets and made trade-offs when resources were tight.

  • Are a generalist across campaigns, content, partnerships, events and PR, with sharp creative judgment you can defend with senior stakeholders.

  • Set brand KPIs and link brand work to pipeline or lead quality.

  • Work well with Sales and Growth and can influence without authority.

  • Written and verbal communication fluency in English and French

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range.

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

You want to know more about Alan?

  • 🙌 Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • 🤘 A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

Freelance Question Reviewers

About AMBOSS

We are a medical education and clinical support platform dedicated to empowering healthcare professionals worldwide to deliver the best possible care.

Founded in Germany, AMBOSS has grown to over 600 team members, with offices in Berlin, Cologne, New York, and Cagliari. Since entering the U.S. medical education market in 2017 with resources for USMLE and shelf exam preparation, AMBOSS has expanded to include point-of-care clinical support and board preparation across multiple specialties. We are now developing a new Qbank for the ABOG Qualifying Examination and are looking for OB-GYN residents and recent residency graduates to help shape this resource.

Position Summary

We are seeking PGY-4 OB-GYN residents or recent graduates for a remote, part-time freelance role developing a new ABOG Qualifying Examination Qbank. You will use your clinical training and board preparation experience to help identify high-yield topics, define what makes a high-quality board-style question, and review questions for exam relevance, difficulty, and educational value. You may also have opportunities to share your insights with multidisciplinary teams (e.g., Commercial, Marketing, AI, Product, and User Research) to help improve medical education and support the responsible use of AI. This role offers a flexible opportunity to explore meaningful nonclinical work alongside your clinical training or practice.

Responsibilities Include

  • Identifying high-yield ABOG exam topics and gaps in Qbank question coverage

  • Helping define what makes a high-quality board-style question

  • Reviewing questions to assess how well they match the ABOG exam in format, content, and difficulty

  • Evaluating whether questions and explanations are clear, concise, and useful for board preparation

  • Suggesting specific changes to improve questions and their educational value

  • Sharing insights from OB-GYN residency training and board preparation with other teams

Qualifications

  • Medical degree (MD/DO).

  • Current PGY-4 resident or recent graduate of an ACGME-accredited OB-GYN residency program in the U.S.

  • Familiarity with the ABOG Qualifying Examination and OB-GYN board preparation resources

  • Strong clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and written communication skills

  • Ability to provide clear, practical feedback focused on educational value

  • Comfortable working independently and meeting agreed-upon deadlines in an asynchronous remote environment

  • Preferred (not required): Experience with AI and/or LLM applications

Logistics

  • Position type: Freelance, independent contractor (project-based)

  • Location: Fully remote

  • Duration: 3 months (~5â10 hours/week, as needed)

  • Schedule: Flexible and project-based, with agreed-upon turnaround times

  • Compensation: $75-$100/hr for current residents; $100-120/hr for recent graduates and attendings

  • Start date: As soon as possible

Why join us?

  • Use your medical training and board preparation experience to help shape the future of residency education and board preparation.

  • Contribute to the quality and responsible use of AI-powered medical education.

  • Explore meaningful nonclinical work that complements your clinical training or practice, with flexible, fully remote part-time hours.

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. Thatâs why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyoneâregardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identityâis valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care!

jobs.description:
Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) m/f/x

Location: Germany/Berlin/Stuttgart 

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Site Reliability Engineers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will need to reside in Germany with legal working permits or residence permits.  

 

The role:  

 

  • Infrastructure Management: Maintain and manage new and existing infrastructure, balancing both proactive and reactive maintenance. 

  • Technical Problem Identification and Resolution: Identify technical problems and bottlenecks. Collaborate with the engineering team to resolve these issues efficiently. 

  • ISO Compliance: Ensure all infrastructure and processes are in compliance with ISO standards, and assist in maintaining those certifications. 

  • Production Support: Work closely with engineering teams to ensure our developed tools and applications run smoothly in a production environment. 

  • Backup Management: Oversee and manage all system backups, ensuring Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) are met. 

  • Release Management Support: Assist in managing software releases to minimize disruption and maximize uptime. 

  • Off-Duty Support: Participate in an off-duty or pager duty rotation to provide round-the-clock system reliability and support. 

  • Incident Review and Analysis: Lead postmortems following any system disruptions, and help identify ways to prevent future incidents. 

  • Infrastructure Monitoring: Monitor system alerts and respond quickly to maintain system health and maximize uptime. 

  • Capacity Planning: Participate in planning server capacity, ensuring we can meet current and future demands 


  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or a related field. 

  • 7+ years of experience in site reliability engineering or a similar role.

  • 3+ years in SRE, DevOps, or related infrastructure roles  

  • Experience supporting/coaching less experienced team members. 

  • Ability in building alerting and observability into all production systems (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch etc.)

  • Proven experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS (ECS, EC2, etc) or Azure. 

  • Extensive experience using Terraform and Ansible. 

  • Incident management, postmortems, and on-call quality of life experience

  • Familiarity with disaster recovery planning and testing. 

  • Strong knowledge of system monitoring tools. 

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues. 

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills. 

  • Proven experience managing system backups and understanding of RTO and RPO. 

  • Familiarity with release management processes. 

  • Ability to work in an on-call capacity. 

  • Define the Site Reliability Strategy and Execute on it 

  • Experience in managing Stakeholders and expectations from Stakeholders 

  • Experience in dealing with concurring priorities / context switching 

  • Proficiency in Python.

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in Germany, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

 

 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion

 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

jobs.title: IT Department Lead - Remote, Worldwide
jobs.description:
IT Department Lead - Remote, Worldwide

About Nethermind:

Nethermind builds and secures core Ethereum infrastructure. We develop the Nethermind execution client, contribute to network upgrades, and deliver protocol-level work across rollups, zero-knowledge systems, and cross-chain architecture. Our security team audits smart contracts, ZK circuits, and off-chain components, with formal verification capabilities for critical systems.

We maintain deep expertise across the full stack—from client optimization to open-source tooling—backed by continuous contributions to Ethereum's evolution. As blockchain intersects with AI, we're developing hardware that anchors digital identity in verifiable biometrics with cryptographic privacy guarantees

The Role:

We're looking for a seasoned IT leader to take ownership of Nethermind's entire Internal IT Department: spanning Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Security, IAM, and FinOps.

This role owns the internal/corporate technology estate that the whole company runs on: developer platform, identity, security posture, and infrastructure spend. It sits alongside (and is distinct from) our client-facing blockchain infrastructure operations, though you'll partner closely with those teams.

You'll report directly to the CIO and serve as the central point of coordination for everything internal infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll manage people, drive strategy, break down silos between DevOps and the wider organisation, and be the go-to person for C-level and group leads on infrastructure matters. If you thrive at the intersection of people management, technical excellence, and cross-functional communication and you're excited about shaping how a 50+ country, fully remote Web3 company operates - we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and supervise the full Internal IT Department: Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Security, IAM and FinOps.

  • Drive company-wide and team-level infrastructure initiatives, co-defining strategy and roadmap with the CIO and rest of the team

  • People management across the department: staffing, career guidance, performance reviews, and raising the technical bar

  • Maintain clear, consistent communication with C-level executives and group leads to strengthen cross-functional relationships and eliminate DevOps silos

  • Act as the primary point of contact for all internal IT matters, staying in constant sync with the CIO on new initiatives and resource allocation

  • Adapt the best of AI technology to the daily engineering and non-engineering working routine

  • Communicate with external clients when required, representing the department's capabilities and aligning on infrastructure needs

  • Continuously identify and implement improvements and optimisations in the way the organisation works

  • Support hiring efforts: sourcing, interviewing, and evaluating candidates to grow the team with top talent

  • Conduct monthly performance reviews using Rippling, providing structured feedback

Must Haves:

  • Proven experience leading and scaling IT / infrastructure / platform engineering teams (5+ years in a management role).

  • Strong background in cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and DevOps/SRE practices.

  • Strategic thinking with the ability to co-define and execute on technical roadmaps.

  • Hands-on understanding of infrastructure security, IAM, and FinOps disciplines.

  • Experience translating compliance and audit requirements (e.g. SOC2, ISO 27001, or sector-specific frameworks) into operational controls.

  • Comfort owning or governing internal AI tooling and agentic workflows, with a security-first mindset.

  • Excellent people management skills: hiring, mentoring, career development, and performance management.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly to C-level stakeholders and non-technical audiences.

  • Practical experience with security incident response and threat modelling, ideally including supply-chain and adversarial/state-actor scenarios.

  • Comfortable operating in a fully remote, async-first, globally distributed environment.

  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, able to juggle multiple initiatives and stakeholders simultaneously.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience in the blockchain / Web3 / crypto ecosystem.

  • Familiarity with multi-cloud and hybrid architectures (AWS, OVH) at scale.

  • Experience running ****self-hosted / sovereign infrastructure (e.g. self-hosted identity providers, internal platforms) over off-the-shelf SaaS.

  • Background in productising internal platforms (PaaS / IaaS offerings) or spinning internal tools into standalone products.

  • Hands-on experience with FinOps tooling and large-scale cost optimisation.

  • Track record building or governing AI/ML and agent infrastructure.

What We Offer/ Benefits

  • Flexible Work Options: Remote-first culture with the opportunity to work from anywhere.

  • Global and Diverse Workforce: You'll work with people from various backgrounds and cultures.

  • Learning and Development: You'll work on innovative, challenging projects and have access to experts and mentors to enhance your skills.

  • Career Growth: Access to training, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to open-source initiatives.

  • Global Events and Conferences: Opportunities to attend the industry events.

  • Collaborative and Innovative Culture: We foster teamwork and encourage new ideas.

  • Unlimited Time Off: Enjoy the freedom to structure your working hours in a way that suits you best, with the flexibility to take unpaid time off whenever needed to maintain a healthy work-life balance.

  • Equity participation allowing you to benefit directly from the company's success.

Our Commitment to Diversity

At Nethermind, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We believe a variety of perspectives drives innovation and leads to better solutions for the blockchain community.

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about blockchain and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you. Click Apply Now to start your journey with Nethermind.

Important Notice for Candidates

Recruitment scams are becoming increasingly common. Please keep the following guidelines in mind when applying for roles at Nethermind.

Where We May Contact You

Our Recruitment Team will only contact candidates using official company email addresses ending in @nethermind.io.
Any communication from our Team will always come from an official company domain — never from Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail, Outlook, or any other free email service.
You can also find us only through our official Nethermind accounts on:

  • LinkedIn

  • X / Twitter

  • GitHub

Please note that we do not use Facebook for recruitment outreach.

How We Conduct Interviews

All interview scheduling and recruitment communication is managed exclusively through Ashby, our official hiring platform.
You may receive scheduling emails sent via Ashby on behalf of our Recruitment Team. Before clicking any links, please make sure the message originates from a legitimate and trusted Ashby source.

We do not conduct interviews through:

  • WhatsApp

  • Telegram

  • Wire

  • Google Hangouts

  • Signal

  • Discord DMs

  • or any other unofficial messaging platforms

What We Will Never Do

Nethermind will never:

  • Ask for your banking details, passwords, seed phrases, and wallet credentials at any stage of the hiring process

  • Request payments, deposits, or fees related to recruitment or interviews

  • Contact you through unofficial email addresses or suspicious messaging accounts

  • Ask you to install unknown software or share access to your devices

If you ever receive suspicious communication claiming to represent Nethermind, please treat it with caution and verify the source carefully before responding.

Software Engineer AI Tooling

About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

Weâre looking for a Software Engineer to join our AI Tooling team and help shape how developers and agents build with Supabase. You'll build and own our AI tooling, including agents, the MCP server, agent skills and the dashboard assistant, and as the space moves you'll build the tooling for new technologies too. You'll build it all eval-first: every tool ships with evals and metrics, so we know, with evidence, that it makes agents better rather than worse.

You'll work closely with the Docs, CLI, Frontend and SDK teams, and with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers who run these services in production. Other teams contribute to AI Tooling to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities, and you'll help them do that while keeping the quality bar high.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What Youâll Be Responsible For

  • Build and improve the AI tooling we run today, including the MCP server, agent skills, agents and the Assistant.

  • Make new Supabase products usable by agents from day one: tools, skills and evals for new product surfaces. Also build tooling for new AI technologies as they emerge: prototype quickly, evaluate honestly, and decide with the team what is worth taking to production.

  • Drive an eval-first approach: build and improve evals, instrumentation and feedback loops, measure tools against a no-tool baseline, and help define the quality KPIs and gates that stop regressions shipping.

  • Understand how customers and agents actually use what we ship, and turn that into improvements to our tooling, interfaces and documentation.

  • Design how documentation and product knowledge are exposed to agents, and measure whether it works.

  • Build patterns and tools that help customers add AI to their own apps, such as MCP on Edge Functions, vector embeddings and agents running on Edge Functions.

  • Enable teams to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities through contributions to AI Tooling: clear contribution paths, templates, documentation and review practice.

  • Centralise shared AI logic so teams reuse it rather than duplicate it.

  • Ship tools that are battle-tested, with strong tests, benchmarking and stress testing where it counts.

  • Work with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on reliability, auth and hosting.

  • Work across Docs, CLI, Frontend, SDK and other teams to deliver one coherent developer experience, and stay close to the fast-moving AI ecosystem.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

Must have:

  • Have 5+ years of experience in professional software engineering experience.

  • Write strong TypeScript and know the JavaScript ecosystem well: npm, ES modules, bundlers, compatibility.

  • Are deeply familiar with the AI ecosystem: current tools, agent patterns and practical trade-offs. You can tell a durable pattern from hype.

  • Have built developer tools, product interfaces or platform primitives used by other engineers.

  • Have designed or used evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability and task success, and understand baselines, variance and cost.

  • Have strong judgement about where AI improves workflows and how to avoid fragile or gimmicky experiences.

  • Write tests and validate reliability in real-world conditions.

  • Know Postgres and relational database practice.

  • Communicate clearly in writing, work across product, engineering and docs, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with vector databases and embeddings, ideally pgvector.

  • Examples of customer-facing AI features or agents you've shipped.

  • Examples of documentation or structured knowledge designed for developers or agents.

  • Experience with Braintrust or a similar eval and tracing platform, or setting up CI quality gates.

  • Open-source contributions or developer tooling you've maintained.

  • Experience across several product surfaces or teams.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what weâre building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environmentâlaptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your familyâs health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. Itâs a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learningâcourses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If itâs in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to supportânot replaceâexisting tools and communities.

You will use AI natively in everything you do. Your work will span a broad range of cybersecurity and technology domains, including:

  • Conducting red teaming exercises and long-term Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) simulations to identify vulnerabilities and test organisational resilience.

Who You Are

  • A hands-on cybersecurity professional with strong technical specialist experience in offensive security, security engineering or red teaming. You enjoy getting into the technical detail, investigating threats and identifying weaknesses rather than focusing solely on governance, risk and compliance.

  • Comfortable navigating code, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments and modern technology architectures.

What You Bring

  • Practical experience conducting or supporting penetration tests, security assessments, adversary simulations, threat investigations or other offensive security activities.

  • Hands on work with AI harnesses and offensive AI models.

Why Prosus?

Director of Finance - Ecosystem

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Opportunity

The Strategic Finance, Planning & Analysis team drives financial performance management across Prosus's global ecosystems - partnering with operating companies and Group Finance to ensure targets are met and capital is deployed effectively. The EU ecosystem team sits at the centre of Prosus's ambition to build a leading lifestyle e-commerce platform in Europe, and this Director role is the financial engine behind that ambition.

You'll own the full Strategic FP&A function for Prosus's European portfolio, managing the annual budgeting, planning, and forecasting cycle across a multi-entity, multi-country ecosystem, and leading the operating cadences that keep business unit CFOs, ecosystem leads, and Group Finance aligned. Within your first 60 days, you'll have established a working rhythm with every BU and minority investment finance team in the region. Within your first quarter, you'll hold full ownership of the EU ecosystem budgeting and forecasting cycle.

This is an active moment for the portfolio. M&A and divestiture activity is ongoing, and you'll be a direct contributor to at least one strategic transaction within your first year, not as a reviewer, but as a hands-on partner to the ecosystem leads driving those decisions. The team you'll lead is five to six direct reports; developing their capabilities and raising the bar on finance practice across the BU finance teams is as much a part of the role as the numbers themselves.

This isn't a reporting function. This is financial leadership for one of Prosus's most strategically significant regions.

Who You Are

You think in systems and act with precision. You're comfortable holding the full picture of a complex, multi-entity portfolio while also rolling up your sleeves on the analysis that makes a business case credible or a forecast defensible. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down - you move forward with the information available, surface the brutal facts clearly, and adjust as the picture sharpens.

You've built trust with senior stakeholders before - CFOs, business leads, Group Finance counterparts, not just by managing up but by being the person in the room who brings clarity. You give direct, evidence-based points of view and create space for the people around you to do the same. You care about the growth of your team as much as the quality of the output, and you understand that both are how a finance function earns its seat at the table.

What You Bring

- Deep experience in finance or FP&A at group or multi-entity level, with a background in digital economy, e-commerce, consumer internet, or a closely adjacent sector

- Experience managing and developing a finance team, with a genuine investment in building capability at every level

- Fluent English communication, written and spoken, with the ability to translate financial complexity into clear, concise narratives for diverse audiences

- Familiarity with Group Finance functions (tax, treasury, reporting, consolidation) and how a finance function at this level interfaces with each

- Background in minority investment oversight or portfolio company finance is a plus

- Exposure to multi-country or cross-border finance environments in Europe is a plus

Your day might begin with a performance review call with a business unit CFO - working through the latest actuals, flagging variances, and agreeing on the narrative before it reaches Group Finance. From there, you're likely in the detail: a forecast model that needs stress-testing, a business case for a potential acquisition, or a consolidation question that cuts across tax, treasury, and reporting.

jobs.description:
IT Administrator - (Senior) IT Administrator

Apex.AI is an international software company developing safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility and autonomous systems. Our technology enables companies to build software-defined vehicles and intelligent machines faster, safer, and more efficiently. 

We are looking for a hands-on IT Administrator / (Senior) IT Administrator to take ownership of the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of our IT environment in Germany while supporting our international teams. 

This is a highly practical role for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, administering systems, supporting users, and continuously improving IT infrastructure. You will work across Linux and macOS endpoints, identity and access management, cloud services, networks, security tooling, and on-premises infrastructure. 

You will be a key point of contact for IT topics in our Munich office and work closely with Engineering, DevOps, HR, and other business functions. 

In addition to your core IT responsibilities, you will have the opportunity to develop your knowledge of Information Security and compliance, including ISO 27001 and TISAX. Previous compliance experience is welcome but not required—we are looking for someone who is interested in learning and growing in this area. 

As Apex.AI grows, this role offers the opportunity to take on broader ownership and help shape the future of our IT function. 

 
This role is located in our Munich office. Authorization to work in Germany is required.

What You’ll Do

Hands-on IT Administration 

  • Own and manage the day-to-day operation of our cloud and on-premises IT environment.  

  • Administer and support Linux and macOS endpoints throughout their lifecycle.  

  • Manage MDM, IAM, user accounts, permissions, SSO, and MFA.  

  • Administer cloud-based email, collaboration, and file-storage services.  

  • Manage employee access across internal systems and business applications.  

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot wired and wireless networks.  

  • Manage VPN solutions, network segmentation, policies, and access rules.  

  • Administer and maintain on-premises and cloud-based servers.  

  • Manage endpoint security solutions, including EDR/antivirus, patching, encryption, and security policies.  

  • Implement and maintain integrations between different IT systems.  

  • Automate repetitive IT administration tasks wherever possible.  

  • Monitor systems and proactively identify and resolve issues before they impact users.  

    • IT Support & Service Delivery 

  • Be a primary point of contact for IT support for employees in our Munich office and provide remote support to colleagues in other locations.  

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, endpoint, network, account, and access issues.  

  • Manage IT support requests and ensure issues are resolved efficiently.  

  • Set up laptops, accounts, permissions, and required applications for new employees.  

  • Execute IT onboarding and offboarding for employees and contractors.  

  • Manage IT hardware inventory and device lifecycle.  

  • Maintain clear and useful technical documentation.  

  • Help create a reliable and user-friendly IT environment where employees can work effectively with minimal friction.  

    • IT Security & Compliance 

    You will have the opportunity to learn how to manage ISMS based on ISO 27001 and TISAX frameworks. We are looking for someone eager to develop in this area. 

    You will: 

  • Support the implementation and maintenance of technical security controls.  

  • Help maintain IT documentation, policies, procedures, asset inventories, and access records.  

  • Support evidence collection and technical preparation for ISO 27001 and TISAX audits.  

  • Work with internal and external stakeholders on Information Security topics.  

  • Support vulnerability management, patching, backups, disaster recovery, and security incident readiness.  

  • Help investigate and resolve IT security incidents.  

  • Gradually develop your knowledge of our ISMS and security/compliance requirements.  

  • Contribute ideas for improving the security and resilience of our IT environment.  

    • Collaboration & Continuous Improvement 

  • Work closely with Engineering and DevOps on infrastructure, access, networking, and security topics.  

  • Support business applications used by HR, Sales, Finance, Legal, and other teams.  

  • Work with IT vendors and service providers when required.  

  • Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to our IT environment.  

  • Support the secure adoption of AI tools and emerging technologies.  

  • Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and simplification.  


    • What you bring

  • Several years of hands-on experience as an IT Administrator, System Administrator, IT Engineer, or similar role.  

  • Strong hands-on experience administering Linux and/or macOS environments, with a willingness to become proficient across both.  

  • Experience with endpoint and device management, including MDM, centralized patching, encryption, and security policies.  

  • Experience with IAM, SSO, and MFA.  

  • Experience administering cloud-based productivity and collaboration platforms such as Google Workspace or Microsoft 365.  

  • Solid networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, Wi-Fi, VPNs, VLANs, and firewalls.  

  • Experience administering servers and working with on-premises infrastructure.  

  • Understanding of endpoint security, backups, monitoring, and logging.  

  • Basic scripting or automation skills using Bash, PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies.  

  • A practical troubleshooting mindset and willingness to investigate problems independently.  

  • Comfortable supporting users directly—from simple endpoint issues to more complex infrastructure problems.  

  • Ability to document technical processes clearly.  

  • Fluent English; German language skills are a must (C1 level).  


    • For the Senior IT Administrator level

    Candidates considered for the Senior IT Administrator level should additionally bring:

  • 5+ years of relevant hands-on IT administration or systems engineering experience, ideally in a technical or engineering-driven environment.
  • Strong hands-on expertise across Linux and macOS, with the ability to independently troubleshoot complex endpoint and system issues.
  • Proven experience taking ownership of MDM, IAM, SSO/MFA, endpoint security, networking, and access management.
  • Strong networking knowledge with practical experience configuring and troubleshooting VPNs, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing, Wi-Fi, and firewalls.
  • Experience independently owning technical projects from solution design and implementation through documentation and ongoing operation.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across endpoints, networks, cloud services, identity, and infrastructure, with the ability to resolve complex issues without relying primarily on external providers.
  • Experience using scripting and automation to improve IT operations and reduce repetitive manual work.
  • Ability to proactively identify weaknesses in an existing IT environment and independently propose and implement secure, scalable improvements.
  • Experience acting as a technical escalation point and supporting or mentoring less experienced colleagues.
  • Ability to work confidently with Engineering and DevOps teams and communicate effectively with highly technical stakeholders.
  • A strong security mindset and interest in taking increasing ownership of Information Security, ISO 27001, TISAX, and ISMS-related topics.

    • Previous hands-on experience supporting ISO 27001, TISAX, an ISMS, or security audits is an advantage for the Senior level, but not required.

    Most importantly, you: 

  • Enjoy being hands-on and solving technical problems yourself.  

  • Take ownership instead of simply escalating issues to someone else.  

  • Are comfortable working independently while knowing when to ask for help.  

  • Enjoy working with highly technical software engineers and learning from subject-matter experts.  

  • Are curious about new technologies and continuously develop your skills.  

  • Want to broaden your experience beyond traditional IT administration into Information Security, ISO 27001, and TISAX.  

    •  


    Nice to have

  • Experience with JumpCloud or similar MDM/IAM platforms.  

  • Experience with Google Workspace administration.  

  • Experience with AWS services such as EC2, EBS, IAM, or RDS.  

  • Experience with EDR, vulnerability management, monitoring, or logging solutions.  

  • Experience supporting developer or engineering environments.  

  • Familiarity with CI/CD infrastructure and version-control systems.  

  • Previous exposure to ISO 27001, TISAX, ISMS, or security audits.  

  • IT or security certifications such as CompTIA, ITIL, CCNA, or similar.  

  • Interest or experience in AI/LLM technologies and their secure use within an enterprise environment.  


    • Why Apex.AI

  • Take real ownership of a modern IT environment rather than simply managing external providers.  

  • Work closely with world-class software engineers developing cutting-edge platforms for autonomous and software-defined systems.  

  • Gain hands-on exposure to an engineering-focused environment spanning Linux, macOS, cloud, networking, security, and developer infrastructure.  

  • Grow your Information Security expertise through practical exposure to ISO 27001, TISAX, security controls, audits, and ISMS processes.  

  • Have a direct impact on how our IT environment evolves as the company grows.  

  • Work in an international, engineering-driven culture where technical curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning are valued.  

  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for professional and career development.  

    • About Apex.AI

    Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

    The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

    • Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.
    • Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

    Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

    • Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.
    • Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.

    Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.

Fullstack Software Engineer (m/f/d)

YOUR JOB

AI can write code now. It can't decide what's worth building, and it can't tell whether its own output is right. That part is yours. As a Fullstack Software Engineer in our customer-facing feature team, you'll take on real problems, often co-leading an initiative with a fellow engineer. You'll carry them from the first discovery conversation to production and beyond, working with Product, Design and engineers who would rather own an outcome than close a ticket. What you build lands with many companies working to keep their data, and the people behind it, safe.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Own what you build, end to end. Shape capabilities in discovery with your Product Owner and Designer, build them across frontend and backend, ship them to production, and make sure they work properly in customers' hands.

  • Help decide what gets built, not just how. Challenge assumptions, suggest alternatives, and help define requirements before anyone writes code.

  • Engineer with AI, responsibly. Use agentic workflows and AI tooling every day while you stay accountable for architecture, security and quality. You'll also help shape how our team builds with AI.

  • Build the new and improve the existing. Your time splits roughly evenly between new product capabilities and modernising an established codebase. Every area you touch should be better when you leave it.

  • Work beyond your team's walls. Spot dependencies with our other teams early, raise risks before they block delivery, and keep stakeholders informed.

  • Deliver as a team. Join four talented engineers who share ownership. You'll work in four-month terms with two-week sprints, keep rituals lean, and adjust scope when reality changes.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

  • The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world

  • Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs

  • Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market

  • Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget

  • Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

  • You think in problems, solutions and how to implement them properly to deliver value to customers, not tickets that should to be done.

  • You're a builder across the stack. You've shipped features on both frontend and backend. Applied AI Engineer, Startups (Codex)

About the team

The Applied AI Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior.

This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex for startups, you will help developers and founders transform how they build and ship software. You’ll combine hands-on engineering, startup experience, and compelling technical communication to help teams turn the potential of AI coding tools into practical, effective workflows.

Presentations and community engagement are central to this role. You will engage developers and founders through technical talks, live demos, workshops, and programmes across the startup ecosystem, alongside targeted work with individual customers. You’ll build reusable tools and resources that extend your impact, and bring insights from developers back to OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys both hands-on building and sharing what they learn with others. You should be as excited to lead a room of developers, deliver an engaging presentation, and build relationships across the startup community as you are to explore a technical problem in code—with a focus on sustained adoption and meaningful improvements in how startups work.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with top startups to identify where Codex can have the greatest impact on how their teams build and ship software.

  • Design and lead technical talks, live demos, workshops, hackathons, and repeatable hands-on programmes that turn initial interest into sustained adoption.

  • Work directly with selected customers to build Codex workflows, integrations, and automations, resolve technical blockers, and evaluate effectiveness and reliability.

  • Turn successful approaches into reusable code examples, guides, and tools that help more startups succeed with Codex and OpenAI’s broader platform.

  • Collaborate with account teams, developer experience, and ecosystem partners to reach developers and founders, prioritise opportunities, and drive measurable customer value.

  • Translate customer experiences and developer feedback into actionable insights for OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have experience building at, founding, or working closely with early-stage startups, and understand the pace, ambiguity, and practical trade-offs involved.

  • Bring strong software engineering fundamentals and enjoy building practical AI applications, integrations, and developer tools.

  • Are an active user of Codex or other AI coding tools, with a thoughtful perspective on how they can improve software development.

  • Are a compelling communicator who enjoys presenting, delivering live demos, and leading hands-on workshops for developers and founders.

  • Have a talent for turning complex technical ideas into clear explanations, engaging examples, and reusable resources that help others succeed.

  • Combine developer empathy with sound technical judgment: you can uncover what a team needs, troubleshoot problems, and help them adopt effective, reliable workflows.

  • Bring high agency, curiosity, and end-to-end ownership, working independently while collaborating closely with colleagues and ecosystem partners.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Products & Agentic Hospitality (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager, AI Products & Agentic Hospitality (f/m/d)

About the role 

 

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, and the first AI agent marketplace for hospitality in our Agent Hub, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. 

We're looking for a senior Product Manager to ownin our AI product domain. You'll turn our AI capabilities into coherent, commercially viable products that solve real operational problems for hoteliers. Your goal is to help hotels move towards genuinely autonomous operations, not to ship isolated automations or AI assistants. 

This is not a backlog role. You'll take an ambiguous opportunity, find the right customer problems, define the proposition, build it with Engineering, bring it to market and drive adoption. You'll also play a central role in turning our AI capabilities into a meaningful and growing source of revenue. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it along our vision, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning. You'll work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and in close collaboration with our other value stream teams.  

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Productising and commercialising our AI capabilities. Define the proposition, target customers and use cases, and shape packaging and launch with commercial teams. 
  • Building the foundations for AI across our ecosystem. Shape how our AI capabilities understand each hotel's context and work reliably with Apaleo and connected systems across operational areas. 
  • Productising hospitality knowledge. Turn hospitality expertise and operational processes into scalable product experiences, with appropriate human oversight. 
  • Driving autonomy and measurable value. Think in complete outcomes, such as staff hours saved and manual work removed. Show hoteliers tangible ROI. 
  • Driving adoption. Run discovery, shape onboarding and usability, measure adoption and improve from real-world feedback. 
  • Keeping AI products reliable and viable. Define good agent performance, understand cost and latency, set up evaluation and monitoring with Engineering, and trade off autonomy, reliability, human intervention and cost. 
  • Owning strategy, roadmap and delivery in your scope, with clear specs, a definition of done and impact analysis. 
  • Working with Engineering on trade-offs, dependencies, quality and our API-first AI-first architecture. 
  • Balancing ambition with reality. Weigh the roadmap against operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and say no to good ideas that aren't great ones. 
  • Spotting dependencies early with Hotel Operations and other engineering teams, since our AI capabilities build on the core platform. 
  • Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering.  

 

What you'll bring 

  • 6+ years as a Product Manager, owning products from discovery through launch and adoption with limited day-to-day direction. 
  • Proven zero-to-one experience. You've taken a new B2B product, not a feature, from an ambiguous problem to paying customers, driving discovery, validation, definition, prioritisation and launch. 
  • Ownership after launch. You've owned a revenue, adoption or retention number and can tell us what moved and what you killed, pivoted or repriced. 
  • Commercial thinking. You've defined propositions, packaging and pricing, validated willingness to pay and worked with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market. 
  • Systems and process thinking. You break processes into steps, decisions and handoffs, and understand how systems with different data models and sources of truth affect the reliability of agents. 
  • Meaningful AI product experience. You've built and launched AI-powered products or capabilities used by real customers, understand what makes a product agentic, and can discuss context, tools, latency, cost and evaluation, with a view on human-in-the-loop design. 
  • Customer centricity and product judgement. You turn interview patterns into opportunities, make tough trade-offs and prioritise ruthlessly. 
  • Platform thinking. You weigh customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency and long-term platform evolution. 
  • Stakeholder alignment. You align Engineering, commercial teams and peers, manage cross-team dependencies and communicate trade-offs with confidence. 
  • Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, raise risks early and make progress through ambiguity. 

 

Strongly preferred 

  • Agentic AI products in production. You've taken an agentic AI product beyond prototype to paying customers, and dealt with reliability, permissions, exceptions, human intervention and evaluation. This is different from AI-powered features such as chatbots, summarisation or copilots. 

 

Nice to have 

  • Hospitality technology or hotel operations experience. 
  • Experience with PMS, RMS, CRS, channel managers, OTAs or hospitality distribution. 
  • Experience in B2B SaaS platforms, ecosystems or integration-heavy products. 
  • Experience with AI governance, permissions, identity, orchestration or enterprise AI adoption. 
  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up. 
  • Comfort with AI-assisted engineering processes. 

 

Don't tick every box? Hospitality experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite. A strong zero-to-one B2B product builder from another domain, with real AI product experience and a commercial mindset, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you. 

 

Who you are 

  • You take high ownership. You answer for product outcomes, not just delivery commitments. 
  • You're strategic and hands-on. You can set a product vision and still get into customer discovery, operational processes and detailed product decisions. 
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You make progress when the problem or the solution isn't fully defined. 
  • You think commercially. You ask what customers will buy and why, not just what Engineering can build. 
  • You're customer obsessed. You understand real operational pain and test your assumptions with customers. 
  • You're technically curious. You know enough about AI and agentic systems to hold meaningful discussions with engineers and make informed product decisions. 
  • You measure what matters. You judge success by customer outcomes, adoption and commercial impact, not features shipped. 

 

What we offer 

Culture and growth 

  • A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech. 
  • Growth and development. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. 
  • Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency. 
  • Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. 

 

Perks and lifestyle 

  • Flexible and remote work options. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup. 
  • Free public transport. Travel across Germany with a fully covered Deutschland Ticket. 
  • Paid time off. 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. 
  • Health and wellbeing. Access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership. 

 

Joining Apaleo 

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo is more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

Software Engineer in Test - 1134

Quantinuum is seeking an experienced Software Engineer in Test to join its Global Quality Assurance team. The role focuses on automated testing across Quantinuum’s quantum computing infrastructure, from cloud services to internal communications within quantum computing systems.

You will design, implement and maintain automated integration and end-to-end test suites for workflows spanning tools developed by different teams. Responsibilities include identifying gaps in coverage, investigating integration failures and developing test plans. Strong software engineering skills are essential; the role involves little manual testing.
As a team, we cover broad automated testing areas, as well as software integration and regression tests we also write automated UI, hardware and hardware/software subsystem tests.  We aim to ensure, whenever possible, that the right person is working on the right task that suits their own personal skills and strengths, so whilst the team’s overall scope is large, having experience in every area is not expected or required.

You will also work with other teams to improve testability and testing practices through technical guidance, practical support and training, and contribute to the development of QA processes for major releases.

Key responsibilities:

1.    Develop thorough test plans and strategies, both independently and collaboratively with relevant stakeholders; especially identifying major risks and suggesting appropriate tests and mitigations.  
2.    Execute test plans: Design, develop and maintain automated integration and end-to-end tests and supporting frameworks and tooling for workflows spanning multiple teams’ front-end, back-end and other components across Quantinuum as described above.
3.    Integrate automated tests into build and deployment pipelines (CI/CD), for example Github Actions or Jenkins.   Work with other teams to ensure these pipelines are effective.
4.    Review requirements and designs for testability, and work with teams to investigate defects and understand their root causes.  Help develop test plans and QA processes for major releases, aligning testing with release schedules and ensuring that coverage, results and remaining risks are documented and supported by auditable evidence.

Must have:

•    Relevant technical education and/or practical experience to reasonably meet the Key Responsibilities listed above.  
•    The ability to understand complex systems quickly, both on a technical level but also understanding the broader product and customer requirements to ensure tests are tailored for the real-world.
•    Strong Python programming skills and experience developing maintainable software as well as a good understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

Applied AI Engineer, Startups (Codex)

About the team

The Applied AI Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior.

This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex for startups, you will help developers and founders transform how they build and ship software. You’ll combine hands-on engineering, startup experience, and compelling technical communication to help teams turn the potential of AI coding tools into practical, effective workflows.

Presentations and community engagement are central to this role. You will engage developers and founders through technical talks, live demos, workshops, and programmes across the startup ecosystem, alongside targeted work with individual customers. You’ll build reusable tools and resources that extend your impact, and bring insights from developers back to OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys both hands-on building and sharing what they learn with others. You should be as excited to lead a room of developers, deliver an engaging presentation, and build relationships across the startup community as you are to explore a technical problem in code—with a focus on sustained adoption and meaningful improvements in how startups work.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with top startups to identify where Codex can have the greatest impact on how their teams build and ship software.

  • Design and lead technical talks, live demos, workshops, hackathons, and repeatable hands-on programmes that turn initial interest into sustained adoption.

  • Work directly with selected customers to build Codex workflows, integrations, and automations, resolve technical blockers, and evaluate effectiveness and reliability.

  • Turn successful approaches into reusable code examples, guides, and tools that help more startups succeed with Codex and OpenAI’s broader platform.

  • Collaborate with account teams, developer experience, and ecosystem partners to reach developers and founders, prioritise opportunities, and drive measurable customer value.

  • Translate customer experiences and developer feedback into actionable insights for OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have experience building at, founding, or working closely with early-stage startups, and understand the pace, ambiguity, and practical trade-offs involved.

  • Bring strong software engineering fundamentals and enjoy building practical AI applications, integrations, and developer tools.

  • Are an active user of Codex or other AI coding tools, with a thoughtful perspective on how they can improve software development.

Key Account Manager

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Key Account Management Team


Our Account Management team’s purpose is to make our key accounts stay and grow with Alan. We created the team in 2020 and we are now 30+.
We are looking for amazing people to help us take care of our growing pipe on Public Sector accounts (Ministries and other public entities).
Being a Key Account Manager at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate experts, with different backgrounds.
We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?


As a Key Account Manager, you will:

  • Handle a portfolio of strategic accounts in the Public Sector

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships with key stakeholders and display a customer-centric approach to identify the main needs and allow our clients to achieve their goals through Alan

  • Proactively identify potential signals of dissatisfaction and implement solutions to answer them

  • Ensure successful onboarding of new accounts and promote Alan health partner positioning to generate massive adoption by employees and admins

  • Analyze and present consumption reports to customers through business reviews

  • Identify and execute out-of-the-box initiatives to engage our existing customers

  • Renegotiate contracts to guarantee both great value for money to our customers and sustainable profitability

  • Participate in the evolution of our products and services, acting as the voice of our customers when discussing with Product teams

You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • You have at least 6 years of experience in a customer-facing role including frequent interactions with C-Levels

  • You have full working proficiency in French (excellent oral and written communication)

  • You have at least advanced level in English

  • You are experienced in dealing with very large organizations and potentially with unions

  • You have the tact and empathy that make great negotiators

  • You are an expert in positive lobbying with key stakeholders and create long-term relationship based on trust and transparency

  • You are very analytical, very comfortable with presenting deep data analysis to clients and solving complex problems

  • You have great active listening skills and are a master in the art of crafting the right follow-up message

  • You have a growth mindset: you are able to adapt to new trends and to develop an in-depth understanding of the health insurance market

  • You are currently based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux or Marseille.


It is nice to have a previous experience in Insurance or any industry linked to benefits. Having experience with or within the Public Sector space is also a nice to have.


For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-E level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Bordeaux or Marseille.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your  time as you  wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly  flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.
