jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
Head of Product

Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

The opportunity

Our engineering teams build a product that enterprises run their purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash processes on every day. Much of the product knowledge behind it sits with our founders and domain experts. As we grow, we are moving from a project-oriented model, where features come top-down and success is measured by output, to a product-oriented one: empowered teams that own problems end-to-end and are measured by their impact on customers and the business.

As Head of Product, you lead that shift. You build the product management practice for the BLP Platform from an early stage. Our first product managers are joining stream-aligned teams, starting with Invoice and Procurement, and the team will grow to 4–5 PMs as we expand. You hire them, coach them, and set the standard for what great product work looks like at BLP.

You report to the CTO and work closely with Engineering, Projects, Sales, and our founders.

What you’ll do

  • Build and lead the product management practice for the BLP Platform: hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers as we scale.

  • Move the product organization from an output-driven model to an outcome-driven one.

  • Establish the product management craft at BLP: discovery practices, evidence-based decision making, and a clear standard for what “good” looks like in the role.

  • Transfer product knowledge out of the experts’ heads and into the teams, without losing the domain depth that got us here.

  • Build the direct line between our teams and our customers.

  • Make our data usable for product decisions. We have BigQuery, PostHog, and prediction-rate analytics available, and we want product managers who reach for them by default.

  • Shape how the product organization works as we grow: intake, prioritization, roadmapping, and the operating rhythm.

  • Contribute directly to product strategy for the platform.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in product management, including experience leading or formally coaching product managers, with a real point of view on how product people are developed.

  • Experience working in an empowered product model, where teams were assigned problems to solve rather than features to build.

  • A track record of shipping enterprise B2B software that customers actually adopted.

  • Experience moving an organization toward an empowered product model, including the political and cultural side of it.

  • The ability to hold a position with engineers, sales, and executives, and to say no in a way that keeps the relationship.

  • Entrepreneurial judgment: comfortable operating with incomplete information, choosing a direction, and owning the result.

  • Fluent English.

  • Enterprise ERP or finance exposure, experience with AI or agentic products in production (particularly reliability, evaluation, and trust in enterprise settings), and German are a plus.

Why BLP

  • Build a function: you shape how product management works at BLP while the team grows.

  • Direct work with the CTO and founders on product strategy for the platform.

  • A product with deep domain substance and a large enterprise customer base to learn from.

  • Employee participation plan.

How we work

  • Impact: We create measurable business outcomes.

  • Transparency: We build trust through openness.

  • Ownership: We take responsibility for outcomes.

  • Excellence: We relentlessly strive for greatness.

Practical information

  • Location: hybrid from our Zurich, London, Munich or Cologne offices, or remote elsewhere in Europe.

  • Employment: full-time, permanent.

Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
 
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?
 
 

We are looking for a dynamic and strategic Regional Account Manager to join our growing team in Germany

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director this is an individual contributor role. The Regional Account Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth and nurturing strategic, long-term partnerships with key automotive clients. This role demands deep industry knowledge, a strong understanding of SaaS solutions, and the ability to tailor offerings to client needs in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

You will sit at the heart of a cross functional “pod” that includes sales, professional services and customer success- acting as the strategic lead and advocate for your clients.


Key Duties & Responsibilities
  • Develop and execute account strategies to maximise client satisfaction and retention.
  • Identify new business opportunities within existing accounts and new prospects in Germany and across DACH.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for key automotive clients, major dealer groups and Account relationships ensuring seamless communication and service delivery.
  • Build strong relationships with key decision makers and confidently drive and communicate how Keyloop drives measurable business impact – aligning global Account strategy with localized priorities.
  • Analyse market trends and client feedback to inform product development and innovation.
  • Manage contract negotiations, renewals, and upselling of additional services.
  • Collaborate closely with sales, product, and technical teams to ensure client needs are met and exceeded.
  • Manage every stage of the sales funnel- prospecting, qualifying and closing solutions that meet customer needs.
  • Develop multi-year strategic account plans aligned with customer priorities and Keyloop goals.
  • Deep understanding of customer operations, dealership operational workflows, dynamics and growth plans.
  • Prepare regular reports on account performance and progress toward targets.
  • Demonstrate strategic thinking ability to increase productivity YoY facilitating double digit business growth & % share of wallet.

    • Skills Knowledge & Experience
  • Fluent in German and Dutch
  • Minimum 8 years’ B2B sales experience in automotive industry 
  • Experience of using AI in Sales to enhance your sales functionality & capability

jobs.title: Chief of Staff – Corporate Affairs (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Chief of Staff – Corporate Affairs (f/m/d)

About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A, the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

We are looking for a Chief of Staff – Corporate Affairs (f/m/d): the first point of contact and the engine room of our Corporate Affairs unit. You will report directly to our Chief Corporate Affairs Officer (CCAO) and run the day-to-day work that keeps a growing, cross-border agenda coherent and moving. This frees the CCAO to focus on relationships and strategy.

You will own ambiguous, cross-functional execution independently. Strategic positioning and external representation remain with the CCAO.

What You'll Do

  • Own the CCAO's agenda and priorities, acting as her first point of contact internally and externally.

  • Drive project management for Corporate Affairs initiatives across Brussels, Berlin, Hesse, and international markets, including tracking dependencies and milestones across locations.

  • Run planning, OKR, and reporting processes for the unit on a reliable cadence.

  • Build decision-ready briefings, talking points, and papers for senior management and the Board, prepared ahead of need.

  • Prepare and follow up on meetings with government bodies, EU institutions, parliament, and industry associations.

  • Partner with the CEO Office, Finance, Investor Relations, Legal, and technical teams on cross-functional initiatives.

  • Manage relationships with external partners such as agencies and advisors.

  • Enable rapid, coordinated responses to short-notice political and stakeholder developments.

What You Bring

  • Proven senior-level experience in chief of staff, executive support, corporate affairs, public affairs, or government relations roles.

  • Solid understanding of political processes at federal, state, and EU level, and of public affairs fundamentals. Interest in energy and technology policy is a plus.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to keep many cross-market threads moving without dropping details.

  • Experience with OKR-based planning, stakeholder mapping, and cross-functional coordination, plus confidence with planning and project management tools.

  • Clear, precise written communication in English and German, with a focus on decisions. You prepare materials that senior leaders and the Board can act on without rework.

  • Ownership and initiative: you anticipate needs, flag issues before they are asked about, and take full accountability for the unit's execution.

  • Sound judgment on operational decisions such as scheduling, sequencing, and partner management, with the ability to work without close supervision.

  • Discretion and confidentiality in handling sensitive political, regulatory, and Board-level information.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to Brussels and Berlin.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a scale-up or early-growth company.

  • Experience in energy, fusion, or other deep-tech sectors.

  • Experience with EU-level, parliamentary, or industry association engagement.

  • Experience supporting a C-level executive in a cross-border organization.

What We Offer

Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you'll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs, whether it's a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing. You choose what fits your lifestyle.

Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

jobs.description:
Senior Information Security Analyst
For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career! 

We are seeking a seasoned security professional to join our Information Security team and help strengthen Cirrus Logic’s overall security posture. In this role, you will work across corporate and engineering environments to assess risk, improve controls, and implement practical security solutions that protect our data and technology ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Partner across Security, IT, and engineering teams to strengthen security posture across multiple cybersecurity domains.
  • Contribute to the security program with a focus on risk evaluation and implementation of scalable security solutions across the company.
  • Design and evaluate secure infrastructure, architectures, and processes that support the Cirrus Logic business roadmap.
  • Develop and implement security requirements, policies, and procedures to protect information systems, data, and applications.
  • Participate in detection and incident response activities, including investigation, containment, and remediation.
  • Perform hands-on evaluation, engineering, and administration of enterprise security tools in collaboration with Security and IT peers.
  • Assess security posture and controls and help drive secure design and configuration across mixed platform, on-prem, hybrid, ecosystem, labs, and applications.
  • Prepare clear, actionable reporting on findings, risks, mitigation efforts, and overall security posture for stakeholders and senior leadership.

    • Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience across multiple cybersecurity domains, including vulnerability management, incident response, identity and access management, network security, risk analysis, security operations, and security engineering.
  • Demonstrated success operating as a senior individual contributor in a complex enterprise environment, balancing risk, business priorities, and practical implementation.
  • Strong hands-on experience designing secure solutions and partnering with infrastructure and engineering teams to implement them.
  • Deep familiarity with enterprise security tools, including endpoint protection, vulnerability management, and logging or SIEM platforms.
  • Experience with AI security and governance, including policy, risk, and enablement of cyber monitoring, detection, and response capabilities.
  • Experience leading or materially contributing to incident response, investigations, and threat-driven security initiatives.
  • Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and facilitate balanced risk discussions.
  • Working knowledge of security frameworks and governance concepts, including NIST CSF, ISO 27000 series, FAIR risk analysis, and privacy-related requirements.

    • Preferred Skills and Qualifications:
  • Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, SSCP, or GCIA are preferred.
  • Experience in a high-tech, engineering, or semiconductor environment is strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with globally dispersed teams across multiple time zones.

    • This position is based in our Edinburgh office, UK.

    You must be based within commutable distance of the work location listed on the job posting, or willing to relocate prior to beginning employment with Cirrus Logic.

We are unable to sponsor or obtain export licenses for this role.

About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Customer Engineer Middle East, Oil & Gas to lead technical pre-sales across our National Oil Company (NOC) engagements in the region. Working alongside our Value Advisor for energy, you will own the technical relationship with NOC customers, translating their operational challenges into Armada solutions across edge compute, sovereign AI, and disconnected/denied-environment use cases.   • Position Armada’s Galleon, Atlas, and Bridge platforms and the Microsoft Azure Local / NVIDIA / Qualcomm stack against alternatives, articulating differentiation on sovereignty, speed, and scale.
  • Develop and maintain deep working knowledge of Armada’s partner ecosystem, their products, software, technology stacks, and how they integrate with Armada, and design joint solutions that combine Armada and partner technologies.

Required Qualifications

Preferred

  • Arabic language skills.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first six months, you will have built credible technical relationships across the regional NOC portfolio, delivered at least one reference-grade proof of concept, and become the go-to technical authority for energy engagements alongside the Value Advisor. Performance will be measured against concrete targets, including [technical-win rate / pipeline supported / average technical-phase cycle time], agreed with your manager in your first 30 days.

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.
Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.
K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners.

Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK, Germany.

Please submit your CV in English

About the role:

 We are seeking a driven Research Scientist with hands-on expertise in Foundation Models (FMs) and Multimodal AI to help drive the next phase of our machine learning platform.

In this role, you will bridge cutting-edge AI research and practical application. Rather than training massive base models from scratch, your focus will be on fine-tuning, adapting, and aligning open-weights foundation models across diverse data modalities (e.g. structured tabular data, single-cell scRNA-seq, image representations, and natural language) to build multimodal systems.

  • Applied R&D collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams (data engineers, domain specialists, and software engineers) to integrate adapted models into scalable production and inference workflows.

About you

Required qualifications / experience:

  • Education: Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.

  • Experience: 2-4 years of post-degree experience applying deep learning and foundation models to complex datasets.

  • Foundation models: Demonstrated experience adapting and fine-tuning foundation models.

  • Multimodal learning: Proven experience with cross-modal representation learning, joint embedding alignment (e.g., CLIP-style architectures), or vision-language models.

    • Advanced proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, Hugging Face ecosystem).

 #LI-HB1

Harmattan AI is developing new hardware products within the Launcher module: field-deployable drone launchers designed to be deployed and operated autonomously in demanding field environments. These products require dedicated electronics design with complex architecture in a constrained environment – PCBs integrating power conversion, energy management, control and communication interfaces – optimised for cost at volume. The Launcher team is seeking a dedicated hardware engineer to own electronics design end-to-end and accelerate the path to production milestones.

Ideal candidate

A senior hardware engineer who has designed and shipped complex PCBs, ideally mixing digital and significant power (hundreds of watts), into production. They are rigorous on schematics, layout, and bring-up, and have a strong instinct for cost and manufacturability. They design with real-world operating conditions in mind - temperature, moisture, surges - and an interest in battery thermal management; direct experience of outdoor-deployed equipment is a plus rather than a prerequisite. jobs.description:
Science Manager – Nature-based Solutions (80-100%)

As a Science Manager in Climeworks Solutions, you make sure that our nature-based solutions (NBS) portfolio meets the same demanding quality bar we apply to all our carbon dioxide removal offerings. Your focus is on Afforestation, Reforestation and Revegetation (ARR), Improved Forest Management (IFM) and Mangroves, but you are not limited to these. You will screen the market, identify and assess priority projects, and carry out due diligence on potential partners. You form and defend Climeworks Solutions' own, independent scientific view on the quality, risks and fit of NBS projects. You keep our assessment criteria up to date and apply them in practice. You work closely with the sourcing team to shape our approach to nature credits, from first supplier contact to partnerships and product positioning. This role gives you real influence on how we build our nature offering and how the wider removal market develops.

  • Quality framework development: You adapt and sharpen Climeworks' quality assessment frameworks for nature-based pathways. You draw on the newest published methodologies and on standards as they evolve.

  • Supplier assessment and monitoring: You build constructive relationships with relevant suppliers. You rate and benchmark their projects. Over time, you track how project quality and delivery change and flag any concerns early.

  • Project due diligence: You run in-depth technical, scientific and commercial reviews of key projects. These cover additionality, measurability, carbon accounting, co-benefits, reversal risk and delivery risk. You combine many data sources, including GIS analysis, project documents and registry information, into clear recommendations.

  • Pathway segmentation: As the CDR industry matures, you group projects into sub-pathways and archetypes. For each one, you develop a well-founded view of what quality means.

  • Market intelligence and prioritization: Together with Sourcing, you map the project landscape across key regions and pathways. You identify the strongest projects and recommend them, based on methodological robustness, pricing, reputation and delivery record.

  • Contracting support: You help Sourcing draft contracts with approved suppliers. You focus on negotiating quality-related terms and amendments.

  • Partnership development: You help build relationships with important players in the ecosystem, such as rating agencies, registries, NGOs and other opinion leaders.

  • Pathway strategy: You work with colleagues in Science, Sourcing and the wider Commercial team to define the strategy for each nature-based pathway. You consider market trends, quality benchmarks, demand and supply.

  • Sales support: You advise on project selection and answer technical questions in customer discussions, pitches and tenders.

  • Knowledge sharing: You keep colleagues informed about scientific progress, new methodologies and market developments in nature-based solutions.


  • Education: You have a Master's degree in a relevant field, such as ecology, conservation science, environmental or natural sciences, forestry or geography. A PhD is an advantage.

  • Experience: You have hands-on experience in nature-based carbon projects. This could be project development, project design documentation, independent project ratings, MRV, carbon modelling or biodiversity research. Experience in carbon markets and CDR, and with standards such as Verra, Gold Standard, Plan Vivo or Isometric, is a strong plus.

  • Analytical skills: You work confidently with large and varied datasets, including GIS and statistical analysis. You are precise and scientifically rigorous, and you can reach sound conclusions even when data is incomplete.

  • Critical thinking: You question assumptions, spot inconsistencies and find practical solutions by connecting findings across projects.

  • Business judgement: You weigh commercial and strategic factors when assessing projects and shaping strategy.

  • Communication and language: You explain complex topics in a clear and credible way, and you can show how robust your assessments are. You are fluent in written and spoken English.

  • Way of working: You take ownership and manage several projects at once, with clean documentation. You are comfortable working across teams and in different environments. You balance independent judgement with close collaboration.

Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience. Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box. Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together.

What we offer:

  • Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays.

  • Flexibility: Work how it suits you best. We offer a hybrid work setup and up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country.

  • Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter.

  • Family Support: Inclusive parental leave.

  • Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget to invest in your professional growth.

  • Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team and earn bonuses for your successful referrals.

Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. Individual compensation depends on your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the team.

Formalities: 

  • This position is based in Opfikon, Zurich, and we ask that you work onsite at least three days per week.

  • The percentage in the job title means flexibility – choose full-time or part-time based on what works for you.

  • We do not accept candidate profiles through recruitment agencies.

Security Architect
jobs.description:
Security Architect

Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.  

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security. 

  1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

  • Security architecture review process 

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

  • Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.  

To succeed in this role: 

  • You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". 

  • You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security" 

  • You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. 

  • You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

  • You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

  • You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

  • You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

  • You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

  • You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. 

In addition, you have the following technical expertise: 

  • Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security 

  • You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached 

  • ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level 

  • Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts 

  • Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries 

  • Zero trust architecture principles 

  • Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) 

  


The following competence is desired: 

  • OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) 

  • Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption 

  • Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 

  • Container and Kubernetes security 

  • Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) 

  • Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. Experience implementing production projects with this stack is preferred, but not required if you are able to learn it quickly (based on your vast experience) 

What we offer you 

  

💶 Excellent remuneration — competitive and aligned with experience. 

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 more at half price. 

🏦 Excellent pension contribution. 

🎓 Education budget of €1,000 per year. 

⏰ Flexible working hours. 

🍱 Onsite canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2). 

🏋️ Free onsite gym. 

🎉 Vibrant, open culture.

Senior Manager, Services Portfolio & Learning Architecture

Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc

Your Role:

The Senior Manager, Services Architecture & Education leads the Portfolio Architects within the Global Services Portfolio, serving as the strategic link that converts overarching portfolio strategy into technically credible consulting services and end-to-end Education programs. Carrying a dual mandate, this role is accountable for leading an experienced team of technical experts through an evolving operating model while acting as the authoritative technical design voice across the entire Global Services suite.

This position owns service design, Education strategy, offering creation, the On-Demand Training (ODT) and Instructor-Led Training (ILT) curricula, and the Training Subscription model. The Senior Manager builds, standardizes, and scales the creation and maintenance engine necessary to keep all consulting offerings and educational content continually aligned with Tenable’s rapidly evolving product roadmap, feature releases, and version retirements.

Working with minimal supervision as a key member of the Services Portfolio Leadership Team, the Senior Manager sets high-bar technical and instructional standards, balances team capacity across creation, optimization, and lifecycle maintenance, and collaborates seamlessly with cross-functional leadership—including Portfolio Strategy & Innovation, Portfolio Enablement & Creative, Program Management, and PS Product Champions—to drive portfolio adoption and operational excellence.

ORGANIZATION STRUCTURE:

  • Reports to: Senior Director, Services Portfolio
  • Direct reports: Portfolio Architects (Associate Services Architects, Services Architects, and Senior Services Architects)

Your Opportunity:

Service Design & Offering Creation

  • Service Architecture: Own the architecture, methodology, scope, and outcomes of consulting service offerings, and the technical requirements and validation behind them. Each offering has a named Services Architect who owns its technical design, with the Manager accountable.
  • Offering Creation: Direct the creation of net-new offerings and Education against the quarterly roadmap set by Portfolio Strategy & Innovation, and lead improvements to existing services alongside the Portfolio Strategy & Innovation Lead.
  • Technical Substance: Make sure the team owns the technical, service, and Education substance of its work, and that the content is accurate before it is handed to Portfolio Enablement & Creative for writing and design.
  • Standards & Quality: Set and maintain service design, content, and lab standards and templates, and review the most strategic offerings before release.

Education Strategy & Training Subscription

  • Education Strategy: Set the direction for Professional Services Education across on-demand (ODT), instructor-led (ILT), and hybrid delivery.
  • Curriculum Ownership: Be accountable for the TRG master curriculum and the ODT and ILT source content, including review on a defined cadence and consistency between delivery formats.
  • Training Subscription: Direct the priorities and evolution of the Training Subscription and track its adoption.
  • Education Authoring: Ensure Architects author and maintain Education content, including in Articulate, to the standard required for technical accuracy and sound learning design. Work with Portfolio Enablement & Creative, where digital learning production needs specialist support.
  • Education Governance: Work with the Education Governance Lead on standards, approvals, versioning, and controls. The Manager owns the Education strategy, and Governance owns the controls.

Portfolio Maintenance & Lifecycle

  • Maintenance Health: Be accountable for overall maintenance health across services and Education. Run maintenance as a formal lifecycle (identify, triage, assign, update, validate, publish, communicate, close) carried out by named asset owners, without creating a permanent maintenance team.
  • Capacity Allocation: Allocate team capacity between creating, improving, and maintaining content, and report the mix, overdue maintenance, and retirements at the quarterly portfolio review.
  • Roadmap Alignment: Work with Product Management and Portfolio Strategy & Innovation to plan updates well ahead of product release, and to decide what to refresh, retire, or replace.
  • Feedback Loop: Act on maintenance and improvement items routed from field feedback triage and the PS Product Champions Forum, and close the loop visibly with the field.

Team Leadership & Delivery

  • People Leadership: Recruit, onboard, manage, and develop the Portfolio Architects, including performance management and career progression across the Associate, Services Architect, and Senior Services Architect levels.
  • Change Leadership: Lead the team through the move to the new operating model, including the transition of long-tenured team members, and set clear expectations for the Architect role.
  • Capability Building: Build team capability in service design, Education design, and delivery, and in the use of modern authoring and AI-enabled production approaches.
  • Delivery Oversight: Oversee dependencies, costs, and schedules across team projects, assess risks, and take corrective action to ensure on-time, within-budget delivery.
  • Budget: Manage the team’s budget and make the case for resources, tooling, and lab environments.
  • Protecting Creation Time: Protect focus time for the team, including the Friday focus day, so that deep creation and maintenance work is not displaced by meetings.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Engagement

  • Portfolio Leadership Team: Contribute to the weekly Portfolio Management Call, bringing creation, Education, maintenance, capacity, and the decisions required, and to the quarterly portfolio review.
  • Strategy & Innovation: Work with the Portfolio Strategy & Innovation Lead on the annual and quarterly roadmap, business cases, and launch readiness, providing technical and Education input.
  • Enablement & Creative: Work with the Portfolio Enablement & Creative Manager on briefs, handoffs, and review cycles to ensure creative output includes accurate technical content.
  • Program Management: Work with the Portfolio Program Manager on milestones, dependencies, and launch readiness.
  • PS Product Champions: Use the PS Product Champions to validate content and to maintain delivery playbooks, worksheets, and guidance, with Architects validating where needed.
  • Stakeholders: Interface with leaders in Product, Customer Success, Customer Care, Sales, and Partners, including direct customer and partner engagement where needed.
  • Escalations: Act as the senior escalation point for portfolio content issues that the team cannot resolve.

What You'll Need:

Experience

  • Security Foundations: 10+ years of overall experience in Information Security.
  • Vulnerability Management & Cybersecurity: 5+ years of experience in vulnerability management and broader cybersecurity operations, preferably with the Tenable product suite.
  • Services Experience: 7+ years of professional services, consulting, technical support, sales engineering, or technical training experience.
  • Education & Curriculum: Proven experience setting Education strategy and designing and delivering technical curricula across on-demand, instructor-led, and hybrid formats, including subscription or learning platform offerings.
  • People Management: 3+ years of experience leading technical, content, or consulting teams, including line management and leading experienced teams through change.
  • Delivery Lifecycle: Exposure to the full offering or product delivery life cycle: requirements analysis, design, testing, and implementation.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Experience with cross-functional and cross-organisational program management, including gathering customer and stakeholder requirements.

Knowledge and Education

  • Education: B.S. or M.S. degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
  • Technical Depth: In-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems and of TCP/IP networking, with working knowledge of web application, container, and cloud security (AWS/Azure) and ICS/SCADA systems.
  • Learning Design & Authoring: Working knowledge of instructional design frameworks and of authoring tools such as Articulate, sufficient to set standards and review the team’s work.
  • Business Acumen: Both business and technical acumen, including budget management and capacity planning.
  • Certifications: CISSP, CISM, or PMP preferred.

And Ideally:

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present to executive, customer, and partner audiences.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and work effectively across teams and at a senior level.
  • Autonomy: Strong initiative and the ability to work with minimal supervision, remotely and as part of a geographically distributed team, in an agile environment.

jobs.title: Sr. Clinical Research Associate (Hungary)
jobs.description:
Sr. Clinical Research Associate (Hungary)

Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

The Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA) independently performs, coordinates and oversees clinical site monitoring activities, ensuring compliance with study protocols, Alimentiv and sponsor procedures, ICH-GCP guidelines and local regulatory requirements.

Serving as a primary liaison between investigative sites, Alimentiv and sponsors, the Sr. CRA plays a key role in the successful execution of clinical studies from site selection and start-up through monitoring and close-out. This role also provides guidance and mentorship to CRA I and CRA II colleagues and may participate in CRA assessment visits, co-monitoring activities, audits and inspections.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently conduct and document onsite and remote site management activities, including site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits, in accordance with applicable SOPs and study requirements.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for investigative sites, building effective working relationships and ensuring site questions, issues, action items and protocol deviations are followed through to resolution.

  • Review source documentation and study systems to ensure clinical data is accurate, complete and compliant with protocol, regulatory and study requirements; manage and facilitate the resolution of data queries.

  • Oversee site activation and ongoing site management activities, working with sites and cross-functional teams to achieve project timelines, milestones and recruitment objectives.

  • Ensure site personnel are appropriately trained on study protocols, plans, systems, ICH-GCP requirements and project-specific expectations.

  • Routinely review Investigator Site Files (ISF), Trial Master Files (TMF) and study systems for accuracy, completeness, timeliness and compliance, requesting outstanding documentation as required.

  • Coordinate site-related study activities and communications, including clinical supplies, investigational product, laboratory materials, ePROs, study documentation and ongoing project updates.

  • Collaborate with Study Start-up, Regulatory and other cross-functional teams, including supporting document collection, localisation and translation activities where required.

  • Participate in study meetings, Investigator Meetings, audits and inspections, supporting issue resolution and implementation of corrective actions when required.

  • Mentor and support CRA I and CRA II colleagues, including CRA Assessment Visits, co-monitoring and sign-off activities; contribute to CRA interviews, training and process improvement initiatives as requested.

Skills & Qualifications

  • (Honours) Bachelor’s degree required; a degree in Health Sciences, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or Nursing is preferred. A Master’s degree is considered an asset.

  • Minimum 4–6 years of relevant clinical research experience; 7–9 years of related experience is preferred.

  • Experience across Phase I–IV clinical trials is preferred.

  • Thorough knowledge of ICH-GCP and applicable local regulatory requirements.

  • Demonstrated experience independently conducting site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits.

  • Proficiency with clinical trial systems including EDC platforms (e.g., Medidata Rave, Oracle InForm), IRT, eTMF and CTMS, as well as Microsoft Office.

  • Strong interpersonal, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and effectively within cross-functional teams.

  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage priorities with an appropriate sense of urgency.

  • Fluent written and verbal English; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

  • Valid driver’s licence and ability to travel approximately 40–60%, depending on project assignment and the geographic location of investigative sites.

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.

Compensation

Additional Information

Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will design, develop, and operate the infrastructure that enables AI agents to perform increasingly autonomous tasks safely and reliably. You will work across agent runtimes, integrations, identity management, security guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership from initial design and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This remote-first opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong software fundamentals with practical expertise in deploying and scaling LLM-based systems.


Accountabilities

You will help build and evolve the organization's AI platform, enabling teams across the business to deploy reliable, secure, and increasingly autonomous agents. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Productionizing AI workflows: Transform prototypes into robust production systems with defined service-level agreements (SLAs), supporting use cases such as specification-to-pull-request agents, AI-powered code reviews, incident triage, and Know Your Business (KYB) reviews.

  • Building and managing MCP servers: Design, deploy, secure, and maintain Model Context Protocol servers, including authentication, per-user OAuth, scoped access, and integrations with tools such as Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services.

  • Developing autonomous agents: Build multi-step agents capable of planning and taking action across different tools, progressing through controlled trust stages from shadowing and suggesting to executing tasks autonomously.

  • Implementing security and governance: Establish platform-wide guardrails, including agent identities, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval workflows, allowlists, and least-privilege access policies.

  • Creating evaluation frameworks: Develop test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression suites, and live production scoring systems to measure agent quality and connect performance metrics to business outcomes.

  • Improving observability: Instrument agents and workflows with tracing, logging, latency and cost metrics, drift detection, alerts, and dashboards that help internal Operators monitor performance.

  • Managing AI expenditure: Track usage and spending across AI providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. Establish budgets, alerts, and cost attribution at the team, agent, and workflow levels.

  • Supporting internal stakeholders: Work directly with Operators across business functions to understand their needs, develop requested features, create documentation, deliver enablement sessions, and build self-service tools.

  • Developing reusable AI capabilities: Create and maintain shared skills, plugins, and knowledge resources covering company processes, standards, security requirements, and brand guidelines.

  • Driving process automation: Proactively identify repetitive manual workflows that could benefit from AI, implement automation solutions, measure their impact, and continuously improve them.

  • Taking end-to-end ownership: Write technical specifications, plan and deliver projects independently, communicate progress asynchronously, and remain accountable for monitoring and improving solutions after deployment.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building and operating production-ready AI systems. You should be comfortable working independently, communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and applying sound judgment to complex automation and security challenges. Required qualifications include:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a software, platform, or infrastructure engineer, with a solid understanding of system design, data modeling, testing, debugging, and code review.

  • Between 6 and 12 months of experience shipping LLM-based systems to production and supporting agentic workflows used by real end users.

  • Daily, hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to write, test, and review production code.

  • Experience developing autonomous or multi-step agents with tool integrations, using technologies such as the Claude Agent SDK, Anthropic APIs, OpenAI APIs, or similar frameworks.

  • Practical experience building MCP servers, including OAuth authentication flows, scoped tokens, and user-level access controls.

  • Knowledge of identity and access management systems such as Okta or similar identity providers, including SSO protocols (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group-based access, and device policies.

  • Experience creating automated system identities, including GitHub Apps, service accounts, API keys, and managing secrets through tools such as 1Password.

  • Understanding of security guardrails and governance practices, including least-privilege access, audit logging, CI checks, approval gates, allowlists, and policy-as-code.

  • Experience designing evaluation systems for LLM applications, including test sets, evaluation rubrics, CI regression testing, release gates, and live production scoring.

  • Practical experience implementing production observability through tracing, metrics, alerting, and dashboards, using tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Langfuse, LangSmith, or Braintrust.

  • Experience monitoring and controlling AI expenditure across providers through API key limits, cost centers, budgets, and actionable alerts.

  • Strong programming skills in at least one of TypeScript, Python, or Go, alongside working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure.

  • A demonstrated ability to independently identify and automate manual processes, supported by two or three concrete examples of previous work.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical specifications, runbooks, and RFCs.

  • Ability to understand stakeholder needs, translate ambiguous requests into actionable technical requirements, and explain complex concepts to both executives and subject matter experts.

  • A proactive and autonomous working style, with the ability to prioritize effectively, challenge unsafe or low-value requests constructively, and communicate progress across time zones.

  • A strong sense of ownership, including the ability to validate solutions with users, monitor performance after deployment, and continuously iterate.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cryptocurrency, blockchain, payments, or fintech, particularly within regulated or audit-focused environments.

  • Experience creating reusable agent skills, plugins, or shared prompt libraries for organizational use.

  • Familiarity with model gateways such as OpenRouter, LiteLLM, or Portkey, including key management, model routing, and fallback strategies.

  • Experience extending open-source coding agents such as OpenCode or Pi.

  • Awareness of emerging agent identity standards, including MCP enterprise-managed authentication and Okta Cross App Access.

  • Knowledge of context and retrieval engineering, including vector stores, agent memory, and permission-aware retrieval systems.

  • Background in machine learning engineering, including model evaluation, fine-tuning, and model routing.

  • Experience working with agent runtimes and sandbox environments such as Modal, n8n, or containerized infrastructure.

jobs.description:
Security Engineer

Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that builds trust, sparks innovation, and strengthens team culture.

 

About Superhuman

Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that makes AI work for everyone. Over 40 million people rely on it daily to get work done. A recognized leader in productivity tools, Superhuman is the maker of popular products including Docs, Fathom, Go, GPTZero, Grammarly, and Mail. The newest product, Superhuman Go, builds on Grammarly’s ability to deliver help everywhere people work. It lets anyone build proactive agents that act as teammates across more than 1 million apps and websites, without changing how they work. Learn more at superhuman.com.

 

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Security Engineer to join our Detection & Response Team to achieve our ambitious goals. This role will contribute to our D&R team as hands-on practitioner across incident response, detection engineering, threat hunting, and threat intelligence. You'll plan, execute, and debrief complex security operations, leveraging those insights to enhance our threat mitigation capabilities and build robust, automated security tooling across all Superhuman environments.

Additionally, you'll own key workstreams in executing and advancing our security vision, translating strategic objectives into tactical implementations through strong technical execution and innovative solution building, with particular emphasis on automation and AI-powered security solutions. You'll conduct research across security domains and automation technologies, identifying opportunities to enhance our capabilities through cutting-edge approaches and intelligent automation. Finally, you'll bring an attacker mindset into Superhuman’s engineering and security culture, thinking like a threat actor to defend our systems in a way that is grounded in how real attacks happen.

Superhuman's engineers and researchers have the freedom to innovate and uncover breakthroughs—and, in turn, influence our product roadmap. The complexity of our technical challenges is growing rapidly as we scale our interfaces, algorithms, and infrastructure. Curious how we build and operate our AI agents? Check out our engineering blog, and explore our threat-hunting AI here.

As a Security Engineer, you will:

  • Own the IR strategy end-to-end, building, maintaining, and operating the systems and tooling that strengthen our ability to detect, contain, and recover from security incidents at scale

  • Build and maintain automated threat detection systems, AI-driven alert triage solutions, and security intelligence pipelines that scale with business growth

  • Conduct threat hunting and detection engineering, developing detection-as-code, hunting-as-code, and intelligence-as-code capabilities.

  • Research and develop cutting-edge security automation and AI-powered security solutions to deepen and scale our ability to identify threats, including autonomous security agents.

  • Operate without traditional scope limitations, following attacker kill chains to uncover security gaps that scoped teams miss.

  • Lead complex security investigations, including insider threat scenarios and sophisticated attack campaigns.

  • Maintain incident response capabilities and serve as part of the Incident Command on-call schedule.

  • Embed attacker mindset thinking throughout the organization through education and collaboration with engineering teams.

Qualifications

  • Has 3+ years of relevant experience in security engineering, with expertise across multiple disciplines including incident response and detection engineering (threat intelligence, threat hunting experience is nice to have too)

  • Proven incident response leadership and complex security investigation experience.

  • Automation and development skills in Python, Go, or similar languages, with experience building production security tooling.

  • Knowledge of cloud security architecture.

  • Research mindset with an ability to identify novel attack vectors and develop creative, pragmatic solutions.

  • Thrives in ambiguous environments and can deliver meaningful results at a rapid pace while managing multiple competing priorities.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with CI/CD security integration, identity and access management concepts, and security orchestration.

  • Experience with large-scale Kubernetes clusters.

  • Background in AI/ML applications for security, including experience with or interest in developing autonomous security systems.

 

Compensation and Benefits

  • Professional Growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first, hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture rooted in our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our team member resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

 

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations—to apply. Superhuman is an equal opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, sexual identity, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, criminal prosecution, judgment in a criminal case, or any other characteristic protected by law.
