jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
AI Platform Engineer

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in Switzerland.

Join a forward-thinking technology team building the AI platform that powers intelligent agents across multiple business functions, including engineering, business development, compliance, support, and finance. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will design, develop, and operate the infrastructure that enables AI agents to perform increasingly autonomous tasks safely and reliably. You will work across agent runtimes, integrations, identity management, security guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership from initial design and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This remote-first opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong software fundamentals with practical expertise in deploying and scaling LLM-based systems.


Accountabilities

You will help build and evolve the organization's AI platform, enabling teams across the business to deploy reliable, secure, and increasingly autonomous agents. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Productionizing AI workflows: Transform prototypes into robust production systems with defined service-level agreements (SLAs), supporting use cases such as specification-to-pull-request agents, AI-powered code reviews, incident triage, and Know Your Business (KYB) reviews.

  • Building and managing MCP servers: Design, deploy, secure, and maintain Model Context Protocol servers, including authentication, per-user OAuth, scoped access, and integrations with tools such as Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services.

  • Developing autonomous agents: Build multi-step agents capable of planning and taking action across different tools, progressing through controlled trust stages from shadowing and suggesting to executing tasks autonomously.

  • Implementing security and governance: Establish platform-wide guardrails, including agent identities, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval workflows, allowlists, and least-privilege access policies.

  • Creating evaluation frameworks: Develop test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression suites, and live production scoring systems to measure agent quality and connect performance metrics to business outcomes.

  • Improving observability: Instrument agents and workflows with tracing, logging, latency and cost metrics, drift detection, alerts, and dashboards that help internal Operators monitor performance.

  • Managing AI expenditure: Track usage and spending across AI providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. Establish budgets, alerts, and cost attribution at the team, agent, and workflow levels.

  • Supporting internal stakeholders: Work directly with Operators across business functions to understand their needs, develop requested features, create documentation, deliver enablement sessions, and build self-service tools.

  • Developing reusable AI capabilities: Create and maintain shared skills, plugins, and knowledge resources covering company processes, standards, security requirements, and brand guidelines.

  • Driving process automation: Proactively identify repetitive manual workflows that could benefit from AI, implement automation solutions, measure their impact, and continuously improve them.

  • Taking end-to-end ownership: Write technical specifications, plan and deliver projects independently, communicate progress asynchronously, and remain accountable for monitoring and improving solutions after deployment.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building and operating production-ready AI systems. You should be comfortable working independently, communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and applying sound judgment to complex automation and security challenges. Required qualifications include:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a software, platform, or infrastructure engineer, with a solid understanding of system design, data modeling, testing, debugging, and code review.

  • Between 6 and 12 months of experience shipping LLM-based systems to production and supporting agentic workflows used by real end users.

  • Daily, hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to write, test, and review production code.

  • Experience developing autonomous or multi-step agents with tool integrations, using technologies such as the Claude Agent SDK, Anthropic APIs, OpenAI APIs, or similar frameworks.

  • Practical experience building MCP servers, including OAuth authentication flows, scoped tokens, and user-level access controls.

  • Knowledge of identity and access management systems such as Okta or similar identity providers, including SSO protocols (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group-based access, and device policies.

  • Experience creating automated system identities, including GitHub Apps, service accounts, API keys, and managing secrets through tools such as 1Password.

  • Understanding of security guardrails and governance practices, including least-privilege access, audit logging, CI checks, approval gates, allowlists, and policy-as-code.

  • Experience designing evaluation systems for LLM applications, including test sets, evaluation rubrics, CI regression testing, release gates, and live production scoring.

  • Practical experience implementing production observability through tracing, metrics, alerting, and dashboards, using tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Langfuse, LangSmith, or Braintrust.

  • Experience monitoring and controlling AI expenditure across providers through API key limits, cost centers, budgets, and actionable alerts.

  • Strong programming skills in at least one of TypeScript, Python, or Go, alongside working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure.

  • A demonstrated ability to independently identify and automate manual processes, supported by two or three concrete examples of previous work.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical specifications, runbooks, and RFCs.

  • Ability to understand stakeholder needs, translate ambiguous requests into actionable technical requirements, and explain complex concepts to both executives and subject matter experts.

  • A proactive and autonomous working style, with the ability to prioritize effectively, challenge unsafe or low-value requests constructively, and communicate progress across time zones.

  • A strong sense of ownership, including the ability to validate solutions with users, monitor performance after deployment, and continuously iterate.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cryptocurrency, blockchain, payments, or fintech, particularly within regulated or audit-focused environments.

  • Experience creating reusable agent skills, plugins, or shared prompt libraries for organizational use.

  • Familiarity with model gateways such as OpenRouter, LiteLLM, or Portkey, including key management, model routing, and fallback strategies.

  • Experience extending open-source coding agents such as OpenCode or Pi.

  • Awareness of emerging agent identity standards, including MCP enterprise-managed authentication and Okta Cross App Access.

  • Knowledge of context and retrieval engineering, including vector stores, agent memory, and permission-aware retrieval systems.

  • Background in machine learning engineering, including model evaluation, fine-tuning, and model routing.

  • Experience working with agent runtimes and sandbox environments such as Modal, n8n, or containerized infrastructure.

  • Public technical contributions, such as open-source tools, servers, technical articles, or presentations demonstrating experience with production AI agents.

    • Benefits

  • Remote-first work environment: Join a globally distributed workforce and work remotely.

  • Health insurance: Access medical, dental, and vision coverage, with employee and dependent coverage fully provided in certain countries, depending on the applicable plan.

  • Retirement benefits: Benefit from a company-matched 401(k) contribution of up to 3% for eligible employees in the United States.

  • Home office allowance: Receive a one-time allowance of $1,500 to set up your home workspace.

  • Professional development: Access an annual book allowance of $200 to support continuous learning.

  • Connectivity reimbursement: Receive $75 per month toward internet or phone expenses.

  • Flexible time off: Benefit from flexible paid time off arrangements.

  • Work equipment: Receive a company-issued laptop.

  • Well-being support: Access egg-freezing benefits, mental health resources, and employee wellness programs.

  • Inclusive workplace: Work in an environment committed to equal opportunity, accessibility, and providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Startup Operations Generalist
jobs.description:
Startup Operations Generalist

Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

We are growing fast and opening a second lab in London. Every new person, contract, invoice and payroll run lands on someone's desk. You own that desk.

This is the operations generalist seat: finance admin, payroll, people operations, hiring logistics, and whatever else the company needs to run well. You own the machinery so that everyone else spends their time on the lab.

This is not a strategy role and not a pure HR role. It is hands-on, and most of the work is making sure things happen correctly and on time, then making sure they happen without you next time.

What You'll Do

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

About the role

We are hiring for our second Commercial Account Executive to help grow the Commercial business across the Netherlands.

You will help grow the Commercial business in your market by building strong relationships, creating new logo momentum, and working closely with partners and the wider team to expand Horizon3’s reach.

We are looking for experienced sellers who enjoy building. They should be proactive, thoughtful, and comfortable helping markets develop. At the same time, we work for and in our local markets. That means staying close to customers, partners, and market activity. Travel in-region is part of the role.

In each market, the Commercial seller, Enterprise seller, Partner Manager, Sales Engineer, and Commercial leader may report into different leaders, but they share collective responsibility for helping the market work well and for making Horizon3 successful in the region.

What you will do

  • Grow the Commercial business in your assigned markets through strong customer engagement, partner collaboration, and good market execution

  • Create new logo momentum and build pipeline in a way that fits the local market

  • Build and manage opportunities with good judgement, clear ownership, and strong follow-through

  • Work closely with partners, distributors, MSSPs, Enterprise sellers, Partner Managers, and Sales Engineers to help the market work well

  • Work across Marketing, Channel, Sales Engineering, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, and leadership to move business forward

  • Bring useful market feedback back into the business

  • Represent Horizon3 well with customers and partners

  • Keep building your capability, product knowledge, and commercial effectiveness over time

What success looks like

Success in this role is about helping the market grow and contributing to a strong Commercial motion in-region.

You will be successful if you:

  • Create new logo momentum and help grow the Commercial segment in your markets

  • Build strong relationships with customers, partners, and internal teams

  • Manage opportunities well and help move business forward with consistency and ownership

  • Become productive quickly and continue to grow in impact over time

What we are looking for

We are looking for experienced Commercial sellers who are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and helping build markets.

Strong candidates will bring:

  • More than 4 years of closing experience in IT or cybersecurity sales

  • Experience in Commercial or mid-market sales, ideally in more than one market or in a regionally complex environment

  • Confidence working with partners, distributors, MSSPs, and cross-functional teams

  • Good commercial judgement and the ability to navigate opportunities with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders

  • Strong ownership, follow-through, and comfort with visibility and accountability

  • Curiosity, coachability, and a desire to keep learning and improving

  • Comfort working in a scaling business where structure is still being built

  • Fluency in Dutch, plus strong English

  • A proactive, builder mindset: someone with a point of view who stays close to the market, works well with customers, partners, and the wider team, and looks for better ways to increase reach, efficiency, and impact

Why this role matters

This is a chance to help shape how Commercial grows across EMEA.

If you want a role where you can help build markets, work closely with partners and customers, and play a meaningful part in how a new category develops in-region, this is that role.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

jobs.title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Manager
jobs.description:
Senior CRM & Lifecycle Manager

Your mission

Cosuno is a platform for construction tendering in the German-speaking market. It connects general contractors, who publish bid packages, with subcontractors, who bid on them, and both sides pay. As our Senior Lifecycle & Customer Growth Manager, you own how customers on both sides activate, buy and stay. You decide which signals matter and what should happen next, and a Growth Engineer builds the system with you. You'll be one of the first hires in a lean marketing team and shape how it works as it grows. We're looking for someone ambitious: you think in systems that sense, decide and learn, not in a handful of fixed, old-school email journeys.

What you'll do

• Define the lifecycle and signal strategy for general contractors and subcontractors: the key stages and behaviours, and the signals that predict activation, repeat usage, expansion or churn.

• Turn those signals into playbooks: prioritized interventions, segments and messages, coordinated with Sales and Customer Success where a human touch works better.

• Drive subcontractor activation, conversion to Premium and churn prevention, and contractor adoption and retention, including 1:1 logic on enriched account data.

• Prove what works with cohort baselines, A/B tests and holdout groups, so decisions rest on incremental impact, not campaign output.

• Build a signal-driven system with the Growth Engineer that decides what happens next, starting from a prioritized signal-to-action map.

• Later, build retention and referral programmes and help hire a second Lifecycle Manager.

What you bring

• You've owned lifecycle, CRM, retention or growth programmes and can show their commercial impact, ideally in B2B SaaS or a two-sided business.

• You're ambitious and think big: you design lifecycle as a system that adapts to each customer, not as a set of fixed drip journeys that get tweaked once a quarter.

• You're data-driven: you've moved activation, conversion or retention metrics and you read experiment results critically.

• You're technically fluent: you've worked with an engineer on a complex system with solid tracking and solved problems from the implementation side.

• You're AI-native: you've built AI-driven automation into a real journey, not only used AI to write copy faster.

• You get things done, learn fast and are comfortable building from scratch.

• You work well across Product, Sales, Customer Success and Engineering.

• Fluent English; German is a big plus. Experience with ActiveCampaign or Salesforce is a plus.

Your benefits

• Room to shape and grow: one of the first marketing hires, with real ownership of lifecycle and CRM on both sides of the platform.

• AI at the core: our product uses AI to analyze millions of price data points and help construction companies bid better, and we invest in it just as much internally. You'll build with the latest tools and move fast.

• Competitive compensation: salary above market average, permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

• Work-life balance: fully remote or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, flexible hours.

• Top-notch equipment: a new MacBook Pro.

• A great team: open, international, with regular off-sites and team events.

• Growth and feedback: open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

About us

Cosuno is a fast-growing tech company making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with its digital platform for tenders and procurement. Our goal: to solve the industry's most complex challenges with innovation and simplicity. Join us and build the future of construction.

Compensation: €65K – €85K

About us

Salience Labs is building the optical infrastructure that will power the next generation of AI. Our photonic switching technology delivers the high-speed, ultra-low latency networking fabrics AI datacenters need and can’t get anywhere else. We’re a multi-disciplinary team of physicists, engineers, and machine learning specialists on a mission to remove the bottlenecks holding AI infrastructure back.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Photonics Layout Lead to join our Photonics team and lead our Layout team, taking technical and people leadership of the physical design, verification and development of advanced integrated photonic devices.

You will work closely with engineers across photonic design, layout and testing, setting the direction for how device and circuit requirements are translated into robust, fabrication-ready layouts. The role combines hands-on physical layout, design verification, programming and ownership of our internal design workflows, along with leading, developing and managing the layout engineers on your team and raising the standard of layout work across the company.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of integrated photonics, semiconductor design and software. You should be comfortable leading the resolution of complex layout challenges, interpreting and challenging design requirements, and using programming to improve the speed, quality and repeatability of engineering work, while building a team that can do the same.

We are particularly interested in people who have led or significantly shaped integrated photonics or semiconductor IC layout work, and who have experience leading engineers, whether in industry, research or a strong academic environment.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the Layout team, setting priorities, allocating work and ensuring the team delivers high-quality, on-time results

  • Line manage layout engineers, including coaching, performance reviews, career development and objective setting

  • Support hiring and onboarding of new layout engineers as the team grows

  • Lead the development of physical layouts for integrated photonic components, structures and large-scale photonic designs

  • Own design verification, including DRC and LVS, and drive designs through the full layout and verification process to tape-out

  • Define and support the development of appropriate test and characterisation structures

  • Lead layout reviews for design integrity, fabrication constraints and potential sources of failure

  • Act as a technical point of contact for foundry and fabrication partners on design rules, process constraints and verification issues

  • Plan and prioritise layout work across projects, balancing schedule, quality, risk and team capacity

  • Collaborate closely with photonic design, testing and wider engineering teams, and represent the Layout team in planning and design discussions

  • Drive improvements in layout methodology, tooling and verification processes

  • Make photonic design workflows increasingly repeatable, reliable and efficient

You will own the Layout team’s technical direction and delivery, from individual components through to complex, full-chip integrated photonic designs and their verification.

What we’re looking for

  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Physics, Photonics, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, or another closely related technical discipline

  • Typically 6+ years of relevant experience in integrated photonics, photonic IC layout, semiconductor IC layout or design verification, including experience leading or owning layout work on complete designs

  • Experience leading, managing or mentoring engineers, and a track record of developing people and building effective teams

  • Extensive hands-on experience creating physical IC or photonic layouts using Python or other layout and EDA software

  • Strong programming capability, ideally in Python or another relevant language, with experience building and maintaining layout automation

  • The ability to explain and discuss software or coding projects you have worked on in detail

  • A strong understanding of integrated photonics or the broader semiconductor IC industry

  • Working knowledge of photonic IC design and fabrication flows, including experience taking designs through tape-out

  • A deep understanding of how physical layout decisions interact with device design, fabrication and performance

  • Experience with DRC and LVS verification, and with resolving complex verification issues

  • Experience planning and prioritising work across multiple projects and engineers

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively and influence across multidisciplinary engineering teams

  • Strong critical thinking and attention to detail, particularly when reviewing layouts and resolving verification issues

  • Clear communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Candidates with particularly strong academic, research or project experience may also be considered where they can demonstrate the required practical capability and leadership.

Even better if you

  • Have a Master’s degree or PhD in integrated photonics, photonics, electrical engineering, physics or a related discipline

  • Have led Python-based layout automation or framework development

  • Have experience with photonic or semiconductor EDA tools

  • Are familiar with common integrated photonic devices and structures

  • Have knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes and fabrication technologies

  • Have developed or maintained component or PDK libraries

  • Have been involved in multiple photonic or semiconductor design cycles

  • Have experience working within a commercial product development environment

  • Have a background in photonic device design or semiconductor process development

  • Have experience building or scaling a layout team or function, including hiring

Relevant backgrounds could include integrated photonics design and layout teams, silicon photonics research groups, university or research institute environments, or semiconductor IC layout and verification teams.

This is an opportunity to work on genuinely challenging problems across photonics, semiconductor engineering and software, with meaningful ownership over the quality and effectiveness of physical design. You will join a highly collaborative engineering environment where you can shape not just individual designs, but also the methods, tools, processes and people behind our advanced photonic hardware.

The role is based in the UK on a hybrid basis, with four days per week on site and one day working from home.

Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

About the Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Kpler, you will play a key role in developing and deploying predictive models that power our global commodity, energy, and maritime intelligence platforms. Working closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Product teams, you will bridge the gap between machine learning experimentation and production-grade software delivery. Your work will directly transform complex data flows into real-time, actionable insights that help world-leading trading firms, industrial leaders, and analysts make critical decisions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and deploy ML pipelines: Design, build, and maintain production-grade machine learning workflows and microservices for power market forecasting and electricity grid modeling.

  • Bridge research and engineering: Transition statistical and machine learning prototypes from initial experimentation into scalable, production-ready Python applications.

  • Manage time-series and event data systems: Design and optimize database schemas in PostgreSQL to handle high-throughput time-series data, event streams, and normalization routines.

  • Implement robust MLOps practices: Establish automated model training, backtesting, evaluation, tuning, and feature/model versioning standards across deployments.

  • Drive data engineering quality: Construct clean ingestion and transformation pipelines, ensuring high integrity, validation, and low-latency access across analytical models.

  • Data engineering & databases: Experience in data engineering, including working with PostgreSQL or similar databases, database design, data normalisation, and managing time-series and event data.

  • DS & ML research rigor: Proven experience in data science and machine learning research, encompassing statistics, hypothesis testing, model training, evaluation, backtesting, tuning, and model selection.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


The Sonar Solutions Engineering team is dedicated to helping our prospective customers achieve technical success with our products. This is your chance to join a growing team as we scale up our efforts to have maximum impact on our targeted customer base. 
 
As a Solutions Engineer at Sonar, you’ll play a central role in providing deep technical expertise to our prospects and supporting them in evaluating our solution. The SE team works as part of the Sales process and also engages with Marketing, Product Management, and Development teams to provide feedback on our products' evolution and messaging.

jobs.title: Portfolio Accountant
jobs.description:
Portfolio Accountant

Access Your Potential.
Join us to create and deliver experiences that inspire people, spark connection, and bring imagination to life—while having a lot of fun doing it.

About the Job

We’re seeking a detail-oriented and organized Portfolio Accountant to join our Finance & Accounting team! In this role, you’ll manage the day-to-day accounting operations for an assigned Access territory, ensuring accurate financial records, timely reporting, and effective financial support for territory operations.

Working closely with territory leadership and the broader Finance & Accounting team, you’ll oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger transactions, month-end closing activities, and financial reporting. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working independently, solving problems, and building strong relationships with internal teams while keeping financial operations running smoothly.

What You'll Be Doing

Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Manage day-to-day accounting activities for an assigned territory, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger transactions.

  • Process supplier payments, client deposits, final payments, expense reports, and journal entries accurately and within established deadlines.

  • Prepare and maintain general ledger entries, account reconciliations, and supporting financial documentation.

  • Complete month-end closing activities, ensuring financial records are accurate and up to date.

  • Enter territory actuals into monthly budget comparison worksheets, review results for discrepancies, and flag variances for Controller review.

  • Monitor territory revenue, expenses, and cash flow to support accurate financial reporting.

  • Provide financial information and supporting documentation to the Controller and Finance & Accounting leadership.

Territory Accounting Support

  • Serve as a primary accounting resource for employees within the assigned territory.

  • Partner with territory leadership and internal departments to resolve accounting-related questions and discrepancies.

  • Review and submit territory-specific labor and staffing reports in accordance with established procedures.

  • Support territory budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting activities as assigned.

  • Ensure timely and accurate processing of financial transactions to support ongoing territory operations.

Compliance & Financial Accuracy

  • Maintain accurate accounting records in accordance with applicable accounting standards and company policies.

  • Assist with internal and external audits by maintaining organized financial records and supporting documentation.

  • Ensure accounting activities are completed in accordance with established procedures and reporting deadlines.

Training & Team Collaboration

  • Provide accounting-related guidance and training to new employees within the assigned territory as needed.

  • Collaborate with the Finance & Accounting team to ensure consistent application of established procedures, communicate accounting concerns, and escalate issues as appropriate.

  • Support additional territory-level accounting projects and responsibilities as assigned.

About You

We know that there’s no one in the world like you. And we know that you have a lot to offer the next company you work with. Below is a list of “nice-to-haves”, but don’t let those deter you from applying. Access believes that an inclusive team and culture is important. We seek applicants from all backgrounds to ensure we get the best, most creative talent on our team.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • 1–3 years of accounting experience preferred, ideally within hospitality, destination management, or a related industry.

  • Working knowledge of general accounting principles, accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger processes, and financial reconciliations.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with accounting or financial management systems (such as Yardi, MRI, Investran, or similar).

  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to financial accuracy.

  • Ability to independently manage recurring accounting responsibilities and consistently meet established deadlines.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve accounting discrepancies.

  • Effective communication and collaboration skills when working with territory employees and internal stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent Financial Accuracy: Territory financial records, reconciliations, and reporting are accurate, complete, and maintained with minimal corrections or rework.

  • Timely & Reliable Execution: Month-end close activities, financial transactions, and reporting requirements are consistently completed within established deadlines.

  • Effective Problem-Solving: Accounting discrepancies are identified and addressed promptly, with appropriate escalation of complex issues or financial variances.

  • Trusted Territory Partnership: Territory employees and leadership receive responsive, knowledgeable accounting support, with clear communication and dependable follow-through.

Why Access?

We’re a women-owned, award-winning destination management company with teams in cities coast to coast. For 50+ years, we’ve been producing high-impact events and experiences for global brands—and we’re just getting started.

 

CULTURE & EXTRAS

  • Paid Sabbatical leave after 7 years of service!

 

COMPENSATION

  • Very strong performance-based quarterly commission plans

  • 401k with company match (eligible after 1 year – up to 4% of salary matched, vested immediately)

  • Monthly cell phone stipend

 

WORK LIFE BALANCE

jobs.description:
(Senior) Software Engineer (d/f/m)

Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity:

As a (Senior) Software Engineer, you’ll build core features for our flagship product, turning complex tax scenarios into simple, reliable experiences. You’ll bring a builder-first mindset: staying close to customer problems, using AI and modern engineering tools to move from idea to impact quickly, and taking ownership of outcomes—not just code.

You’ll work hands-on in a cross-functional team and bring deep expertise in either frontend or backend engineering, while collaborating effectively across the stack. You’ll help us raise the bar for scalable design, quality, maintainability, and AI-first software development.

Your responsibilities and decisions:

  • Partner with product management, design, and engineering to understand customer problems, shape pragmatic solutions, and deliver measurable outcomes.

  • Own work end to end—from discovery and technical design through implementation, release, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Turn ambiguity into action, make sound trade-offs, and deliver valuable increments without compromising long-term maintainability.

  • Contribute to technical direction and strategy in support of the long-term product vision.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools in your daily engineering work to accelerate exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high engineering standards.

  • Critically evaluate, validate, and troubleshoot AI-generated output, using effective prompting and appropriate safeguards rather than accepting results at face value.

  • Share effective AI-assisted development practices, encourage responsible experimentation, and help teammates improve how they use AI tools.

  • Improve developer experience through tools, automation, and engineering practices that enable reliable, frequent delivery.

  • Collaborate across product and platform teams, and contribute to an environment where people learn, grow, give constructive feedback, and raise challenges safely.

Your profile:

  • Professional software engineering experience (React, Node.js) and designing reliable backend services and APIs. Experience with React Native experience is a plus.

  • Able to work effectively across system boundaries and collaborate with engineers outside your primary specialism.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools in your daily engineering work to accelerate exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high engineering standards.

  • Able to evaluate and troubleshoot AI-generated output, use effective prompting where relevant, and share practical learnings with teammates.

  • Experience working with a public cloud environment such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Microsoft Azure.

  • Familiarity with DevOps concepts and practices, including CI/CD, observability, and operating software in production.

  • Understanding of core application and backend concepts such as authentication, databases, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and API integrations.

  • A builder-first, pragmatic approach: You turn customer problems into shipped outcomes. You take initiative, test and learn quickly, and make clear trade-offs between speed, quality, maintainability, and risk.

  • Passion for writing maintainable, elegant code and continuously improving how software is built.

  • A collaborative, positive attitude and a willingness to challenge ideas constructively.

  • You have a builder mindset. You thrive in environments where things are still taking shape, take initiative to move ideas forward, and find ways to create impact even when the path isn't fully defined.

  • You embrace trying things out over waiting for perfect conditions, ship early to learn fast, and treat iteration as progress.

 

Why Taxfix?

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions and yoga.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

jobs.description:
Manager/Associate Director - Project Management

About Relation

Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure.

We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact.

We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age.

By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

The opportunity

Relation is offering an outstanding opportunity for an experienced Project Manager to work in close partnership with our Programme and Project Leaders, putting you in a prime position to help shape delivery plans and drive our osteoporosis programme forward.

Working across the full discovery journey, you'll help move the programme through Target ID, Hit-to-Lead, Lead Optimisation, Candidate Selection and beyond — coordinating across the multiple projects that make up the programme, our internal interdisciplinary teams, and third-party partners such as CROs, all while navigating the ambiguity of discovery-stage science with confidence.

You'll operate at programme level, with visibility across every project within the osteoporosis programme, partnering with the Programme Leader and the Project Leaders who own each individual project. If this sounds like you, and you thrive in matrixed environments and want a real hand in shaping how tomorrow's medicines are discovered, come and join us in the heart of London.

Day to day, you will

  • Partner with Programme, Project Leaders and sponsors to understand the strategic objectives and delivery requirements across the programme.

  • Orchestrate the matrix team to deliver against project objectives, motivating all team members with clear direction and communication.

  • Work with functional leads to ensure appropriate resource allocation and to onboard supplementary resources where needed to support delivery.

  • Proactively manage plans, budgets, risks and issues across the programme, escalating to senior management when appropriate.

  • Support leadership in navigating high-impact, high-risk situations with clear analysis, high transparency and a spirit of partnership — even in the face of significant adversity or major obstacles.

  • Translate scientific and strategic objectives into integrated project plans, timelines and milestones.

  • Coordinate execution across the wet lab, ML research, data science and engineering teams, owning cross-team dependencies and prioritisation, and actively monitoring interdependencies across teams as the programme evolves.

  • Identify and manage risks across the programme, working with team leads to mitigate blockers before they affect delivery.

  • Coordinate joint governance bodies (steering committees, working groups, technical committees) — agendas, materials, minutes and follow-ups — and ensure decisions are documented and actioned.

  • Communicate status clearly to internal leadership and external partners, surfacing decisions and trade-offs as they arise.

  • Maintain project documentation, decision logs and operational hygiene to a standard that supports a multi-year, partnered effort.

  • Coordinate resource allocation and operational support across the computational and wet lab teams where required.

  • Identify and embed improvements to ways of working as the programme evolves.

Professionally, you will have

  • A degree in life sciences, project management, or a related field; advanced degree or equivalent industry experience welcome.

  • Significant Programme/Project management experience in biotech, pharma, or comparable scientific R&D settings, ideally including early-stage discovery programmes (target ID through to candidate selection), sufficient to operate as the senior Project manager for a major, multi-year effort.

  • Comfort managing a programme where scope and workstreams may evolve significantly as science matures from exploratory biology through to a defined lead series.

  • Scientific literacy sufficient to engage credibly with discussions spanning wet lab biology, single-cell omics, and machine learning, and enough grounding in the discovery pipeline (target validation, hit-to-lead, lead optimisation) to track progress and flag risk without needing to do the science yourself.

  • Familiarity with stage-gate or portfolio governance frameworks as applied to early discovery programmes (e.g. go/no-go criteria, TPP evolution, milestone-based progression).

  • Experience overseeing third-party or outsourced work packages (e.g. CROs, academic collaborators, specialist service providers) — tracking deliverables, timelines, and quality against agreed scope, and escalating issues appropriately.

  • Fluency with modern project management methodologies, artifacts and tools (e.g. MS Project, Smartsheet, Asana, Jira; Gantt, RAID logs).

  • Strong organisational skills with a record of managing complex, interdependent works treams in matrixed environments. Comfort with the operational realities of R&D projects

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to write clearly for senior external audiences.

    Bonus Experience:

  • Awareness of the discovery-to-IND pathway and its major inflection points (IND-enabling tox, CMC/formulation, DMPK, regulatory strategy) sufficient to anticipate future PM needs, even if this programme doesn't reach that stage during the role's tenure.

  • Any exposure to pre-IND regulatory interactions or translational/preclinical handover

Personally, you

  • Are comfortable working in a matrixed environment, balancing multiple stakeholders and contributing effectively across teams.

  • Take ownership of your work, proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work.

  • Communicate openly and directly, give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect.

  • Actively seek out diverse perspectives, build strong working relationships, and contribute to shared goals across teams.

  • Embrace challenges with openness and resilience, set high standards for yourself, and strive to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Working Style & Culture at Relation

At Relation, we operate in a matrixed, interdisciplinary environment, where impact is driven through collaboration across scientific, technical, and operational domains. We collaborate, and you will partner with colleagues across multiple teams and projects, contributing your expertise while aligning to shared company priorities. We work together and win together! The patient is waiting!

Chef.fe de Projet Applicatifs Hôpitaux

Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service.

En tant que Chef.fe de projet, tu piloteras des déploiements de nos solutions auprès de grands comptes, notamment des groupements hospitaliers de territoire (GHT). Tu seras le point de repère côté Lifen pour structurer le projet, donner de la visibilité aux clients et lever les obstacles avec les équipes internes.

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

  • Cartographier les établissements, les services concernés et leurs besoins pour cadrer chaque déploiement.

  • Suivre les usages après le déploiement et identifier les difficultés rencontrées sur le terrain.

  • Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe.

Must-have

  • Une bonne connaissance fonctionnelle et technique du secteur de la santé et de l’organisation d’un établissement de santé.

Nice-to-have

  • Une expérience auprès de grands comptes hospitaliers ou de groupements d’établissements de santé.

  • L’habitude de former des utilisateurs sur des outils ou processus fonctionnels.

  • Une bonne maîtrise de Notion, des outils Google ou Office et d’outils de suivi de projet.

Soft skills

Tu sais organiser ton travail sans attendre qu’on te donne chaque prochaine étape, tout en signalant rapidement les risques ou les dépendances. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement concret d’un client avant de proposer une solution. Face à des interlocuteurs aux priorités différentes, tu gardes le cap, tu reformules et tu fais avancer les décisions.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity : tu prends le temps de comprendre les contraintes d’un établissement, les dépendances techniques et les besoins des utilisateurs.

Bienveillance : tu communiques avec clarté, écoutes les difficultés et cherches des solutions avec les parties prenantes.

L’objectif est d’évaluer ta capacité à structurer un plan de déploiement, prioriser les actions et les risques, coordonner les parties prenantes et communiquer avec le client.

Head of FP&A (F/H)

At Younited, we are reinventing credit and payments to make banking simple, transparent, and inclusive. European leader in instant credit, we serve over 1 million customers and partner with major brands like Apple, N26, Bouygues Telecom. Operating in 4 countries with 500 employees, we are proud to be B Corp certified, placing social and environmental impact at the heart of our strategy.

Our mission: become the trusted financial partner for millions of Europeans by promoting transparency and financial well-being. We leverage cutting-edge technology and innovation to redefine lending and payment practices, delivering exceptional user experience.

Our solutions include credit and payment services for consumers and partners. We empower passionate problem-solvers to collaborate, innovate, and act as entrepreneurs in a fast-growing environment.

In January 2025, we reached a major milestone in our history by becoming a publicly listed company on Euronext Paris and Amsterdam.

Join us and shape the future of finance in an inclusive, dynamic, and ambitious company.

Be part of an adventure that is only beginning!

About the Finance team

The Corporate Finance team reports to the Finance Director.

The Corporate Finance team oversees the financial reporting of Younited within a regulated banking environment. Its mission is (i) to deliver accurate accounting, tax, and regulatory reporting, (ii) provide reliable performance analyses to guide strategic decisions, partnering with business units to optimize resource allocation and support key growth initiatives, and (iii) drive the continued digital transformation of the overall finance function while working closely with teams across the company.

The FP&A team is being reorganised into an end-to-end function of 4 people, including the Head of FP&A. Each FP&A controller owns both the forecast and the actuals on their scope, across the full management cycle — budget, business plan and capital plan, monthly closing anticipation, and post-closing analytics analytics.

Context 📄

Reporting directly to the Finance Director, the Head of FP&A leads the newly structured FP&A function (a team of 3 FP&A controllers). He / She owns the management cycle and the calendar, arbitrates priorities and ad hoc requests, and acts as the guardian of the method and of the single planning model. He / She is accountable for the quality of the figures and for the development of the team.

This role comes at a pivotal moment: Younited is moving to a market-standard, end-to-end FP&A organization and the Head of FP&A will be responsible for shaping his/her team target operating model, formalise scopes and ways of working, and progressively automate and strengthen the reliability of the whole planning and reporting chain — while partnering closely with the business to turn financial analysis into better decisions.

Key responsibilities 🚀

  • Build the team target operating model, define the set of FP&A procedures (scopes, calendar, controls, documentation) and make its organisation resilient by design with clear back-ups and shared standards.
  • Own the budget process, business planning and reforecasts: annual budget (build, iterations, defence), multi-year business plan and periodic reforecasts, under one method and one single model.
  • Own the monthly closing process: pre-close anticipation of closing topics so that issues are spotted before the accounts are closed, post-close analysis of variances to budget, and capital plan.
  • Deliver timely, clear financial reporting tailored to each audience — leadership, local management and business partners — including management accounts, variance analyses and ad hoc studies, and act as a business partner to the divisions on strategic initiatives and performance improvement.
  • Lead, develop and coach the FP&A team, ensuring skills development, back-up and high performance across the scope.

About you 👇

  • Seasoned finance professional with 8+ years of experience, including team management:
    • with proven experience in both FP&A / controlling and Audit / TS at a leading international firm with exposure to financial institutions, regulated environments and complex data structures,
    • with a good understanding of a market standard full management cycle — budgeting, multi-year business planning, forecasting and management reporting,
    • experienced with EPM tools is a plus,
  • Solid understanding of accounting standards and their strategic implications for financial planning and reporting (IFRS & French GAAP & regulatory),
  • A structured leader able to build method and process, set standards and drive change and continuous improvement in an evolving environment,
  • Demonstrated ability to work under tight deadlines while ensuring accuracy and reliability,
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact confidently with business partners and top management (CEO, COO, CFO) and board,
  • A proactive, hands-on and detail-oriented mindset, with strong analytical skills and a genuine commitment to team development,
  • Full professional proficiency in English and French, both written and spoken, is required.

Why makes the role so exciting 🌟

  • A rare opportunity to build and lead a market-standard end-to-end FP&A function in a listed company.
  • High autonomy and visibility: you own one of the most critical processes of the company and partners directly with Senior Management personnel of the Company.

Recruitment process 📅

  1. The process begins with an interview with Arthur, Lead Talent Acquisition Manager, to discuss the role, your motivations, and how you align with Younited's values and culture (30 min).
  2. This is followed by an interview with Arthur, Finance Director, for a discussion about the position (1h).
  3. Next, you'll have one week to prepare a technical case study on an FP&A topic (management cycle, planning and business partnering), and then present your approach during a dedicated session (1h) with Arthur and a member of the Finance team.
  4. You will then meet Rémi, BU France CEO for a conversation about the banking business (1h).
  5. Finally, the process concludes with a closing conversation with Naren, Group CFO (1h).

Account Executive (Enterprise)

About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

Every large group in Europe has bought an AI assistant, or is buying one this year. The next decision is harder: how their teams' own work runs on agents, across their own systems, governed, on top of what they already pay for. That is what Dust sells, and this role owns that decision inside a handful of France's largest groups.

You will be one of our first Strategic Account Executives. We are looking for people who have been at the top of every team they have joined, wherever they started.

The Role

  • 5 to 8 named groups, 5,000+ employees, mostly headquartered in France. You own each relationship globally, across subsidiaries and countries.

  • Some are already customers. They started with one team and grow as more teams build their own agents. Their renewals are where your account grows, and you run them.

  • The others you open. We go in through the executive who owns the group's AI programme, before any tender is written. Our founders and executives work your accounts with you, and so do the consulting firms that run these programmes.

  • Deals of €300K to €1M+ a year, decided by the executive committee, with IT, security, procurement and the business in the room.

  • You run the deal team: solutions engineers, customer success, partners and founders, brought in when you decide.

  • You write the playbook. How Dust sells to large groups is being built now, by the people in this seat.

What success looks like

  • 90 days: an account plan for each group, the owner of the AI programme identified in all of them, and a first executive meeting held in at least half.

  • 12 months: a first group-level deal signed, and one existing account growing across new teams.

Who we are looking for

  • You have been at or near the top of every team you joined. Tell us your rank in each role, and where you started. We care more about how far you have come than about the logos on the way.

  • You have opened large accounts yourself, without a big brand or an inherited list doing the work.

  • You have led a deal decided at executive level, with procurement and legal involved, and you can walk us through every step of it.

  • You have grown an account after the first deal, and you think in what an account is worth in three years.

  • You use AI in your own work. If you have built an agent, show us.

  • Fluent French and English. Based in Paris or moving here, with regular travel in France and Europe.

We do not screen on years of experience or on the size of your last employer. If you have been the best at what you did and want a bigger game, apply.

What is hard

  • Our brand is smaller than the labs'. You will win on what Dust does next to the assistant a group already chose, not on our name.

  • Large groups move slowly and decide at the top. A unit that loves the product does not make a group deal; you will learn to find the person who does.

  • The playbook is unfinished. You will be writing it while you use it.

What you get

  • OTE €180k OTE 50/50 split, uncapped accelerators, and a significant equity package in a Sequoia-backed company.

  • Founders on your accounts, a small team that decides fast, and room to lead as the Strategic team grows. We are not promising a title; we will look here first when we need one.

  • Health cover, relocation support, Paris office, regular trips to San Francisco.

How we hire

A call with Talent, a deep dive on your largest deals with the hiring manager, a live executive meeting role-play, then a half-day where you present an account plan for a group of your choice, and a conversation with a founder. We decide within [2–3] weeks of your first call.

In your application, tell us your rank on your team in each of your last roles, and one deal you are proud of.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description:
Research Engineer

Do you believe the path to general-purpose physical AI runs through noisy, real-world factory deployments?
Are you excited by the challenge of turning the classical robotic stacks into the foundational training data for physical AI?
Do you want to bridge the gap between world-class ML research and industrial-scale robotic execution?

If your answers are yes, we should talk.


At Nomagic, we are executing a humble pivot for general-purpose physical AI. We believe that physical AI is fundamentally a knowledge transfer problem - we are leveraging the "internet data" of robotics - massive deployment logs from real systems operating in production environments -  to bootstrap our efforts. We are looking for Research Engineers who will help us to build, train, and deploy foundational models that bring our fleet from a classical control stack to generalized AI mastery.


Offer essentials
  • Play with real robots, solving real problems, every day.
  • Relocation package.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • English-speaking environment.

    • Here is why we love this job ourselves, and hope you will enjoy it too:
  • We combine world-class research with top-notch engineering and apply it to solve real problems
  • The data already exists. We have robots in production at scale. We aren't waiting for datasets to be collected; the byproduct of our machines doing useful work is being created right now.
  • We measure what matters. We test our code in unit tests, simulations, and directly on real robots. Grounding our models in deployment allows us to truly measure performance.
  • High leverage, high impact. We’re still a highly focused team. If your training recipes improve our agents, you directly change the economics of the company.
  • World-class peers. Our team has built Google Warsaw, unicorn startups, led research in DeepMind, tested rocket engines, and worked at top companies like Nvidia and ByteDance. Now, we are shaping the reality of Physical AI together.
  • We are building the bridge. We aren't a new startup looking for an application; we are an established player bootstrapping physical AI. We believe that this will be the first true proof-of-concept for scaled physical AI.

    • What you will do
  • Your focus will be defined by the intersection of Robotics and ML and large-scale multimodal model training - expertise in both is optimal and alternatively eagerness to learn.
  • Expect challenges across two main pillars with the opportunity to specialise:
  • Core Research & Large-Scale Infrastructure
  • Own the Training Stack: Design, implement, and maintain the core infrastructure for large-scale VLA model training, including scheduling, distribution, job management, checkpointing, and rigorous logging.
  • Enable Rapid Iteration: Build the critical tools and abstractions necessary for launching, monitoring, debugging, and seamlessly reproducing complex, multi-variant experiments.
  • Train from Deployment Logs: Utilize our massive repository of offline, classical stack data to pre-train robust robot foundation models.
  • Drive the Software Feedback Loop: Translate core research needs into concrete infra capabilities, track experiments, analyze results, and close the loop directly with ML researchers to unblock model progress
  • Real-World Evaluation & Operations
  • Design Physical Benchmarks: Design new robotic tasks and build lightweight physical setups to systematically evaluate model capabilities far beyond the limits of simulation.
  • Execute Structured Evaluations: Ensure robots are properly configured, calibrated, and ready for rollouts. You will coordinate data collection efforts and run structured, on-robot evaluations to measure real-world success rates.
  • Close the Physical Feedback Loop: Analyze real-world evaluation results to guide the ML research direction. You will identify operational bottlenecks across software, hardware, and deployment systems to continuously improve our iteration speed.
  • Scale the Workflows: Beta test internal and third-party tools for teaching robots new skills, and write clear, structured documentation so the broader team can reproduce your workflows and scale your impact.

    • What skills we’d like you to have:

  • Experience: Deep experience and understanding at the intersection of machine learning, systems engineering, and robotics.

  • Proven Track Record: Experience training, fine-tuning, and deploying modern deep learning architectures (Transformers, VLMs or VLAs, Imitation Learning, RL) for robot control, ideally with policies validated on real hardware.

  • Engineering Excellence: Strong software engineering and infrastructure skills. You are highly proficient in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch/JAX) and can write clean, scalable code for training and evaluation.

  • Robotics Intuition: Comfort working hands-on with hardware. You understand the robotics full stack (perception, controls, state estimation) and how to debug failures when software meets the physical world.

  • Pragmatic Research Mindset: You possess the ability to move seamlessly between research and implementation. You prefer execution, iteration speed, and real-world robustness over theoretical purity.

    • What should you expect once you apply?  

    • A phone screen with the hiring manager to discuss your background and our technical direction.
    • A half-day of on-sites (cultural fit & deep-dive technical interviews).
    • A final decision made within 2-3 days after the on-site interview.
    • Important: Expect detailed, honest feedback after completing the process, regardless of our decision.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - Robotics Platform
jobs.description:
Software Engineer Intern - Robotics Platform

Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  


About the role

At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators superhuman capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. We ensure all algorithms execute correctly, based on a rock solid communication layer and world class introspection capabilities. We provide all the tools to deploy, develop and debug the most powerful robots on earth.

As a robotics platform software engineer intern, you will help build our vision of a scalable, safe and high performing robotics platform. You will  gather requirements from internal customers, work on communication layer, node orchestration and lifecycle management as well as APIs to off-machine systems.


What you'll do

  • Design, build and maintain parts of the robotics platform, e.g. APIs, health monitoring and machine configuration management

  • Contributing to high quality code, improving robustness and maintainability of existing code


    • What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • Hands-on experience in Software Engineering

  • Solid Software Engineering skills

  • Programming skills in a systems language like C++ or Rust, Python is nice to have


    • Bonus qualifications

    Don't meet every requirement? We still want to hear from you. These are nice-to-haves, not dealbreakers:

  • Experience in computer networking

  • Experience in information security

  • Experience working with embedded systems

  • Experience working on production grade software system

  • Open source contributions

jobs.title: Cell Culture Engineer
jobs.description:
Cell Culture Engineer

Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

We're expanding our protein expression into mammalian cell culture, for example in CHO and HEK cells. Our mammalian expression volume is growing fast. We're looking for a Cell Culture Engineer who has spent years growing and transfecting mammalian cells and knows what to do when a run goes wrong.

You'll work alongside our production and mammalian cell teams as a hands-on expert in the cell culture lab. You'll keep cultures healthy and on schedule, run transfections and expressions, and be the person the team turns to when yields drop or cells misbehave. This is a hands-on role, not a management role.

What You'll Do

  • Run mammalian expression. Maintain, expand, and passage cell lines, and run transfections and expressions on a production schedule.

  • Troubleshoot. When viability, growth, or yield falls off, find the cause and fix it.

  • Own the cell bank. Thaw, freeze, and track cell stocks, and protect the lines from contamination and drift.

  • Optimize conditions. Test culture and transfection conditions, and turn what works into the standard protocol.

  • Scale with automation. Work with our automation team to move cell handling onto liquid handlers as volume grows.

  • Hand off clean material. Deliver harvests ready for purification and downstream assays.

  • Keep the lab running. Look after incubators, biosafety cabinets, and cell counters, and keep the BSL-2 space organized and compliant.

  • Write SOPs and train. Document protocols that others can follow, and train the team on aseptic technique and our cell culture workflows.

What We're Looking For

  • Extensive hands-on experience with common mammalian model cell lines, for example CHO and HEK, including transfection and expression.

  • BSc / MSc in biotechnology, cell biology, or a relevant field.

  • A troubleshooting track record. You've rescued failing cultures and expressions and can explain what went wrong and why.

  • Flawless aseptic technique and experience working under BSL-2 conditions.

  • Experience with high-throughput formats: multi-well plates and many conditions in parallel, not only flasks.

  • Experience with liquid handlers is a plus.

  • Experience with antibody or Fc-fusion production is a plus.

  • Organized and precise. You track every stock, passage, and transfection, and you follow protocols exactly.

  • You use AI tools effectively and with discernment. We use them across the company and expect you to check, edit, and stand behind what they produce, not pass along unreviewed output.

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift. Cells don't keep office hours, so you plan around them.

Application deadline
