jobs.title: Strategy Intern (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Strategy Intern (f/m/d)

At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

We are scaling fast and investing heavily in our product, our clients and our international footprint. We are looking for a Strategy Intern to join our Strategy team and help us shape what comes next.

About the role:

As Strategy Intern, you will join our Strategy team, working directly with our Head of Strategy, Tine von Villiez, and our wider leadership team, including our CEO and Founder, Martin Kassing. You will support Upvest's most important strategic work, from high-stakes leadership and board meetings to initiatives such as market expansion and new products. You will own your own work packages, working independently and cross-functionally, with direct exposure to senior leadership. This is a high-impact, highly visible role and a great way to learn how a fast-growing fintech is run, with a deep look into our product, clients, operations and the banking ecosystem.

What you’ll do:

  • Support high-stakes internal projects: Help the team prepare and run all-hands, leadership offsites and presentations, and board meetings

  • Support strategic initiatives: Contribute to high-impact strategic initiatives, such as market expansion or new products, from research and analysis to preparing recommendations and materials to the actual execution and project management

  • Support the OKR process: Help run the company OKRs, link them to core business KPIs and support cross-team prioritisation

  • Own your work packages: Take ownership of your own work packages, working independently and cross-functionally to deliver them

  • Become an AI champion: Learn and adapt to new AI tools, and help upskill the organisation by sharing what works

What you bring:

  • Experience: You have already completed 1-2 internships in highly dynamic environments, ideally in consulting or at other fintechs or high-growth scale-ups

  • Business acumen: You have high business acumen and quickly understand how a business works and what drives it. You break down complex problems into actionable insights and measurable outcomes, and care about the details to ensure flawless execution

  • Curiosity and drive: You are curious, highly motivated and eager to learn across the board. You are proactive and happy to support on different projects. You are passionate about fintech and the mission of empowering more people to invest

  • AI-native: You use AI tools proactively in your day-to-day work (synthesis, research, reporting) and are always looking for smarter, faster ways of working

  • Communication and stakeholder management: You communicate clearly and confidently and enjoy working with colleagues at all levels, including senior leadership

  • Team player: You are open, collaborative and a cultural ambassador who lives our values

  • Location and availability: You are based in Berlin and available for a minimum of 4 months

How we Upvest in you:

  • Impact-driven work: We're working on solving a hard problem: fixing the European investment infrastructure so that more people are able to invest. You have the opportunity to contribute to this change.

Working in the complex yet fascinating world of investments, with an API product built on a state-of-the-art tech stack and alongside leading fintechs and financial institutions, offers an incredibly rewarding learning experience.

  • Flexibility: While we're not quite fully remote, we are committed to being a flexible employer, as we understand you don't have to be in the office to do your best work. This role is based in Berlin.

Our Values:

Hi, we’re AMBOSS and we’re searching for a Copy Editor to join our team of English language experts for 14-18 months and help shape the language that medical professionals around the world rely on.

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we’ve grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

Your work will shape the language that medical students, clinicians, and educators rely on, from exam prep to the point of care. You’ll edit articles and Qbanks for different markets and work side by side with our medical editors. Together, you’ll keep our content clear, correct, and consistent as it grows. You’ll also build and test AI tools and prompts that raise the language quality of everything we publish. If you love both the art of language and the language of medicine, we’d be delighted to meet you.

You will:

  • Copyedit AMBOSS articles following our in-house style guide (based on the AMA Manual of Style), keeping content clear, correct, concise, and consistent

You enjoy:

jobs.title: Tech Lead
jobs.description:
Tech Lead

We’re on a mission to protect society from fraud and money laundering. We’ve already protected over 3 million people through life’s big transactions.

Fraud and regulation are rising, costing the UK economy over £100bn every year; this makes it more difficult for businesses to protect themselves and their clients - individuals like you and me - from fraud and money laundering.

Our co-founders Olly and Jack were led to this area when a friend was defrauded of £25K when buying their first property. At the time, anti-fraud technology didn’t exist, which meant that completing the anti-fraud checks required in these processes was largely manual. These big life moments should be exciting, but instead are often confusing and scary due to the painful process of completing these paper-based checks and the risk of fraud.

Thirdfort helps businesses to facilitate these anti fraud checks so that individuals know they can transact safely and seamlessly with professionals during these big transactions. Our anti-fraud platform provides a secure way for professionals in regulated sectors like Lawyers, Estate Agents and Accountants to transfer funds and verify sensitive information through app based document checks, facial recognition and open banking.

Over 1,500 businesses now trust Thirdfort to verify their clients. We are FCA regulated and have raised over \$33m in capital from leading Fintech investors Breega and Element Ventures, as well as the founders of Zoopla, Funding Circle, Comply Advantage, Tessian, Fenergo and Fidel.

 

About the role:

We’re looking for a Tech Lead (IC4) to join one of our product teams and provide strong technical leadership.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager (F/H)
jobs.description:
Product Marketing Manager (F/H)
At Younited, we believe credit and banking should feel as simple, fast and transparent as everything else in your digital life.

So we build financial services that way. We combine technology, data and automation to rethink the way people borrow, pay, save and manage their money.

Today, more than 1.5 million customers trust us, and nearly 500 employees contribute to our growth across 4 European countries.

What we build

    • Younited Credit – instant consumer credit, directly accessible to customers.
    • Younited Pay – instalment payment and financing solutions embedded into our partners' customer journeys.
    • Younited Cashback – cashback and personalised offers, enhanced by open banking data.
    • Younited Bank – our everyday banking offering, currently available through helios by Younited and being expanded.
Our ambition is to build a financial partner people genuinely trust, combining simplicity, transparency and responsible finance. As a certified B Corp, we integrate social and environmental considerations into the way we build our business.
 

The 5 values we work by

    • Make it simple - in the product, in the customer experience and in how we organise. Be transparent.
    • Act as an entrepreneur - take ownership, play as a team, dare to try and accept failure.
    • Innovate or die - challenge the status quo, however impossible it may seem.
    • Faster is better - speed over perfection, alignment over debate.
    • No limit - shoot for the moon, stay humble.
We give passionate problem-solvers the space to do their best work in diverse and inclusive teams across Europe, because that is how we build better financial products for our customers and partners.

Context 📄

How do you turn complex credit and payment products into propositions that customers understand, partners value and teams can sell?

As Product Marketing Manager at Younited, you will shape the insights, narratives and tools that help our products stand out and grow. You will work across Younited’s product portfolio, with Younited Pay as your initial priority given its strategic importance and the competitiveness of its market.

Within Marketing Central, you will join the Customer Engagement team and work with Product, Sales, Partnerships, Data, Brand & Communications and local marketing teams. Depending on business priorities, your scope may evolve across different Younited products, audiences and customer journeys.

Your mission will be to understand the audiences we want to reach, clarify what makes our products valuable and turn market, customer and field feedback into concrete recommendations for Sales, Partnerships, Product and Marketing. You will connect market reality, commercial priorities and product decisions by turning research, customer insights and field feedback into clear messages, useful tools and actionable recommendations. You will also work closely with the PRM/CRM teams to connect these insights with customer journeys, engagement and retention initiatives.

Key responsibilities 🚀

1) Build market and customer understanding

  • Conduct market research, competitive analysis and customer data analysis to identify target audiences, understand their needs, uncover opportunities and bring the voice of the customer into business and product decisions.

  • Work across several products, audiences and business priorities, with Younited Pay as the initial priority.

  • Work with the PRM/CRM and Customer Engagement teams on segmentation, use cases and customer journeys across acquisition, activation, repeat usage and retention, including merchant onboarding for Younited Pay and other priority journeys across the Younited portfolio.

2) Define positioning and support commercial teams

  • Clarify the benefits, differentiators and key messages of Younited products, making complex topics compelling and easy to understand for customers, merchants, partners and internal teams.

  • Turn market and customer insights into sales pitches, presentations, enablement materials, partner tools and practical recommendations that help Sales and Partnerships teams explain and sell our products.

  • Contribute to strategic RFPs by understanding requirements and shaping the response narrative, value proposition, differentiators, proof points and presentation materials.

3) Partner with Product teams and support product evolutions

  • Bring market feedback and customer insights into product discussions and roadmaps, and influence product decisions based on market and customer feedback.

  • Support product launches and evolutions with the necessary materials, including demos, training materials, operational guides, FAQs and sales enablement documents.

  • Work across Product, Sales, Partnerships, Data, Brand & Communications and local marketing teams to turn insights into clear messages, useful tools and actionable recommendations.

About you 👇

  • You have at least 5 years of experience in B2B Product Marketing, Product Marketing or a related role.

  • You know how to conduct market research, analyse competition and turn customer and market insights into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • You are comfortable working across several products, audiences and business priorities.

  • You understand Sales and Partnerships teams’ challenges and know how to create useful, practical materials that support commercial teams.

  • You are comfortable contributing to strategic RFPs and tailoring a value proposition to different business and partner contexts.

  • You are comfortable working with Product teams and influencing product decisions based on market and customer feedback.

  • Experience in payments, banking, credit, fintech, e-commerce or another complex or regulated industry is a plus.

  • You know how to make complex topics simple and compelling, both in writing and verbally.

  • You are fluent in French and English.

  • You are autonomous, structured, proactive and able to manage several projects in parallel.

  • You know how to adapt your approach to different audiences and switch between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

  • You know how to influence stakeholders without relying on hierarchical authority and deliver concrete results.

Hiring process 📅

  • First video interview with Arthur, Lead Talent Acquisition Manager, to discuss the role, your motivations and Younited.

  • Second interview with Lise, Head of Customer Engagement, to explore the expectations of the role in greater depth.

  • Business case, followed by a debrief and conversations with members of the team.

  • Final interview with Ricardo, Growth & Business Operations Director, to validate overall alignment with the role and potential development opportunities.


🎁 Other benefits from joining Younited ?

  • Offices located in the heart of Paris (9th arrondissement)
  • An international work environment and the opportunity to go on assignments in our offices abroad (Barcelona, Lisbon, Rome)
  • An entrepreneurial mindset and strong team spirit
  • Personalized managerial and HR support during onboarding and throughout your Younited journey
  • A continuous learning environment with access to internal and external training, an e-learning platform, and “Friday workshops” within the Tech team to support everyone’s development
  • A strong focus on work-life balance
  • A parenthood charter to support all family-related projects, with key measures
  • Special leave for major life events, often more generous than legal requirements
  • An hybrid remote work policy: 2 to 3 days of remote work per week depending on the team, and the option to work fully remotely for one week twice a year
  • 33 days paid holiday, i.e. 8 more than the statutory 25 days (instead of the traditional RTT)
  • Access to the Wellpass platform (formerly Gymlib) with over 4,000 fitness and wellness activities across France at a discounted rate
  • Meal vouchers (€10 per day, 60% covered by the company)
  • Team buildings in France (Summer Party & Winter Party), abroad, and within your team
 
Younited is an Equal Opportunity Employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation.

Nos sièges de Paris et d’Amsterdam accueillent une équipe diversifiée et motivée de membres de la famille KARL venant de plus de 35 pays différents. Ensemble, nous visons à créer des histoires pleines de sens ainsi que des concepts de produit liés au monde et aux attributs emblématiques de Karl.
 
Le prêt à porter pour femme, les sacs, la petite maroquinerie et les sous-vêtements sont gérés directement depuis notre siège d’Amsterdam, tandis que d’autres catégories, incluant le prêt à porter pour homme, les parfums, la lunetterie et autres, sont développés avec les meilleurs partenaires de licence de leur catégorie. La récente ligne KARL LAGERFELD JEANS est de la même manière gérée en dehors de notre siège d’Amsterdam et est notre gamme connaissant la croissance la plus rapide.

Vision

En tant que fournisseur de logiciels SaaS, DiliTrust est une entreprise mondiale dédiée à offrir une suite intégrée de solutions juridiques et de gouvernance. Notre vision est de digitaliser les directions juridiques à travers le monde et de devenir un leader mondial de la Legal Tech.

DiliTrust est à l’avant-garde de l’innovation en Legal Tech et s’attache à offrir un environnement de travail positif, entrepreneurial et stimulant.

Votre mission sera de donner davantage de visibilité à l’équipe sur la performance et la santé du portefeuille clients, tout en participant à la construction de l’organisation Customer Success de demain. Les analyses, tableaux de bord et processus que vous développerez auront un impact direct sur les décisions de l’équipe et sur le suivi de nos clients.

  • Contribuer à la qualité et à la fiabilité des données HubSpot : comptes, propriétaires, fiches entreprises et informations relatives au suivi client.

jobs.title: Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor
jobs.description:
Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor

We are currently looking for an experienced Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor to join an international financial services environment and contribute to strengthening its technology, cybersecurity and risk management landscape.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise with a strong understanding of governance, risk and controls. You will take ownership of complex audit engagements, challenge existing practices and provide independent insights that support informed decision-making at senior management level.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically experienced professional who enjoys investigating complex IT environments, identifying potential vulnerabilities and making a meaningful impact on the organisation’s security and resilience.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Plan, lead and deliver comprehensive IT audit engagements based on a risk-oriented approach, including the development of audit strategies and testing procedures.

  • Review and evaluate technology-related risk areas, including cybersecurity, IT governance, infrastructure, network security, access management, data protection, operational resilience and emerging technologies.

  • Apply your technical background to analyse complex IT architectures, identify potential weaknesses and assess the effectiveness of existing security measures and internal controls.

  • Review findings from penetration tests, vulnerability scans, security assessments and monitoring activities, translating technical observations into relevant risk insights.

  • Assess emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence and AI-driven solutions, and evaluate their implications for cybersecurity, governance and technology risk.

  • Present audit findings, recommendations and risk assessments to relevant stakeholders, including senior management and executive-level decision-makers.

  • Prepare structured and impactful audit documentation, ensuring that identified issues are clearly communicated and actionable.

  • Track remediation activities and evaluate the effectiveness of implemented measures.

  • Work closely with colleagues across IT, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Governance and Business functions to promote continuous improvement and strengthen the overall control environment.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a comparable discipline, alternatively equivalent professional experience.

  • At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in IT, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Technology Risk or a related technical field.

  • Strong practical knowledge of several core technology and security domains, such as Network Security, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management, Security Operations or IT Resilience.

  • Experience working with technical security assessments, penetration testing results, vulnerability scanning solutions or comparable security tools.

  • Previous exposure to IT Audit, Internal Audit, External Audit, Technology Risk or another assurance-related function is highly desirable.

  • Professional certifications such as CISA, CISM, CISSP or equivalent qualifications are considered an advantage.

  • Interest in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning and AI-driven technologies, particularly in relation to security, governance and risk management. Practical experience in AI governance or AI-based solutions is beneficial.

  • Strong analytical capabilities, a structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to assess complex technical information independently.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge established practices constructively and engage with senior decision-makers.

  • High professional integrity, sound judgement and a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Fluent English is required. German and/or French language skills are an additional advantage.

  • Willingness to undertake international business travel, approximately 20 days or more annually.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager LogicSteel
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager LogicSteel

Senior Product Manager LogicSteel Ben jij een ondernemende Product Manager die kansen ziet waar anderen ze nog niet zien? Krijg jij energie van het doorgronden van complexe productieprocessen en weet je deze te vertalen naar slimme, innovatieve softwareoplossingen? Wil jij de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, richting te geven aan productontwikkeling en écht impact te maken binnen een internationale, dynamische organisatie? Dan is dit jouw kans!

 

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Product Manager LogicSteel ben jij dé drijvende kracht achter het doorgronden van productieprocessen en het vertalen daarvan naar slimme oplossingen binnen LogicSteel. LogicSteel is ons cloud-based software platform voor de staalverwerkende industrie. Middels LogicSteel wordt de ontwerpfase, werkvoorbereiding en productie naadloos met elkaar verbonden. Wat kunnen klanten uit LogicSteel halen? Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het automatisch plannen en inkopen van al het materiaal voor productie, het optimaliseren van het proces voor nesting op basis van voorraad en beschikbaarheid, het realtime volgen van het volledige productieproces én het aansturen van onze machines.

 

In deze sleutelrol duik jij in de productieprocessen van staalbouwers. Je kijkt verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk, staat dicht bij de klant en verdiept je in de stappen en randvoorwaarden voor hun productieproces. Door regelmatig klanten in binnen- en buitenland te bezoeken, krijg je scherp inzicht in de productieprocessen, knelpunten en kansen voor optimalisatie. Hierbij doorgrond je welke stappen bepalend zijn, welke beperkingen een limitatie vormen en waar liggen kansen om slimmer te werken? Deze inzichten vertaal je naar generieke, herbruikbare product-capabilities die in verschillende processen waarde toevoegen – van 3D-modeling tot machinebewegingen. Vervolgens werk je initiatieven uit tot concrete productrequirements waarmee Product Owners aan de slag kunnen. Hierbij werk je intensief samen met multidisciplinaire teams om te zorgen dat software, processen en machines naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. In deze rol houd je continu grip op de voortgang, kwaliteit en impact van LogicSteel-oplossingen, en stuur je waar nodig bij om het beste resultaat te behalen.

 

Maar dat is nog niet alles. Als Product Manager LogicSteel bewaak jij de samenhang binnen het platform. Je zorgt ervoor dat processen, knelpunten, afhankelijkheden en product-capabilities goed worden vastgelegd en gecommuniceerd, zodat Product Owners, engineering en consultancy vanuit hetzelfde beeld werken. Je communiceert helder over de gemaakte keuzes, stemt af met betrokken teams en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een samenhangend LogicSteel-platform. Daarnaast draag je actief bij aan productintroducties en de doorontwikkeling van onze software-oplossingen.

 

Samenvattend bestaan jouw verantwoordelijkheden uit het:

  • doorgronden en structureren van complexe productieprocessen bij staalverwerkende organisaties;

  • bezoeken van (internationale) klanten om processen te begrijpen en nieuwe kansen te identificeren;

  • vertalen van pijnpunten en klanbehoeften naar generieke herbruikbare product-capabilities, van 3D modeling tot machinebewegingen;

  • identificeren waar vergelijkbare capabilities in verschillende processen kunnen worden toegepast;

  • bepalen welke functionaliteiten en innovaties worden ontwikkeld;

  • opstellen van een helder werkpakket met productrequirements voor de Product Owners en het bewaken van de voortgang;

  • intensief samenwerken met Product Owners, Engineers en Consultants om software, processen en machines optimaal op elkaar te laten aansluiten;

  • bewaken van de samenhang binnen LogicSteel en het consistent vastleggen van klantprocessen, knelpunten en capabilities;

  • bijdragen aan succesvolle productintroducties en doorontwikkeling.

 

Wat maakt deze functie zo bijzonder?

“Je bent een ondernemer binnen onze onderneming”, aldus collega Luc. Jij verdiept je in de productieprocessen van staalbouwers en ontdekt waar complexe stappen, beperkingen en afhankelijkheden om slimme oplossingen vragen. Je weet die processen te doorgronden en te vertalen naar herbruikbare capabilities die niet alleen één klant helpen, maar binnen het gehele LogicSteel-platform van waarde zijn. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met verschillende disciplines en bouw je dagelijks aan oplossingen die er écht toe doen!

 

Warm en professioneel bad

Bij ons werk je niet zomaar voor een bedrijf, maar voor een familiebedrijf waar mensen centraal staan. Je merkt het in alles: de korte lijnen, de betrokkenheid en de ruimte om zelf initiatief te nemen. Ondernemerschap zit in het DNA van de organisatie. Heb je een goed idee? Dan krijg je de vrijheid en het vertrouwen om dit verder te brengen en écht impact te maken.

 

Daarnaast kennen we elkaar, nemen we verantwoordelijkheid en staan we voor elkaar klaar. Dat zie je terug in de manier waarop we samenwerken: teams trekken veel met elkaar op, denken over domeinen heen en zoeken actief de verbinding. Die open en ondersteunende houding zorgt niet alleen voor sterke resultaten, maar ook voor een werksfeer waarin je je snel thuis voelt. Zoals een collega het mooi zegt: “Doordat we er voor elkaar zijn, kunnen we kwaliteit leveren én zorgen we voor een prettige werksfeer – met ruimte voor een gezonde dosis humor en gezelligheid.”

 

Tegelijkertijd is er veel aandacht voor jouw persoonlijke groei. We kijken naar talent, potentie en kwaliteit, en bieden ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en stappen te zetten. Of zoals collega Luc het verwoordt: “Ik ben als stagiaire begonnen en heb de kans gekregen om door te groeien tot eindverantwoordelijke voor de business unit LogicSteel. Kortom, binnen ons bedrijf is veel mogelijk.”

 

Wij vragen

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in Industrial Engineering & Management / Technische Bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Software Engineering, Business IT & Management of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Relevante werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie;

  • Het vermogen om complexe (productie)processen te ontrafelen, te structureren en inzichtelijk te maken;

  • Een sterk abstractievermogen en het talent om generieke capabilities te herkennen die ook in andere processen bruikbaar zijn;

  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om processen en afhankelijkheden te vertalen naar heldere, concrete productrequirements;

  • Het vermogen om de samenhang tussen verschillende onderdelen van een softwareplatform te overzien en te bewaken;

  • Het talent om overzicht te behouden omtrent de productontwikkeling;

  • Het vermogen om helder af te stemmen, intern draagvlak te creëren en effectief samen te werken met Product Owners, engineers en consultants;

  • Kennis van productieprocessen in de staalbouw, werkvoorbereiding en/of calculatie is een sterke pre;

  • Een nieuwsgierige, proactieve mindset en de drive om complexe processen steeds slimmer in te richten;

  • Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal;

 

Wij bieden

  • Een brutosalaris tussen €5.301 en €7.460 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 40 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband;

  • Flexibele werktijden voor een goede werk-privébalans;

  • Een sleutelrol in het realiseren van onze commerciële productstrategie met internationale impact;

  • Werken in een moderne omgeving op onze Voortman Campus in Rijssen;

  • Ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatieven binnen een ambitieus team;

  • Dagelijks een heerlijke lunch in bedrijfsrestaurant Steely’s;

  • Uitstekende doorgroeimogelijkheden en ontwikkelkansen.

As we expand across Europe, our Latvian subsidiary, licensed as a European Crowdfunding Service Provider by the Bank of Latvia, plays a critical role. Our stack combines regulated financial infrastructure with modern software engineering. The gap between those two things is exactly where this role lives.

The Role

We're looking for a Platform Engineer who wants to own the infrastructure that makes everything else possible. You'll build and maintain the systems our engineering teams rely on every day — CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, data tooling, AI integrations, and developer experience as a whole. jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst

Senior Data Analyst

Your mission

We're a small data team with a big job: helping everyone at Cosuno make better decisions. Our data platform is stable and in good hands. What we need now is someone who takes our most important, open-ended business questions and answers them properly: in depth, with little guidance, and often before anyone thought to ask.

You'll work across product and commercial topics. How do general contractors and subcontractors actually use our platform? What makes some accounts grow into company-wide rollouts? Which levers move our funnel the most? You'll work closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success and leadership, and we expect you to have opinions.

In your first few months, you might:

  • Work out what drives account growth: which behaviours predict long-term retention and expansion, and how Sales and Customer Success can act on them.

  • Map how our customers really use the product: which workflows stick, where new features find their audience, and what healthy adoption looks like in an account's first months.

  • Pick a question nobody has asked yet, answer it, and change a product or go-to-market decision with the result.

  • Build the dbt models and Looker views your analyses need, so the next person can answer the question themselves.

How we work

  • Questions Over Tickets: You don't wait for requests. You figure out what matters and go after it.

  • Depth Over Dashboards: One analysis that changes a decision beats ten reports nobody reads.

  • Pragmatic by Default: Simple processes, fast iterations, and the lightest method that gives a trustworthy answer.

  • Clarity Wins: A finding is only as good as how well others understand it and act on it.

  • AI-Native by Default: We work heavily with Claude Code and other AI tools and expect everyone to use them fluently.

Your profile

  • 5+ years in analytics at fast-growing startups or scaleups, ideally B2B SaaS, where your work shaped product or commercial decisions.

  • An exceptional ability to reason through ambiguous business problems: framing the right question, choosing a sound approach, and landing on a clear recommendation.

  • Hands-on experience in both product analytics (usage, adoption, engagement, experimentation) and commercial analytics (retention, expansion, funnel, pricing).

  • A track record of driving your own analytical agenda with minimal guidance.

  • Strong SQL and professional experience with dbt and a BI tool (a strong command of Looker is a big plus). You build the models and views you need instead of waiting for them.

Corporate Counsel
jobs.description:
Corporate Counsel

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

As Corporate Counsel, you’ll support Airwallex’s growth in the UK by providing practical, business-focused legal advice on corporate, regulatory and commercial matters. You’ll work closely with Corporate Development on strategic transactions such as fundraising and M&A, partner with UK and regional leaders on new-market entry, support licence expansion, and help align Airwallex’s global policies and governance with UK and relevant EMEA requirements. You’ll also advise on marketing, referral and partnership initiatives, helping the business move quickly while managing legal and regulatory risk.

  • Provide clear, pragmatic advice on UK and relevant EMEA legal and regulatory requirements, helping teams navigate applicable rules while enabling responsible growth.

  • Support Corporate Development on fundraising rounds and strategic transactions, including due diligence, data rooms, corporate approvals, investment documentation, cap table changes and ongoing governance.

  • Partner with the business, Regulatory Legal and Regulatory Compliance teams on expansion into and launches in new markets across the UK and EMEA, including regulatory mapping, entity and licensing considerations, and corporate governance requirements.

  • Align Airwallex’s policies, procedures and corporate governance frameworks across jurisdictions, with particular focus on UK requirements.

  • Draft, review and negotiate referral agreements, marketing and sponsorship agreements, and other commercial arrangements, ensuring risks are appropriately managed and documented.

  • Advise on marketing, advertising and promotions, including claims, disclosures, digital campaigns, co-marketing and referral programmes, while supporting the review of customer-facing materials for legal and regulatory compliance.

  • Coordinate and manage outside counsel on specialised matters in the UK and across EMEA, ensuring advice is high-quality, cost-effective and aligned to Airwallex’s risk appetite and business goals.

  • Use technology and AI-enabled tools, including templates, playbooks, contract lifecycle tools and knowledge bases, to increase the speed, consistency and quality of legal work.

You’ll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • Qualification as a solicitor or barrister in England and Wales, or an equivalent qualification in another UK jurisdiction, and in good standing with the relevant professional body.

  • Proven experience in financial services and corporate law, preferably gained at a fast-growing technology or fintech company and/or a top-tier law firm.

  • Demonstrated interest in financial services regulation and the fintech industry, with willingness to go deep on payments, e-money, money services and related regulatory topics in the UK and EMEA.

  • In-depth knowledge of, or strong familiarity with, the UK legal and business environment, including how UK legislation, FCA requirements and cross-border rules impact fintech and payments businesses.

  • Proven experience drafting and negotiating corporate and commercial agreements, with strong written and verbal communication skills that make complex issues clear to non-lawyers.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Corporate Development, Finance, Product, Compliance, Risk and Marketing, across time zones.

  • Demonstrated capability in managing and leading outside counsel, including scoping work, controlling costs and consolidating advice into clear recommendations.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a practical, business-oriented approach and comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting fundraising transactions, M&A or strategic investments, including due diligence and deal execution, ideally in a technology or fintech context.

  • Prior in-house experience in a fintech, payments or broader financial services company, particularly one operating across the UK and multiple EMEA jurisdictions.

  • Experience advising on legal issues related to marketing, advertising and promotions, including digital marketing, performance marketing, referral programmes and brand partnerships.

  • Exposure to UK financial services regulatory frameworks, including the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000, the Payment Services Regulations 2017, the Electronic Money Regulations 2011, FCA rules and guidance, and applicable financial promotions requirements.

  • Experience partnering with Regulatory Legal, Regulatory Compliance or licensing teams on market expansion initiatives and regulatory change.

  • Comfort using technology, AI and legal operations tools to increase the speed and quality of legal work, for example playbooks, templates, contract lifecycle tools or knowledge bases.

You'll thrive here if

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You have experience at a fintech, payments company, or other highly regulated business.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

Learn more about your team

Legal sits at the heart of the decisions that shape how Airwallex grows. This team backs the builders transforming us into a generational financial company, working alongside product, sales, and business partners every step of the way. You'll help shape a global licensing footprint most fintechs wish they had, while keeping our brand and data architecture best-in-class for customers entering the agentic economy and its regulatory demands. The hard part is helping the business move fast on product, revenue, and new-market expansion without compromising the discipline that protects the moat.

It's a team for lawyers, strategists, and licensing specialists with commercial instincts, sharp judgment, and an obsession with customer-first outcomes. If you want to guide executive decisions and help build the licensing, structure, and judgment behind what comes next, this is where legal has real leverage.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Advisory Data Architect
jobs.description:
Advisory Data Architect

About Unity Advisory

Unity Advisory is a modern advisory business built for today's CFO, with connected solutions across finance, deals and tax. Focussed on client outcomes, seasoned experts lead every engagement, in an operating model powered by AI and free from audit conflict.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Advisory Data Architect to own data design across our advisory engagements. This is a platform and design-authority role with a hands-on edge, combining finance-focused business understanding with modern data architecture, platforms and governance. You will define how data - across a client’s business - is structured, governed, and served so that AI, analytics, and management reporting are reliable and scalable. As a Senior Manager, you will lead architecture decisions, guide engineers, shape client data strategy, architecture, governance, and be accountable for the coherence and quality of the data estate you design.

This is a client-facing role within our AI Advisory team, setting the data architecture that our engagements — and our clients' AI ambitions — are built on.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define target-state data architectures for clients — models, storage, pipelines, and access patterns — balancing rigour with delivery realism.

  • Establish data modelling standards and curated domain layers across the a variety of systems (e.g. ERP, CRM, Manufacturing) and data sources, with end-to-end lineage and provenance sufficient for audit and controls.

  • Map and integrate finance source systems (ERP, EPM, sub-ledgers, and consolidation tools) into governed, analytics-ready models.

  • Design the finance data foundations for applied AI/ML: governed retrieval sources for RAG, feature stores, and the architecture that keeps AI systems fed with trustworthy, reconciled finance data.

  • Set patterns for secure, compliant finance data platforms — access control, data sensitivity, segregation of duties, isolation, and alignment to standards such as ISO 27001.

  • Provide architectural direction for cloud data platforms, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and observability, ensuring designs are cost-aware and operable.

  • Define the data lineage and controls that support responsible production AI — monitoring, confidence scoring, and human-in-the-loop review.

  • Translate ambiguous business and client problems into clear architectural decisions and scoped roadmaps under delivery pressure.

  • Own key technical trade-offs and communicate them clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and senior client sponsors.

  • Mentor data engineers, raise the technical bar across the team, and contribute reusable patterns, reference architectures, and accelerators.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Significant experience designing and delivering data architectures for production systems, with evidence that your designs have shipped and run - not remained on paper.

  • Deep expertise in data modelling, warehouse/lakehouse design, and data governance.

  • Hands-on background in SQL and Python, and fluency with at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Azure) and modern data platforms (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks).

  • System-level judgement on how data architecture shapes AI outcomes: designing governed sources for RAG, structuring data for retrieval and orchestration, and deciding where structured outputs and tool use fit.

  • Ability to set standards and lead engineers while remaining close to implementation.

  • Strong stakeholder skills, including engaging senior client sponsors and explaining architectural trade-offs clearly.

Strong Preference

  • Experience architecting the data layer behind AI or analytics products in production.

  • Informed views on the trade-offs between fine-tuning, RAG, and long-context approaches, and how each changes data architecture requirements, including context window economics and prompt caching.

  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and observability for data platforms.

  • Awareness of MCP and tool-orchestration concepts and their implications for composable, data-driven AI systems.

  • Fluent use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor), with a clear view of where they help and where human design judgement must lead.

  • Security and compliance experience (e.g. ISO 27001 alignment, access control design).

  • Consulting or advisory background, owning problems end-to-end rather than a single workstream.

Nice to Have

  • Evidence of self-directed building — side projects, internal tools, or startups.

  • Exposure to finance data, PE/M&A, or portfolio-company environments.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g. AWS/Azure architect-level credentials).

Additional Information

We are committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments or support when applying or arranging your interview.

 

We do not accept unsolicited CVs from third-party agencies.

jobs.description:
Senior Platform Engineer
Our Story
 
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
 
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 
 
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 
 
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

The Team
 
Cloud Infrastructure sits within Zopa’s Platform Tribe alongside DBA and DevX colleagues. We build the foundations that help engineering teams deliver reliable, secure products with confidence. 
 
We are at the beginning of a meaningful transformation: moving from infrastructure that is primarily operated for teams towards a platform that engineers can increasingly use through clear, self-service capabilities. 
 
This role will help shape the standards, guardrails and developer experience that make that possible. 

A Day In The Life:

  • Design and evolve reliable cloud platform capabilities for engineering teams. 

  • Improve AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, monitoring and operational patterns. 

  • Partner with engineers to understand needs and make safe, maintainable choices. 

  • Take ownership of work from problem definition through delivery and learning. 

  • Strengthen observability, resilience, security and incident readiness. 

  • Help build reusable tooling, guardrails and self-service foundations. 

  • Contribute to platform standards across Cloud Infrastructure, DBA and DevX. 

  • Support business-critical services through the shared on-call rota. 


    • About You:

  • Strong hands-on AWS platform engineering experience in production environments. 

  • Practical Kubernetes/EKS, Docker, Terraform and Helm experience. 

  • Strong CI/CD experience, particularly GitHub Actions, and reusable-pipeline thinking. 

  • Experience with logging and monitoring, networking and protocols, scripting, secrets management and service discovery. 

  • Exposure to both AWS and Kubernetes, with sound coding experience. 

  • Evidence of designing secure, reliable and maintainable platform solutions. 

  • Autonomous delivery and constructive collaboration with application engineers. 

  • Experience supporting business-critical services through an on-call rota. 


    • Added Bonus:

  • Experience with Honeycomb, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Splunk, including SLO-led practices. 

  • Pragmatic use of AI-assisted engineering tools to improve quality and productivity. 

    • #LI-AP1

    At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

    We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

    You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

    *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

     

    Diversity Statement

    Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. 

     

    Our approach to AI in interviews

    At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs. 

    Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process. 

    Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other. 

    Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your initial focus will be on card transactions and related events, including card tokens and account takeover. 

This is a hands-on role where you’ll own the analysis, implementation and ongoing performance of our controls. You’ll work with large datasets, identify emerging risks and use your findings to design and improve the rules and models that help keep our customers safe. 

You don’t need to have worked in fraud or financial crime before. We’re looking for a strong analyst who enjoys solving complex problems, is curious about how things work and wants to build expertise in this area. 

Why this role matters 

Fraud and financial crime are constantly evolving, and so are the products and services we offer our customers. To grow safely, we need controls that can identify and prevent harm while allowing genuine customers to use their accounts with confidence. 

We want to build the next generation of fraud and financial crime controls, using modern data, technology and AI to stay ahead of emerging threats and make our detection as effective as it can be. 

You’ll be embedded in one of our product squads as part of the wider Fraud & Financial Crime Analytics team, working alongside Fraud Risk, Operations, Data Science, Engineering and Product. Together, you’ll help shape, build and continuously improve the controls that protect our customers. 

This is one of the most impactful analytics roles in the business. In the same day, you could be triaging a new fraud risk, designing the controls to stop it and protecting our customers from harm. 

This is an opportunity to bring your own ideas, shape how we solve problems and make a visible impact on both our customers and the business. 


A day in the life

  • Own and improve controls: Analyse, implement, test and optimise rules and other controls that prevent and detect fraud and financial crime. 

  • Investigate emerging risks: Use data to identify suspicious patterns, understand changing threats and recommend practical ways to respond. 

  • Measure what matters: Monitor detection, losses, false positives and alert volumes to understand control performance and identify opportunities to improve. 

  • Test and learn: Develop hypotheses and evaluate new approaches, balancing improvements in detection with the impact on genuine customers and Operations. 

  • Build the next generation of controls: Work with Data Science, Product and Engineering to explore how new data, models, AI and automation can improve our detection and how we work. 

  • Support change: Help implement and monitor model-led controls, and test and migrate controls as our platforms evolve. 

  • Shape your priorities: Work with the squad to identify and prioritise opportunities, influence decisions and share your knowledge with others.

Our Story
 
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
 
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 
 
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 
 
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

The team
 
We’re on a mission to take our mobile app to the next level, and we’re looking for someone to help shape the future of our Android experience in Kotlin. Joining the Mobile Platform team, you’ll work on the technical foundations that power the app — from architecture and shared libraries to core experiences, build systems, and analytics infrastructure. 
 
You’ll join our Mobile Platform team, which owns the infrastructure, tooling and engineering standards that sit beneath our customer-facing mobile experiences. This includes areas such as app architecture, shared modules, our design system, observability, developer tooling and CI/CD.

The team is accountable for keeping these foundations reliable, scalable and easy for our product squads to build on. You’ll help shape the direction of mobile engineering at Zopa, improve the developer experience, and reduce the underlying technical complexity that product engineers need to manage.

The Mobile Platform team does not own individual customer journeys or build product features on behalf of squads. Instead, your focus will be on creating and maintaining the shared capabilities, tooling and standards that enable those teams to deliver safely and effectively.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer

We’re on a mission to protect society from fraud and money laundering. We’ve already protected over 3 million people through life’s big transactions.

Fraud and regulation are rising, costing the UK economy over £100bn every year; this makes it more difficult for businesses to protect themselves and their clients - individuals like you and me - from fraud and money laundering.

Our co-founders Olly and Jack were led to this area when a friend was defrauded of £25K when buying their first property. At the time, anti-fraud technology didn’t exist, which meant that completing the anti-fraud checks required in these processes was largely manual. These big life moments should be exciting, but instead are often confusing and scary due to the painful process of completing these paper-based checks and the risk of fraud.

Thirdfort helps businesses to facilitate these anti fraud checks so that individuals know they can transact safely and seamlessly with professionals during these big transactions. Our anti-fraud platform provides a secure way for professionals in regulated sectors like Lawyers, Estate Agents and Accountants to transfer funds and verify sensitive information through app based document checks, facial recognition and open banking.

Over 1,500 businesses now trust Thirdfort to verify their clients. We are FCA regulated and have raised over $33m in capital from leading Fintech investors Breega and Element Ventures, as well as the founders of Zoopla, Funding Circle, Comply Advantage, Tessian, Fenergo and Fidel.

 

About the role:

You'll join Thirdfort at an exciting moment for Tenant Referencing. We're rebuilding the product from the ground up, moving it off a legacy platform onto Thirdfort's strategic engineering platform (Go, Temporal-based workflows, cloud-native). You'll be one of the first permanent engineers on a newly-formed squad, with real scope to shape how tenant referencing gets architected and make technical calls on a live migration. It matters beyond the tech, too. Tenant referencing is where our fraud-prevention mission meets something that matters to people directly: renting a home.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership, is comfortable without a fully mature spec, and is pragmatic about tooling, including using AI where it helps them move faster.

For this role, we would love this person to be able to join us in our London office two times a week as being together as a team is valuable for us but ultimately, we trust our team to decide what works best for them.


You will achieve your mission as our Senior Software Engineer by:
  • Helping lead the rebuild of our tenant referencing product, migrating it from our legacy platform onto Thirdfort's strategic engineering platform (Go, Temporal-based workflows), working across both systems during the transition
  • Designing and building backend services and APIs that power tenant referencing checks, and contributing to our frontend (React/TypeScript) and mobile platforms when needed
  • Making independent architecture and delivery decisions on a fast-moving, still-forming squad, working closely with our Product & Tech Lead
  • Upholding engineering quality through testing, observability, and code review, as we build permanent engineering ownership into the team
  • Partnering closely with Ops and Support to understand real tenant referencing workflows and translating that understanding into good technical decisions
  • Using modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development, to build new check types and features quickly without sacrificing quality
  • Mentoring and uplifting engineering practices across the squad as it grows

    • You may be right for this role if you:

    Hard requirements:

  • Have strong backend service experience in a modern programming language, with the ability to ramp up quickly in Go
  • Have experience designing, building, and integrating APIs
  • Have experience working in cloud environments (AWS and/or GCP)
  • Have taken ownership of ambiguous technical problems and seen them through with minimal oversight

    • Nice to haves:

  • Have experience with workflow orchestration or event-driven systems (e.g. Temporal)
  • Are comfortable using AI coding tools (e.g. Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) as part of your everyday workflow
  • Have experience working across a legacy-to-modern platform migration
  • Have some experience with React/TypeScript and/or mobile development

    • “Studies show that women and other less represented groups are less likely to apply for roles unless they meet every requirement. We believe in building a diverse team, valuing different skills and experiences and so if you don’t think you have all the requirements listed here but feel this could be a role and environment you’d thrive in, we would still love for you to apply."


    Our Benefits:

    We've created our benefits package to reflect Thirdfort's mission and values. Everything we do is designed to build on trust, and we extend this promise to our team by investing in their physical, mental, and financial security to support them through life's big moments. Ultimately, our benefits exist to empower our people, ensuring everyone feels deeply supported, trusted, and equipped to do their best work.

     

    When you join Thirdfort, you'll get immediate access to our employee benefits package that aims to support you across these areas:

  • Compensation: up to £100,000 base salary
  • Location - London Office - twice per week
  • Share options for all UK employees
  • Annual leave allowance of 26 days, increasing to 30 with tenure and the option to buy additional days
  • Uncapped personal development budget
  • Flexible working hours
  • Private healthcare (AXA)
  • Enhanced parental and sick leave


    • We're committed to building an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture where everyone has a chance to make a difference. We're purposefully building a team of problem-solvers that reflect our values, which is why we hire from all backgrounds. If you're a curious, kind individual who takes ownership, you'll be a great Thirdforter.

jobs.title: Data Platform Manager
jobs.description:
Data Platform Manager

About the role

As Data Platform Manager you will own Destinus's company data platform. Built on Microsoft Fabric, it brings together data from our different systems, and it serves the reporting and data agents that production, supply chain, program management, and finance work from every week.

You will own its architecture: how OneLake and our lakehouses are structured, how data lands in them from the systems we run, and how it holds up as more of the business comes to depend on it. You will lead a small team of data engineers — setting direction, reviewing their work, growing them — and you will keep building yourself. You are also the person who makes our AI ambitions possible: the foundation behind our data agents and our Company Brain is yours to design and deliver.

At Destinus we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing, building advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across three European plants. The data you will work with is physical — parts, build progress, shortages, non-conformances — and the questions asked of it get harder each year as we grow. If you want a platform you can still shape rather than one already set in concrete, this is a good moment to arrive.

What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture of our Microsoft Fabric estate end to end — OneLake, our lakehouses and their bronze, silver, and gold layers, workspace and domain structure, naming conventions, and the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers: set priorities, review code, raise the technical bar, and develop the people.
  • Stay hands-on. You will build pipelines, notebooks, and Delta tables yourself, not only direct others who do.
  • Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source.
  • Own the gold layer and the semantic models built on it, so that Power BI reads from one governed source rather than from copies scattered around the business.
  • Work closely with our Business Operations & Data Specialists, who represent the business owners of each domain: turn their requirements into the right gold tables, agree definitions with them, and give them a platform they can query, validate, and explain to the business with confidence.
  • Own lineage across the estate: know what feeds what, be able to prove it to an auditor, and make dependencies visible rather than tribal knowledge.
  • Build the data foundation for our AI programme — the lakehouse structures, pipelines, and knowledge graph behind our Fabric data agents and our Company Brain — and deliver it to a standard that can be trusted with a real question.
  • Design and maintain the OneLake security and access model together with your team: workspace roles, access groups, and the controls that decide who sees what in the lake.
  • Keep the platform reliable, observable, and cost-aware: monitoring, alerting, recovery, and disciplined use of our Fabric capacity — including knowing what a runaway notebook costs us.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5-8 years of data engineering experience, including real ownership of a lakehouse architecture rather than only delivering against someone else's.
  • Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience is strongly preferred — OneLake, lakehouses, Delta tables, the SQL analytics endpoint, Data Factory pipelines, Spark notebooks, and semantic models in Direct Lake mode. If your depth is in Azure Synapse, Databricks, or Data Lake Storage Gen2 and you have since moved onto Fabric in earnest, we will take that seriously.
  • Strong command of the medallion pattern and of Delta Lake in practice: partitioning, schema evolution, table maintenance, and why a gold table behaves the way it does.
  • Genuinely hands-on. Strong SQL, solid PySpark, and comfort building and orchestrating pipelines yourself. This is not a role that stops at diagrams.
  • Practical understanding of Fabric capacity: how workloads consume it, how to spot what is burning it, and how to keep the platform inside its envelope.
  • Experience leading engineers — formally, or as a technical lead who set direction and mentored others. A first step into people management is welcome if the technical leadership is already there.
  • Proven integration experience with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 / MSD, as well as APIs, flat-file landings, and change data capture from operational databases.
  • Solid data modelling skills, including dimensional modelling and an understanding of how a semantic layer serves Power BI.
  • Working knowledge of lineage, data governance, and access control in a cloud platform; exposure to Microsoft Purview is a plus.
  • Interest or experience in the data foundations behind AI assistants — retrieval, knowledge graphs, and preparing data so that an agent can answer with it.
  • Aerospace or another regulated industry is an advantage; so is experience in a start-up or scale-up.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

Who You Are

You are an architect who never stops building. You have strong opinions about how a platform should be structured, and you earn the right to them by being in the code. You would rather make a design decision explicit and documented than let it live in one person's head.

You care more about reliability than novelty. You know that the measure of a data platform is whether people trust the numbers that come out of it on a Monday morning, not how modern the stack looks on a slide. When something breaks, you want to know why it was possible, not just how to patch it.

You enjoy growing engineers, and you understand that leading a small team means doing the work alongside them. Above all, you want to build something durable — a foundation that holds while the company scales on top of it.

jobs.title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Data & Analytics Engineer

Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place.

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting) with 25+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel.

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 23 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition at Polarsteps - Senior Data & Analytics Engineer

Over the past 10+ years, Polarsteps has grown massively through word-of-mouth, thanks to our product and tech department building a top-quality user experience for all our travelers.

As our first Senior Data & Analytics Engineer, you'll own the foundation that every data-driven decision at Polarsteps is built on. Product & growth teams run experiments and analyse the data every week, leadership need clear reports for investors, and all of that depends on data that is reliable, modelled and compliant. You'll set the direction for our data platform, bring structure to data governance, and own the data infra that helps our product managers, marketers and data scientists do their job even better. You'll work closely with the Head of Engineering on infrastructure and architecture, and with the Head of Growth and product teams on what the business needs from data.

With 20M+ users and ratings of 4.8 and 4.7 on the app stores and features in multiple Google and Apple showcases, we've got an impressive past. But we're even more excited for the future, and you'll play a crucial role in building the data foundation that gets Polarsteps to 100M+ travelers around the globe.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day.

  • Own the data platform roadmap: set the strategy for our data infrastructure and warehouse, make the build-vs-buy and tooling calls, and oversee execution together with DevOps.

  • Design, build and maintain scalable ingestion pipelines for both internal (product events, back-end data) and external sources (ad platforms, attribution, app store data).

  • Build and maintain a clean, documented modeling layer (e.g. dbt) that serves as the single source of truth for analysts, data scientists and self-serving PMs.

  • Lead data governance: define and enforce event naming and tracking standards, a schema change process, documentation, and dashboard ownership.

  • Embed privacy in the data stack: make sure personal data is categorized, minimized and pseudonymized before it reaches downstream and third-party tools, in close collaboration with Legal

  • Own the health of the stack: monitoring, alerting, data quality checks and cost management, so issues are caught before they reach stakeholders.

  • Define who owns what across our data tooling (e.g. Mixpanel, our warehouse and BI layer), and help teams get the most out of self-serve analytics.

  • Enable data enrichment to unlock deeper insights for Product and Growth.

  • Explore how we can safely use LLMs (such as Claude) on top of our data for analysis and reporting.

  • Act as the go-to data partner for Product, Engineering and Growth, and help grow the data function as Polarsteps scales.

The equipment in your backpack

What we're hoping you'll bring with you.

✅ 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or a hybrid data role, ideally in a B2C product or mobile app company.

✅ Strong SQL and Python, and hands-on experience modeling large event datasets in a modern warehouse (e.g. ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

✅ Experience with dbt and an orchestration tool such as Airflow or Dagster.

✅ Proven track record of bringing structure to data governance: tracking plans, event ownership, documentation and data quality.

✅ Experience with product analytics tools (e.g. Mixpanel, Amplitude) and BI tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker).

✅ Comfortable owning infrastructure decisions: cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform), CI/CD for data.

jobs.title: Junior Tester
jobs.description:
Junior Tester

Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar hoe software werkt en vind je het leuk om uit te zoeken of alles doet wat het zou moeten doen? Heb je oog voor detail, stel je graag kritische vragen en krijg je energie van het vinden van verbeterpunten?

Dan is deze functie als Junior Tester precies wat je zoekt!

Als tester speel je een belangrijke rol in de kwaliteit van software. Je onderzoekt applicaties, voert testen uit en kijkt kritisch naar de werking ervan. Kom je iets tegen wat niet klopt? Dan analyseer je wat er aan de hand is en zorg je ervoor dat jouw bevindingen duidelijk bij de juiste mensen terechtkomen.

Je hoeft nog geen ervaring te hebben als tester. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je leergierig, analytisch en nauwkeurig bent en graag wilt ontdekken hoe je software steeds beter kunt maken.

Wat ga je doen als Junior Tester?

Als Junior Tester houd je je bezig met het controleren en beoordelen van de werking en kwaliteit van applicaties en systemen. Je werkt samen met ontwikkelaars, analisten en andere betrokken collega's om ervoor te zorgen dat software goed functioneert en voldoet aan de verwachtingen.

Je leert stap voor stap hoe je verschillende soorten testen uitvoert en hoe je bevindingen op een duidelijke manier rapporteert.

Concreet zijn jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Opstellen van testscenario's

  • Uitvoeren van testgevallen

  • Controleren of applicaties werken zoals bedoeld

  • Signaleren van fouten, afwijkingen en verbeterpunten

  • Analyseren van testresultaten en bevindingen

  • Registreren en duidelijk communiceren van bevindingen

  • Samenwerken met developers, analisten en andere stakeholders

  • Meedenken over de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van software

  • Leren werken met verschillende testmethodieken en tools

Je krijgt gedurende het traineeship de ruimte om praktijkervaring op te doen en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Zo groei je stap voor stap van trainee naar een zelfstandige tester.

Binnen het traineeship Business & IT ontwikkel je jezelf in twee jaar tijd tot een echte IT-professional. Je doet direct praktijkervaring op, volgt trainingen en behaalt relevante certificaten die je de rest van je carrière kunt gebruiken.

In het eerste jaar leg je een sterke basis in IT, systemen, processen en communicatie. Vanuit daar ontwikkel je jezelf steeds verder binnen jouw vakgebied.

Je start met een onboarding op ons kantoor in Bunnik, waar je trainingen volgt en je mede-trainees leert kennen. Daarna start je in je rol als Junior Tester. Gedurende het hele traject krijg je begeleiding van een persoonlijke people manager die je helpt om stappen te maken in je ontwikkeling.
