jobs.title: Research Engineer Privacy and Anonymization
jobs.description:
Research Engineer Privacy and Anonymization

Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones)
Start Date: ASAP
Languages: English
Team: Engineering

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.

This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.

This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

What You'll Do

  • Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.

  • Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.

  • Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.

  • Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.

  • Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.

  • Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.

  • Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.

  • Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.

  • An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.

  • High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.

  • Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.

  • Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.

  • Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

Why This Role Matters for You

  • Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.

  • Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.

  • From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.

  • Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.

  • San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will lead the migration to FleetDM and build the shared platform capabilities that support dependable endpoint operations. You will combine hands-on engineering with technical planning, partnering with Windows, macOS, and Linux engineers to introduce changes safely across a distributed environment.
You will develop automation, integrations, and configuration-as-code workflows, validate platform capabilities, and guide phased adoption. Beyond migration, you will improve platform reliability, visibility, and maintainability, helping the team reduce manual work and operate the service with shared ownership.
You will partner with Security, IAM, CorpInfra, and support teams to resolve dependencies and make practical trade-offs. This is an individual-contributor position with technical leadership and mentoring responsibilities.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the FleetDM migration. Define scope, requirements, architecture, dependencies, and a phased delivery plan with OS specialists and partner teams.
  • Engineer and operate the shared platform. Maintain configuration, agent workflows, policies, queries, integrations, and operational automation.
  • Make deployment safe and repeatable. Build version-controlled configuration with automated checks, peer review, controlled rollout, drift detection, and recovery.
  • Validate capabilities and coexistence. Identify gaps, clarify management authority, and establish which responsibilities should migrate or remain with existing tools.
  • Make platform health actionable. Establish trustworthy device populations, data freshness, enrollment and agent health, and owned remediation workflows.
  • Protect service continuity. Use representative pilots, acceptance gates, employee-impact checks, and clear pause and recovery decisions.
  • Strengthen team capability. Create reusable patterns, documentation, and shared support coverage through pairing, mentoring, and operational handoffs.
  • Improve efficiency and cost. Reduce recurring manual work and recommend tooling consolidation where evidence supports it.

Requirements

  • Significant hands-on experience engineering enterprise endpoint platforms, including deep expertise in at least one of Windows, macOS, or Linux and experience working across OS boundaries.
  • Personal ownership of a multi-phase platform migration or comparable change, including discovery, pilots, rollout, recovery, and operational handover.
  • Strong practical programming or scripting skills, such as Python, Go, PowerShell, or shell, with production automation and API integration experience.
  • Demonstrated use of Git, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for configuration or infrastructure changes.
  • Ability to diagnose enrollment, agent, policy, identity, networking, and integration failures and distinguish missing data from healthy devices.

  • Migration or coexistence experience involving Intune, Jamf, or comparable endpoint-management platforms.

  • Experience supporting developer-heavy, distributed environments.
  • Demonstrated improvements in platform operating effort, tool consolidation, or lifecycle cost.

About Actian

Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale.

Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions and providing the trusted data foundation required for enterprise AI.

We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering or Director of DevOps to establish and lead our newly formed Platform Engineering organisation.

This is a hands-on technical leadership position for an engineering leader who has successfully built and scaled platform or infrastructure teams within a technology product company.

You will not simply inherit and manage an existing organisation. You will build the team, define its technical direction, establish its operating model, and remain closely involved in architecture and implementation.

You should be someone who can move confidently between strategic decisions and hands-on engineering: designing infrastructure, reviewing code, implementing automation, solving complex production challenges, and setting engineering standards.

We are an AI-first engineering organisation. We expect you to actively use AI technologies to accelerate engineering, automate infrastructure operations, and fundamentally rethink how platform teams work.

This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position.

What You Will Own:

1. Platform Engineering & Architecture

  • Establish and lead the Platform Engineering organisation from the ground up.
  • Design and implement scalable, reliable platform services supporting our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
  • Define the architecture and engineering standards used across the organisation.
  • Establish clear ownership boundaries and effective collaboration with product engineering teams.

2. Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment

  • Design and deliver a cloud-agnostic deployment architecture across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments.
  • Build and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure in production.
  • Own infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt and GitOps-based deployment using Argo CD or equivalent technologies.
  • Ensure reliable installation, upgrades, maintenance, and supportability across different customer environments.
  • Support restricted-network and air-gapped deployment scenarios where required.

3. AI-First Engineering & Infrastructure Operations

  • Integrate AI agents into infrastructure operations, including incident triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting.
  • Use AI coding assistants and development agents extensively in your own daily engineering work.
  • Establish practical standards for AI-assisted engineering across the platform team.
  • Identify opportunities to replace traditional tools and operational processes with AI-driven automation.
  • Build the infrastructure required to support AI and ML workloads, including model-serving environments and associated data services.
  • Ensure appropriate human oversight, security guardrails, and auditability for AI-driven operations.

4. Security, Compliance & Reliability

  • Establish security and compliance practices supporting SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
  • Ensure compliance with EU data residency and customer-specific security requirements.
  • Implement automated compliance evidence collection and audit readiness.
  • Establish observability, monitoring, incident management, and on-call practices.

5. Team Building & Leadership

  • Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Platform Engineering team.
  • Define the team's structure, responsibilities, processes, and engineering culture.
  • Remain technically involved while developing the team's capabilities and autonomy.
  • Work closely with the SVP of Engineering and other technical leaders to align platform strategy with business and product priorities.

What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months:

  • Build and establish a high-performing Platform Engineering team with clear ownership and responsibilities.
  • Deliver a portable deployment architecture supporting AWS, at least one additional public cloud, and customer-managed infrastructure.
  • Establish infrastructure as code and GitOps delivery as standard engineering practices.
  • Introduce AI agents into operational workflows, with measurable reductions in manual effort and operational overhead.
  • Deliver scalable infrastructure foundations for our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
  • Automate compliance evidence collection and improve audit readiness.
  • Establish a reliable operating model covering observability, incident response, security, and cloud cost management.

What You Bring:

Leadership & Experience

  • 10+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE.
  • At least 3 years of direct engineering management experience.
  • Currently operating at Director of Platform Engineering, Director of DevOps, or an equivalent hands-on Director-level position.
  • Demonstrated experience building and scaling engineering teams, rather than exclusively managing established organisations.
  • A strong track record of delivering and operating production platforms within a technology product company.
  • The ability to combine technical leadership with hands-on engineering execution.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes.
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly Terraform or Terragrunt.
  • Proven experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines using Argo CD or comparable technologies.
  • Strong AWS expertise and practical experience designing cloud-portable architectures.
  • Experience with Azure or Google Cloud is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience with self-hosted or on-premises enterprise software deployments.
  • Practical experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and data residency requirements.
  • Experience with cloud cost optimisation, FinOps, and infrastructure efficiency.

AI-First Mindset

  • Extensive practical use of AI coding assistants, development agents, and AI-driven automation.
  • Experience applying AI to engineering productivity and infrastructure operations.
  • Ability to identify, implement, and govern AI-driven operational workflows.
  • A forward-looking mindset about how AI will change platform engineering and infrastructure management.

Leadership Approach

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.
  • Comfortable making technical decisions and taking responsibility for their outcomes.
  • Able to build teams and systems from scratch.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work across distributed international engineering teams.
  • Comfortable working across US Eastern and Central European time zones.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with enterprise data platforms, data catalogues, metadata management, or graph databases.
  • Production experience across multiple cloud providers.
  • Experience with air-gapped and restricted-network deployments.
  • Infrastructure for AI/ML workloads, model serving, vector databases, or graph data stores.
  • OpenTelemetry or comparable observability technologies.
  • Privileged access management solutions such as StrongDM.

How You Will Work:

You will report directly to the SVP of Engineering and work closely with Product Engineering, Security, Customer Success, and Support.

This is a fully remote position based in the US East Coast, UK, Germany, France, or Spain, subject to local employment eligibility.

You should be able to maintain at least four hours of daily overlap with both US Eastern Time and Central European Time.

Occasional travel for team offsites and company-wide meetings may be required.

We value builders over theorists, ownership over hierarchy, and measurable outcomes over activity.

If you have built and scaled a platform engineering organisation, remain technically hands-on, and believe AI should fundamentally change how infrastructure teams operate, we would like to hear from you.

What We Offer:

  • The chance to be part of an innovative, fast-growing company making a significant impact in the data management space.
  • Collaboration with a passionate and diverse team.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote or hybrid).
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Join Us? At Actian, we are passionate about innovation and teamwork. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves creating an efficient and welcoming workspace, and enjoys working closely with a talented team.

Interested? We’d love to hear from you! Let’s discuss how you can contribute to our success while growing your career with us.

We value diversity at our company. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

jobs.title: Manager, Monitoring & Site Management (CRA Team)
jobs.description:
Manager, Monitoring & Site Management (CRA Team)

Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

ABOUT ALIMENTIV

Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.

We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you.

THE OPPORTUNITY

In this role, you will lead the day-to-day delivery of our Clinical Monitoring capability, with a focus on European CRAs. You will bring structure, clarity, and accountability to how we plan, manage, and continuously improve this critical function.

Your scope spans both operational leadership and strategic impact. From shaping policies and strengthening processes, to ensuring the quality and integrity of our clinical work at every level, you will play a central role. You will oversee resource planning, performance management, and compliance, ensuring our teams and partners deliver consistently high standards aligned with both regulatory expectations and industry best practice.

Working closely with sponsors and research partners, you will act as a trusted representative of our clinical monitoring and project teams throughout the full study lifecycle. You will bring expertise, credibility, and a solutions-oriented mindset to every interaction.

Positions available: 1; this opportunity is cross-listed in multiple locations. At this time, the position is open to those residing in Germany, United Kingdom, Ireland, Poland, Hungary, and Romania.

Closing date: June 12th, 2026, or later until successful candidate identified.

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.

Project Planning

  • Working in conjunction with clinical monitoring and project leadership team members, identify, develop, plan for, monitor, approve and/or report on project specific processes and services related to site selection, clinical monitoring, ICH-GCP compliance issue resolution, and global project harmonization including SOP and QS document maintenance, periodic site visits and collaborating with IT support to meet sponsor requirements on a timely basis.

Customer Service Delivery

  • Represent and support the Clinical Monitoring teams with internal partners and external Sponsors to identify areas of improvement, to address sponsor/site concerns and to integrate new technologies and processes.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance, industry best practices, and organizational goals and targets are met and/or exceeded.

Team Management and Engagement

  • Manage members of the Clinical Monitoring teams, ensuring functional areas are adequately staffed with qualified personnel, providing ongoing support to staff in the areas of work allocation, resource planning, training and development, technology, process development, expense management, employee engagement and performance management (staff role development, evaluations, performance improvement and lost time management).

Third Party Contract Management

  • Identify, procure, and manage Clinical Monitoring (Clinical Operations Leads) Independent Contractor services, including needs assessment, recruitment, contract negotiations, Corporate and Sponsor policy compliance, training and development, cost monitoring and performance management, ensuring corporate, industry and regulatory service level, guidelines and regulations are maintained.

Product/Service Delivery Support

  • Provide expertise, developing tools to support project teams and business development in the areas of clinical, site and compliance monitoring and performance during the project life cycle starting from the bidding process through to reporting project findings to sponsors.

Qualifications

  • The successful candidate should have a College Diploma/University Degree in a relevant field (Health Sciences, Life Sciences preferred, or SoCRA and/or ACRP Certification/Designation) and a minimum of 4-6 years related experience + substantial on-going training.
  • Experience in managing CRA staff and ability to provide training and/or mentorship to colleagues on a 1:1 basis or meeting setting.
  • Ability to work in a remote global capacity
  • Strong knowledge of appropriate regulations and guidelines as they pertain to clinical monitoring and GCP.
  • Team player that has a customer service approach and is solution oriented.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills
  • Strong verbal, written, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.

Working Conditions

  • Home-based

Compensation

+ bonus

Please note that the above range reflects the full spectrum of compensation for candidates located in Germany - our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to discuss specific local compensation at time of interview.

Additional Information

Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

Full-Time Germany, Hungary, Ireland, Poland, Romania, UK

Elektriker (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Elektriker (m/w/d)

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Chipindustrie – von Anfang an!

Deine Rolle bei Black Semiconductor

Bei Black Semiconductor entwickeln wir eine neue Generation der Halbleitertechnologie. Mit unserer ersten Produktionsanlage FabOne in Aachen schaffen wir die Grundlage für die Chipfertigung der Zukunft.

Dafür suchen wir dich! Als Elektriker*in wirst du Teil unseres Facility-Teams und unterstützt den Aufbau, die Inbetriebnahme und den Betrieb der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Aufbau, Installation und Inbetriebnahme der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage.

  • Wartung, Prüfung und Instandhaltung elektrischer Anlagen und Niederspannungssysteme.

  • Fehlersuche und Störungsbehebung an elektrischen Installationen und Steuerstromkreisen.

  • Lesen und Interpretieren von Stromlauf-, Schalt- und Verdrahtungsplänen.

  • Mitarbeit bei der Inbetriebnahme und Weiterentwicklung unserer Gebäudeautomation (FMCS), einschließlich Steuerungs- und Visualisierungssystemen.

  • Koordination und Unterstützung externer Elektrofachfirmen sowie Sicherstellung einer fachgerechten und sicheren Ausführung.

  • Unterstützung bei elektrischen Prüfungen, technischer Dokumentation und Materialbeschaffung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Energie- und Gebäudetechnik oder eine vergleichbare elektrotechnische Qualifikation.

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Elektroinstallation, Instandhaltung oder Betriebstechnik.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in der Elektrotechnik und Freude an praktischer Fehlersuche und Problemlösung.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Stromlauf- und Schaltplänen.

  • Grundkenntnisse der relevanten elektrotechnischen Vorschriften und Sicherheitsbestimmungen.

  • Eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team.

  • Sehr Gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Unsere Arbeitskultur

Menschen stehen über Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität entscheidend. Wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst – und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance ein, in der berufliche Aufgaben sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind auf den Menschen ausgerichtet und ermöglichen es dir, dich auf das Wesentliche zu konzentrieren.

Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial steht für uns an erster Stelle. Wir bieten dir die Freiheit und Eigenverantwortung, nachhaltige Veränderungen zu bewirken, und fördern deine Entwicklung durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in deine berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.

Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Dein Wohlbefinden hat für uns höchste Priorität. Wir bieten dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit hervorragenden Versicherungsleistungen, betrieblicher Altersvorsorge und virtuellen Aktienoptionen – für deine mentale, körperliche und finanzielle Gesundheit. Deine Sicherheit und Zufriedenheit liegen uns heute und in Zukunft am Herzen.

Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion bilden die Grundpfeiler unserer Unternehmenskultur. Wir fördern Offenheit und schaffen ein Umfeld, das von Vertrauen und gegenseitigem Respekt geprägt ist. Individualität ist unsere gemeinsame Stärke und treibt Innovation und Fortschritt voran.

Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen qualifizierter Menschen unabhängig von ihrer Herkunft und ihrem persönlichen Hintergrund. Wir schaffen ein inklusives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und persönliche Entwicklung großgeschrieben werden. Werde Teil unseres Unternehmens und gestalte mit uns den Wandel in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Read more about our privacy policy here.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer & Consultant (all genders) – Microsoft Fabric
jobs.description:
Senior Data Engineer & Consultant (all genders) – Microsoft Fabric

Mit über 650 Kolleg:innen an 19 Standorten in ganz Deutschland gestalten wir bei teccle die Zukunft der IT. Seit 2020 bringen wir starke IT-Unternehmen mit unterschiedlichsten Schwerpunkten unter einem Dach zusammen - und entwickeln uns so zu einem der führenden IT-Dienstleister im Land. Unser Ziel: IT-Lösungen schaffen, die wirklich weiterhelfen - verständlich, flexibel und zukunftsfähig. Für unsere Kund:innen und gemeinsam mit einem Team, das Technik genauso liebt wie neue Ideen.

Als Teil der teccle group steht die teccle wave für ganzheitliche Cloud-Lösungen und digitale Transformation im deutschen Mittelstand. Zur Verstärkung unseres eigenständigen siebenköpfigen Data-Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt engagierte Unterstützung.

Was du bei uns bewegst

Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was du kannst - sondern auch, was du bewirkst. In dieser Rolle trägst du zu folgenden Punkten bei:

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung moderner Data-&-Analytics-Plattformen auf Basis von Microsoft Fabric, Azure und Power BI, um nachhaltige Mehrwerte für unsere Kund:innen zu schaffen

  • Aufbau skalierbarer Datenarchitekturen, Datenmodelle und Data Pipelines, die eine effiziente Integration, Aufbereitung und Nutzung von Unternehmensdaten ermöglichen

  • Verantwortung für die technische Konzeption und erfolgreiche Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Kundenprojekte – von der Analyse über Workshops bis zur Qualitätssicherung

  • Sicherstellung leistungsfähiger Reporting-, BI- und Self-Service-Analytics-Lösungen, die datengetriebene Entscheidungen auf allen Ebenen unterstützen

  • Steuerung der Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen, Stakeholdern und Projektteams, um Projekte effizient, transparent und zielgerichtet zum Erfolg zu führen

  • Einsatz innovativer Technologien wie Azure AI und Microsoft Foundry zur Erweiterung moderner Datenplattformen und AI-gestützter Analytics-Lösungen

Womit du bei uns glänzt

Niemand erfüllt jede Anforderung. Wenn du neugierig bist und Lust auf die Aufgabe hast, freuen wir uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn nicht alles zu 100% passt.

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Data-, Analytics- oder Cloud-Umfeld mit – idealerweise im Consulting oder in kundenorientierten Projektlandschaften – und verfügst über fundiertes Know-how in Microsoft Fabric, Azure, OneLake, Data Lakes und modernen Datenarchitekturen

  • Du entwickelst, betreibst und optimierst skalierbare Cloud Data Platforms, ETL-/ELT-Prozesse und Data Pipelines mit Microsoft Fabric, Python, SQL sowie modernen CI/CD- und Testing-Standards

  • Du besitzt Erfahrung in Data Engineering, Datenmodellierung, Lösungsarchitektur und Systemintegration; Kenntnisse in Power BI, Spark/PySpark, Azure AI, AI Foundry oder komplexen SaaS-Anbindungen sind ein zusätzliches Plus

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und kundenorientiert, kommunizierst sicher mit technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern und überzeugst im agilen Projektumfeld mit professionellem Auftreten

  • Du interessierst dich für innovative Technologien, moderne AI- und Analytics-Lösungen sowie technische Projektverantwortung; Microsoft-Zertifizierungen wie DP-600, DP-700, AZ-305 oder AI-102 sind willkommen

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch - im Team, mit Kund:innen und im Alltag

  • Du lebst in Deutschland und bist berechtigt hier zu arbeiten - so können wir im Alltag gut und reibungslos zusammenarbeiten

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Bei uns bekommst du mehr als nur einen Job. Wir wollen, dass du dich weiterentwickeln, wohlfühlen und mitgestalten kannst. Hier ein paar Gründe, warum du gerne bei uns arbeitest:

  • Mehr Freiheit: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und bis zu 25 Tage arbeiten im EU-Ausland

  • Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt: Ob im Büro oder von zuhause - du entscheidest, was für dich am besten funktioniert

  • Wissen, das weiterbringt: Zertifizierungen, individuelle Weiterbildungen und Raum für deine Entwicklung

  • Willkommenskultur mit Herz: Ein kollegiales Team und echtes Miteinander

  • Gutes Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Technik und klare Strukturen

  • Sichere und faire Konditionen: attraktives Gehalt, JobRad, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Unterstützung über meinEAP, unser kostenloses Beratungsangebot - auch für deine Familie

Vielfalt macht uns stärker - deshalb fördern wir bewusst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen willkommen sind.

Gesucht wird eine Person, die:

  • Gespräche gezielt lenken und konzentriert auf einen erfolgreichen Abschluss hinarbeiten kann,

  • motiviert ist, Ziele nicht nur zu erreichen, sondern zu übertreffen,

  • auch in herausfordernden Situationen ruhig, fokussiert und lösungsorientiert bleibt,

  • echte B2C-Vertriebserfahrung mitbringt

  • schnell ins Handeln kommt, Eigenantrieb zeigt und keine langen Anlaufzeiten braucht,

  • aufgeweckt, dynamisch und hungrig auf Ergebnisse ist,

  • gerne im Team arbeitet und zu einer positiven, produktiven Atmosphäre beiträgt,

  • sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mitbringt.

Auch mit wenig Erfahrung, zum Beispiel rund einem Jahr Berufserfahrung, ist eine Bewerbung willkommen. Entscheidend ist nicht, dass bereits jede Anforderung perfekt erfüllt wird, sondern dass Drive, Lernbereitschaft und echtes Entwicklungspotenzial vorhanden sind.

Die Rolle ist grundsätzlich auf tägliche Präsenz im Office in Berlin/Brandenburg ausgelegt. Die neue Abteilung soll gemeinsam vor Ort aufgebaut werden.

jobs.title: Projektmanager Instandhaltung und Sanierung (m/w/d)

Projektmanager Instandhaltung und Sanierung (m/w/d)

Sie kommen vom Bau oder aus dem Handwerk, erkennen auf den ersten Blick, ob eine Arbeit sauber ausgeführt ist, und wollen Maßnahmen nicht mehr selbst ausführen, sondern voranbringen? Dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Die Immobetriebe Hausverwaltung GmbH ist ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen in Konstanz. Wir verwalten Wohnungseigentümergemeinschaften, Mietshäuser und größere Gewerbeobjekte im Raum Konstanz, Radolfzell und Singen. Wir arbeiten weitgehend digital: ein Vorgangssystem für alle Fälle, KI-Assistenz bei Routinen und Abläufe, die wir aufschreiben und gemeinsam verbessern.

Bisher haben unsere Verwalter die Umsetzung von Instandhaltung und Sanierung neben ihren rechtlichen Aufgaben mitgetragen. Diese Aufgabe lösen wir jetzt heraus und machen sie zu einer eigenen Stelle, die eng mit den Verwaltern zusammenarbeitet: Die Verwaltung führt Versammlung und Beschluss, Sie bringen die beschlossenen Maßnahmen auf die Baustelle und zum Abschluss.

Als Projektkoordinator sorgen Sie dafür, dass Instandhaltung und Sanierung in unseren Objekten zügig, in guter Qualität und im beschlossenen Budget umgesetzt werden. Die Ausführung liegt bei unseren Fachfirmen. Sie vertreten die Eigentümer als Bauherr: Sie planen, beauftragen, prüfen und halten nach, bis die Maßnahme abgenommen ist.

Aufgaben

  • Sie sehen sich Schäden und Instandhaltungsbedarf vor Ort an und schätzen ein, was zu tun ist und welche Gewerke gebraucht werden

  • Sie besprechen Umbau- und Modernisierungswünsche von Eigentümern am Objekt und machen daraus ein umsetzbares Vorhaben

  • Sie holen Angebote ein, vergleichen sie und bereiten Entscheidungen vor; Umfang, Varianten und Kosten liefern Sie für die Beschlüsse der Eigentümer, den Beschluss selbst holt die Verwaltung ein

  • Steht der Beschluss, setzen Sie die Maßnahme um: Sie beauftragen die Firmen, setzen Termine, koordinieren die Gewerke und halten nach, bis alles erledigt ist

  • Sie prüfen vor Ort, ob fachgerecht gearbeitet wird, nehmen Leistungen ab, verfolgen Mängel und prüfen Rechnungen gegen den Auftrag

  • Sie arbeiten im Rahmen der Budgets und Freigaben, die Beschlüsse und Verwaltervertrag vorgeben, und melden Abweichungen frühzeitig

  • Sie dokumentieren jedes Projekt im Vorgangssystem und erfassen Ihre Zeiten laufend

  • Ein großer Teil Ihrer Arbeit findet am Schreibtisch statt: Telefon, E-Mail, Angebote und Abstimmung mit Eigentümern, Beirat und Verwaltung

Qualifikation

  • Eine bautechnische Ausbildung, etwa im Handwerk, als Techniker oder ein Studium im Bauwesen, und mehrjährige Praxis am Bau oder in der Instandhaltung von Gebäuden

  • Ein gutes Auge für Qualität über mehrere Gewerke hinweg; Sie erkennen, was ein Schaden braucht und was ein Angebot taugt

  • Freude daran, Dinge zu Ende zu bringen und mehrere Maßnahmen gleichzeitig im Blick zu behalten

  • Verlässlichkeit im Umgang mit Budgets und Freigaben

  • Sorgfalt in der Dokumentation: Projektstand und Zeiten schreiben Sie konsequent auf

  • Ein freundliches, klares Auftreten gegenüber Eigentümern und Handwerkern

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft 365; Offenheit für digitale Werkzeuge und KI im Alltag

  • Führerschein Klasse B und verhandlungssicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift

  • WEG-Recht müssen Sie nicht mitbringen. Die rechtliche Seite verantwortet die Verwaltung, Sie lernen sie im Alltag kennen

Benefits

  • Direkteinstieg in bestehende Projekte mit beschlossenen Maßnahmen, mit sauberer Übergabe durch die betreuenden Verwalter

  • Eigene Projekte von der Besichtigung bis zur Abnahme, mit klaren Vorgaben und Rückhalt im Team

  • Abwechslung zwischen Büro und Objekten in der Region, planbare Arbeitszeiten statt Baustellenalltag

  • Dienstfahrzeuge für Fahrten zu den Objekten

  • Zentrale Lage in Konstanz mit guter Verkehrsanbindung und kostenfreien Parkplätzen

  • Betriebliche Zusatzleistungen und Weiterbildung

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann bewerben Sie sich bei uns.

Wenn Sie Maßnahmen gern in die Hand nehmen und zu Ende bringen, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin und Gehaltsvorstellung.

Bewerbungskosten, etwa Fahrtkosten zu Vorstellungsgesprächen, können wir leider nicht übernehmen.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Strategic Finance Manager (m/f/d)

📊 Want to build the finance function of a fast-growing consumer brand from scratch, and sit right next to the founders when the big decisions get made? Then read on. 🐱

At The Better Cat, we are reinventing the pet food market. 🐾 We are a VC-backed startup (backed by FoodLabs, among others) that has become the fastest growing cat food company in Germany and won the Fressnapf Innovation Award in 2024. We sell D2C, on Amazon and increasingly in retail.

This is our first dedicated finance hire, reporting directly to our co-founder Niklas. The role is a real mix: part finance business partner, giving the founding team accurate and timely numbers to decide on, and part hands-on operational finance, building the close and working with our external accountant and tax advisor. We are AI-first and automate wherever we can, so you will have the freedom (and the expectation) to build finance processes the modern way.

Tasks

Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Own forecasting, budgeting and performance analysis.

  • Analyse revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, costs and working capital.

  • Support pricing, promotion, product mix, channel and product portfolio decisions.

Business Partnering & Decision Support

  • Be the primary finance contact for our Growth & Marketing and Supply Chain teams.

  • Translate financial and operational KPIs into clear insights and actions.

  • Challenge assumptions, connect operational decisions to P&L and cash-flow outcomes, and find opportunities to improve profitability and efficiency.

Supply Chain & Working Capital

  • Partner on inventory, procurement, fulfilment, logistics and working capital decisions.

  • Identify opportunities to improve costs, cash flow and operational efficiency.

Strategic Initiatives & Business Cases

  • Build business cases and quantify the financial impact of major initiatives, such as new brand, channel or country launches, and connect them to financial operations.

  • Support the rollout of controlling processes across the organisation.

Accounting

  • Build the monthly and annual close processes from scratch.

  • Work with our external tax advisor and accountants to ensure robust VAT treatment across countries and channels.

Requirements

Experience & Background

  • 2-4 years of experience in Consulting, Investment Banking, FP&A, Finance Business Partnering, Commercial Finance or Strategic Finance.

  • Experience in e-commerce, consumer products, retail, distribution or another physical-product business.

  • At least a bachelor's degree in a relevant subject such as Finance, Accounting, Economics or Business. A professional qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CFA) in progress or newly completed is a plus.

  • Proven ability to run workstreams independently and deliver high-quality output with minimal supervision.

  • Fluent in German and English.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex financial modelling and data analysis.

  • Experience with accounting software (e.g. DATEV, Lexware) and AI and automation tools (Claude, ChatGPT, n8n, Make, Zapier) is a plus. Above all, you are curious about AI and want to use it to work smarter.

  • Comfortable working with large datasets and turning analysis into clear, concise business insights.

  • Solid understanding of financial statements, management accounting principles and business performance metrics.

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong commercial mindset and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

  • Clear and confident written and verbal communication, including presenting findings to non-finance stakeholders.

  • Proactive and self-motivated, with an entrepreneurial mindset and comfort in a fast-paced, scaling company.

Benefits

  • 🦁 An inspiring team: Ambitious, fun, down-to-earth and authentic. Come and meet us!

  • 🏗️ Build it your way: As our first finance hire, you shape the finance function, its processes and its tools from day one.

  • 📈 Direct access to the founders: You work daily with Niklas and the founding team and help make decisions instead of just reporting on them.

  • 🤖 AI-first environment: We automate wherever it makes sense and give you room to experiment with the latest tools.

  • 🐱 Great products: It is more fun to stand behind something that truly works. Read our reviews or ask us for a sample!

  • 💝 Cool benefits: Deutschland-Ticket, MacBook, Wellpass, merch, office snacks and drinks.

  • ⭐ Great workplace: Modern office in Hamburg's HafenCity, hybrid setup, flexible working hours and fast personal growth.

🐾 Ready to build the finance engine of a scaling consumer brand and make the world a better place for cats?

Then get in touch! 📩 Send us your CV and a short cover letter and tell us why you are the right person for this role. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: M&A Associate (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
M&A Associate (m/f/d)

Über die Rolle

Eine gute Kaufentscheidung beginnt damit, dass jemand genau hinsieht. Bei Buena bist du das: Du verstehst das Unternehmen, hinterfragst Annahmen, erkennst Risiken und begründest, welchen Preis wir zahlen sollten.

Du verantwortest die Due Diligence für Hausverwaltungen, die wir übernehmen möchten: von der ersten Sichtung des Datenraums über die Bewertung und die Präsentation im Investment Committee bis zu den finanziellen und operativen Anlagen für den Kaufvertrag. Wenn das Committee ins Detail geht, kennst du das Unternehmen und kannst deine Empfehlung fundiert begründen.

Unser Prozess steht. Jetzt suchen wir jemanden, der die Verantwortung für die Qualität der Analysen übernimmt, die Due Diligence eigenständig steuert und unseren Prozess mit dem Wachstum weiterentwickelt.

Über Buena

Buena übernimmt Hausverwaltungen und digitalisiert sie mit selbst entwickelter Software. Wir verbinden Akquisitionen, operative Erfahrung und Technologie, um Immobilieneigentum und Verwaltung einfacher zu machen.

M&A ist ein zentraler Teil dieser Strategie. Die Unternehmen, die wir kaufen, werden Teil von Buena. Deshalb zählt unser Verständnis ihrer Zahlen, Verträge, Teams und Abläufe weit über den Abschluss einer Transaktion hinaus.

Deine Verantwortung

  • Das Unternehmen hinter dem Datenraum verstehen. Du führst Finanzdaten, Verträge, Objektlisten und Mitarbeiterinformationen zusammen. Du erkennst Lücken, gehst Widersprüchen nach und klärst offene Fragen mit den Verkäufern, bis ein belastbares Gesamtbild entsteht.

  • Die Bewertung fundiert herleiten. Du analysierst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung, arbeitest mit unseren Kaufpreismodellen und prüfst die zugrunde liegenden Annahmen. Du zeigst, was deine Erkenntnisse für den Kaufpreis und die Investitionsentscheidung bedeuten.

  • Deine Ergebnisse im Investment Committee vertreten. Du verdichtest die Due Diligence zu einer klaren Einschätzung von Chancen, Risiken und offenen Fragen und präsentierst sie direkt vor den Entscheidungsträgern.

  • Die Details bis zum Closing begleiten. Gemeinsam mit unserem M&A-Anwalt bereitest du die finanziellen und operativen Anlagen zum Kaufvertrag vor und stellst sicher, dass die Angaben stimmen.

  • Für die Qualität einstehen. Du prüfst die Beiträge unserer Praktikant, erkennst Fehler frühzeitig und übernimmst Verantwortung für die fertige Analyse.

  • Den Prozess weiterentwickeln. Du lernst unsere Playbooks kennen, setzt sie sorgfältig um und bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir Datenräume, Analysen und Entscheidungen besser organisieren können.

Du passt gut zu uns wenn

  • Du bereits an Transaktionen gearbeitet hast. Idealerweise bringst du ein bis zwei Jahre Erfahrung als Analyst im Transaktionsumfeld, bei Private Equity oder Venture Capital mit. Auch fundierte Praktikumserfahrung kann relevant sein. Entscheidend ist, wie tief du in die Arbeit eingestiegen bist und welche Verantwortung du dir jetzt zutraust.

  • Deine analytischen Grundlagen sitzen. Du bist sicher in Excel, kannst Finanzdaten interpretieren und verstehst Bewertungskonzepte wie Equity Bridge und Discounted-Cashflow-Analyse.

  • Du den entscheidenden Details nachgehst. Eine Zahl, die sich nicht nachvollziehen lässt, oder eine Vertragsklausel mit unerwarteten Folgen ist für dich ein Grund, genauer hinzusehen.

  • Du dein Urteil erklären kannst. Du gehst souverän mit Rückfragen um, unterscheidest belastbare Erkenntnisse von Annahmen und änderst deine Einschätzung, wenn neue Informationen es erfordern.

  • Du Verantwortung übernimmst. Du hältst den Prozess in Bewegung, verfolgst offene Punkte konsequent und holst dir Unterstützung, wenn sie gebraucht wird.

  • Du dich in einem direkten, informellen Umfeld wohlfühlst. Du bringst sorgfältiges Arbeiten aus dem Transaktionsumfeld in ein Startup ein und gestaltest mit, wie wir arbeiten.

Die Besonderheiten von Hausverwaltungen und unsere internen Abläufe kannst du bei uns lernen. Startup-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung.

Warum Buena

Früh eigene Verantwortung übernehmen. Du begleitest deine Targets durch die Due Diligence und stehst für die Ergebnisse ein. Deine Analysen fließen direkt in konkrete Kaufentscheidungen ein.

Direkt mit den Entscheidungsträgern arbeiten. Du präsentierst im Investment Committee und arbeitest eng mit Kolleg aus M&A, Legal und Operations zusammen.

Mit jeder Transaktion dazulernen. Unsere volle Pipeline bietet dir immer wieder die Gelegenheit, Unternehmen zu verstehen, Risiken zu bewerten und zu sehen, wie deine Erkenntnisse einen Deal beeinflussen.

Mitgestalten wie wir Unternehmen kaufen. Unser Prozess ist strukturiert und lässt sich weiter verbessern. Sobald du ihn kennst, hast du den Freiraum, einzelne Schritte zu hinterfragen und bessere Lösungen vorzuschlagen.

So lernen wir uns kennen

Wir sprechen über deine Transaktionserfahrung, deine Herangehensweise an Due Diligence und die Verantwortung, die du als Nächstes übernehmen möchtest. Anschließend bearbeitest du einen praxisnahen Case und lernst das Team kennen, auch bei einem gemeinsamen Mittag- oder Abendessen. Referenzgespräche sind Teil der abschließenden Phase.

Du möchtest die Due Diligence hinter Buenas nächsten Akquisitionen verantworten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Product Engineer (m/f/d)

About 8returns

Every online shop has returns. Most treat them as a cost. We help brands turn them into a better customer experience, more exchanges instead of refunds, and less work for their teams.

You'll own features end to end: talking to merchants, deciding what to build, shipping it and making it better.

  • Full-stack product features

  • Infrastructure and tooling for agentic engineering

  • APIs and integrations with shop systems and carriers

  • Write your own specs and decide with the founders what's worth building next.

jobs.description:
GTM Intern - New Products (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)

You turn new ideas into revenue at Reonic. Find the opportunity, test it, make it happen.

Looking for a role where you don't just support growth but actually own it? This is for you. You'll work directly with installers to uncover real problems, turn those insights into new products and services, and take them from first idea to go-to-market. Working closely with our Venture Development team, you'll have the freedom and responsibility to figure out what works - and the pace to make it happen.

Please note that for this role, C2 German proficiency is required. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Berlin.

What You’ll Do

  • Go-to-market for new products and services inside our software. Which installers need this service? How do we reach them? What can we charge? What are the selling points? You don't find the answers at your desk, you find them by trying things.

  • Customer immersion and spotting new revenue streams. Daily conversations with installers to find out where their processes really hurt, pressure-test ideas against reality, and sell what you've built together with the Venture Development team.

  • Commercial responsibility. You figure out which model works: commission, fixed price, bundled pricing, or a partner share. And you see early whether a channel has enough potential to keep pushing.

  • Cross-functional execution. You pull sales, marketing, tech, and external partners together around your topic and keep it moving. You're the one who calls the next step and makes sure it happens.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Native or C2-level German and fluent English.

  • You've already brought something to market, or at least tried: your own project, a campaign, a product during an internship. What matters isn't the outcome, it's that you got going.

  • Strong sense of ownership and impatient if things don't move fast.

  • You'd rather talk to customers than build a theory at your desk.

  • You're comfortable with open situations and get your own answers.

  • Top university background with a clear entrepreneurial streak.

  • First experience in sales, growth, or product is a plus, but not a must.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of one of the fastest growing VC-backed startup in Germany with 3000+ satisfied B2B customers.

  • A vibrant, collaborative office culture where great ideas happen face-to-face - we're a full in-person team (5 days/week) in a beautiful Berlin office near Hackescher Markt.

  • Enjoy opportunities for personal and professional growth.

  • Embrace the freedom to innovate and make quick changes in a dynamic team.

  • Perks include gym membership ,or Deutschlandticket, Uber Eats after 7pm, Uber home after 7:30pm, regular team events, and a MacBook.

  • Receive competitive pay.

Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn't hold you back - we value talent and passion above all.


About Reonic

At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology with our AI operating system for renewable installers. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by 3000+ business customers, we’re growing fast - and we need YOU to help us accommodate our new and existing customers.

jobs.title: Technical Programme Manager
jobs.description:
Technical Programme Manager

About us

Salience Labs is developing optical circuit switching technology for AI infrastructure, aimed at significantly reducing latency and cost in data centre networks. As we move towards real-world deployment, you’ll have genuine ownership of your area, working alongside a highly technical team of physicists, engineers and software specialists on one of the hardest problems in AI infrastructure.

Job Overview

This role sits at the centre of how Salience Labs turns complex, multi-disciplinary engineering work into delivered hardware. You will drive our technical programmes from design through tape-out, fabrication, test and qualification, keeping photonics, electronics, firmware, test and packaging teams aligned and moving towards clear milestones.

We are looking for someone with an engineering background who has moved into programme or project management and still enjoys getting into the technical detail. You will be credible with engineers, able to understand the real constraints and dependencies, and able to turn them into plans, priorities and decisions that keep work moving.

You will work in a fast-paced, deep-tech environment where the work spans external partners as well as internal teams, and where clear ownership, early risk flagging and disciplined execution make a real difference to how quickly we get to deployment.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the delivery of cross-functional technical programmes, from planning through to milestone completion

  • Build and maintain integrated plans, timelines and critical paths across photonics, electronics, firmware, test and packaging

  • Translate technical requirements and engineering constraints into clear scope, priorities and deliverables

  • Identify, track and escalate risks, dependencies and blockers early, and drive them to resolution

  • Coordinate tape-outs, fabrication runs and build cycles with external foundry, manufacturing and test partners

  • Run regular programme reviews, stand-ups and milestone gates, with clear actions and accountability

  • Report progress, risks and trade-offs to engineering leads and senior leadership with data-led clarity

  • Work with engineering teams to define test readiness, qualification plans and release criteria

  • Manage supplier and partner schedules, deliverables and communication

  • Continuously improve programme management processes, tooling and ways of working

  • Maintain clear documentation of decisions, plans and programme status

What we’re looking for

  • A degree in Engineering, Physics or a closely related technical discipline

  • Experience delivering complex technical programmes or projects in hardware, semiconductor, photonics, electronics or similar deep-tech environments

  • An engineering background, with hands-on technical experience before moving into programme or project management

  • A strong understanding of hardware development lifecycles, such as design, prototyping, build, test and qualification

  • Experience coordinating multi-disciplinary teams and working with external partners, suppliers or foundries

  • Proven ability to plan rigorously, manage dependencies and critical paths, and keep projects moving under changing priorities

  • Strong technical understanding, with the ability to discuss detail with engineers and challenge assumptions constructively

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain progress, risks and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

  • A structured, proactive and outcome-driven approach, with strong attention to detail

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving deep-tech environment

Even better if you

  • Have experience with photonics/ semiconductor industry

  • Have managed programmes through new product introduction, from prototype to production

  • Have experience with qualification, reliability or manufacturing ramp

  • Hold a recognised project or programme management qualification (for example PMP, PRINCE2 or Agile)

  • Are experienced with programme tools such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project or similar

  • Have worked in a scale-up or early-stage deep-tech company

  • Have experience line-managing or coordinating a team of project or technical staff

You will join a highly ambitious deep-tech company operating at the intersection of AI infrastructure, semiconductors, and photonics. We are building foundational technology with the potential to reshape the performance envelope of future AI systems.

If you want to apply your engineering background to driving hard, multi-disciplinary hardware programmes at the frontier of AI infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Systems Test Engineer

About us

Salience Labs is developing optical circuit switching technology for AI infrastructure, aimed at reducing latency and cost in data centre networks. As we move towards deployment, you’ll have real ownership of your area and work alongside a highly technical team on a hard problem in AI infrastructure.

Job Overview

This role sits at the centre of how Salience Labs takes our photonic switching technology from prototype to reliable deployment in AI networks. You will define, build and operate our system test capability, covering complex opto-electronic setups, automation and structured test execution.

We need someone with a clear, organised and outcome driven approach, able to design test strategies from first principles and communicate progress with data led clarity.

Success requires strong technical depth, solid operational discipline and the ability to work quickly and precisely in a lab environment. You will shape how we validate our switching hardware, ensure test readiness at each milestone and remove bottlenecks through smart automation and process improvement. As a senior member of the team, you will set the technical standard for test and guide others in meeting it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Define and own the system level test strategy for Salience’s photonic switching platform, covering test planning, setup definition, execution and reporting

  • Build and maintain complex optical and electronic measurement setups with strong attention to stability, repeatability and safety

  • Automate test sequences and data capture pipelines to minimise manual overhead and accelerate learning cycles

  • Develop and communicate a clear view of test readiness, critical paths and parallelisable work

  • Create plans, timelines and prioritisation frameworks that reflect real engineering constraints

  • Optimise existing test processes by identifying wasted effort, anticipating failure modes and preparing setups ahead of hardware arrivals

  • Collaborate closely with Photonics, Electronics, Firmware and Product teams to ensure test outputs align with system level performance requirements for high bandwidth, low latency switching

  • Drive a culture of disciplined execution with a clear understanding of the commercial end goal

  • Mentor and guide other engineers in test practice, automation and lab discipline

  • Shape and lead the function with competence, judgement and reliability, even before any formal line management is introduced

What we’re looking for

  • Typically 5+ years of experience working hands on in lab environments involving complex optical, photonic or mixed signal electronic setups

  • Demonstrable ability to build, debug and optimise measurement systems, and automate test workflows, with experience owning test capability end to end

  • Comfortable operating in environments where test coverage, data quality and repeatability underpin every decision

  • Ability to plan rigorously, track progress, think in parallel and flag risks early

  • A background that may include photonics, optics, MEMS, mixed signal electronics, semiconductor test or high-speed transceiver validation

  • Experience with automated test frameworks, scripting for test automation and data analysis tooling

  • Fluency in Python (NumPy) and familiarity with VISA/SCPI protocols is essential

  • Strong organisational capability, able to set expectations, anticipate bottlenecks and maintain momentum across multiple teams

  • Experience mentoring or technically guiding other engineers

  • Based in the UK or willing to relocate, with consistent presence required in the Oxford lab

Even better if you

  • Have experience scaling system test infrastructure for high performance communication or switching hardware

  • Are comfortable developing automated analysis pipelines to support data led decision making

  • Have previously led or mentored test or validation teams

  • Bring understanding of reliability, environmental or system level testing for optical or networking hardware

  • Possess a practical commercial mindset, able to balance speed, risk and technical depth

If you are looking for an opportunity to shape the core test capability of a deep tech company redefining photonic switching for AI infrastructure, we would be glad to speak with you. This role suits someone who enjoys turning complex hardware behaviour into clear signals, structured plans and meaningful progress.

Founding Customer Success Manager, SME & Growth

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

As a founding member of the EMEA Customer Success function, you’ll help define how we support SME and mid-market customers as the business scales. You’ll own the customer journey through implementation, go-live and ongoing servicing, partnering closely with Sales, Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Support, Billing and Operations.

  • Build the operating model for Customer Success across EMEA, helping shape how we support SME and mid-market customers.

  • Own onboarding activities including pricing configuration, vendor onboarding, feature validation, invoicing and additional client reporting.

  • Project-manage feature implementation and coordinate stakeholders to move customers successfully from setup through go-live.

  • Monitor usage, service-level adherence and failure rates, turning customer insights into practical improvements.

  • Act as an escalation point for support and technical issues, using your product expertise to identify solutions and keep customers informed throughout resolution.

  • Build trusted relationships with customers and internal teams, creating a proactive and consistent customer experience as the business scales.

This role is based in Manchester, with three days a week in the office.

 

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • At least five years’ experience in customer success, operations or account management, ideally supporting enterprise, SME or mid-market customers.

  • Experience managing customer onboarding, implementation or activation processes from initial setup through go-live.

  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills, with the confidence to work with people across different functions, backgrounds and levels of seniority.

  • A technically minded approach, with experience delivering, supporting or troubleshooting SaaS or other technical solutions for customers.

  • Strong attention to detail and a habit of checking work carefully to prevent downstream issues.

  • The ability to manage multiple stakeholders, prioritise operational detail and keep customers informed through complex or time-sensitive issues.

Preferred

  • Experience in fintech, payments or another technology-led financial services environment.

  • Experience working with tools such as Google Workspace, Salesforce, SQL, Looker or Zendesk.

  • Experience monitoring customer usage, service levels, failure rates or other operational metrics.

  • Experience supporting SME or mid-market customers in a high-growth environment.

You'll thrive here if

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

jobs.description:
Account Executive, Mid-Market (Spend)

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

As an Account Executive on our Mid Market team, you’ll help ambitious businesses solve complex financial challenges across borders by bringing Airwallex’s global financial platform to more customers.

  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and territory planning through negotiation and close.

  • Build relationships with senior stakeholders and understand their business needs.

  • Partner across teams to shape solutions spanning spend management and related products.

  • Manage your pipeline carefully and deliver accurate forecasting through disciplined CRM usage.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 2+ years of experience in outbound business development and 1+ year in a closing sales role.

  • Experience selling a spend management tool or similar financial technology product.

  • A track record of strong sales performance and meeting targets.

  • Experience owning a full sales cycle, from prospecting through close.

  • The ability to understand complex customer requirements and craft solutions across multiple products.

  • Experience developing and executing territory plans.

  • Strong presentation and communication skills, particularly in meetings with multiple stakeholders and CXO-level audiences.

  • Superior verbal and written communication skills in English.

  • Experience using CRM systems consistently for pipeline management and forecasting.

  • Willingness to represent Airwallex at client meetings and events, with some travel required.

You'll thrive here if

  • You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

  • You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You say what you mean. You’re direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You’re motivated by working alongside people whose ambition pushes you to raise your own bar.

Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

 

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Capital Allowances Manager
jobs.description:
Capital Allowances Manager

About Unity Advisory

Unity Advisory is a modern advisory business built for today's CFO, with connected solutions across finance, deals and tax. Focussed on client outcomes, seasoned experts lead every engagement, in an operating model powered by AI and free from audit conflict.

The Role

We're building out our capital allowances offering and are looking for a Manager. You'll run a portfolio of client engagements, from single-asset claims through to large multi-site capital expenditure projects, working across all sectors. You'll support the technical lead on claims, act as the main point of contact for clients, and drive growth in this part of the practice.

This is a genuine opportunity to shape how the team operates, not slot into an existing one. Unity's technology and AI tools handle the heavy lifting on claim preparation and data analysis, freeing you up for the technical judgement and client relationships that actually move the needle.

Responsibilities

  • Lead a portfolio of capital allowances engagements across multiple sectors.

  • Prepare, review and submit capital allowances claims, ensuring technical accuracy and compliance with current legislation.

  • Advise clients on fixed asset tax treatment, expenditure planning and related incentives, including structures and buildings allowances and R&D-adjacent capital reliefs.

  • Manage HMRC correspondence and enquiries, negotiating on clients' behalf where needed.

  • Interpret asset schedules, fixed asset registers and financial data to identify qualifying expenditure and maximise client outcomes.

  • Produce clear, well-structured technical reports and client-facing deliverables.

  • Coach junior team members through day-to-day oversight, review and quality control.

  • Contribute to business development, including proposals, pitches and opportunities within existing client relationships.

Qualifications

  • Strong analytical skills — able to interpret financial data and asset schedules, and pick up new digital tools quickly.

  • Solid track record in capital allowances or fixed asset tax advisory, gained at an established advisory or accountancy firm.

  • Strong technical knowledge of UK capital allowances legislation, comfortable managing multiple live engagements at once.

  • CTA, ACA, ACCA, RICS or equivalent qualification.

  • Confident communicator — credible with senior stakeholders, able to explain complex tax positions in plain terms.

Additional Information

We are committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments or support when applying or arranging your interview.

 

We do not accept unsolicited CVs from third-party agencies.
