jobs.title: Commercial Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Commercial Analytics Manager

About Octopus Energy for Business

Octopus Energy for Business (OEB) is a rapidly scaling energy supplier with more than 130k business customers. We aim to accelerate the business sector’s transition to net zero whilst providing low-cost energy that meets the needs of our customers.

We’ve pioneered PPA-backed supply for mid-market businesses through Electric Match, led the way for SME smart tariffs with Shape Shifters and are the established market leader for enabling EV public charging through energy supply and services.

 

About the role

We’re seeking a highly skilled and data-driven Commercial Analytics Manager to modernise how we track and forecast our financial performance. In this role, you’ll take ownership of our business forecasting processes and lead the transition away from legacy, multi-tab spreadsheets. By leveraging modern data tools, you will build robust, automated pipelines to analyse margins, investigate variances, and provide actionable insights that optimise OEB's financial performance. You’ll collaborate closely with our Data team, finance teams, and senior leadership to ensure our financial strategies align with the company's sustainable growth objectives.


What you'll do

  • Provide consistent portfolio level reporting for OEB to determine overall net margins. This will include revenue, cost of sales, debt and operational expenditure.

  • Lead the development and management of the company’s forecast, ensuring accuracy and alignment with strategic goals.

  • Work with the team to interrogate the entire cost stack to influence pricing decisions.

  • Develop margin optimisation strategies, including pricing adjustments, cost reductions, and process improvements.

  • Improve accuracy of gross margin calculations in partnership with Finance and Pricing teams.

  • Lead meetings with colleagues and senior management to provide clear options in the decision making process.

  • Work closely with the pricing team to influence key decisions to ensure we provide customers with a wide range of tariffs which are set with a conscious view of outturned margins.

  • Provide monthly reporting packs to monitor different aspects of performance including budgets and variance analysis.

  • Work closely with business units to gather key inputs and assumptions for accurate forecasting.

  • Improve the tools behind our forecasting, moving away from spreadsheet-heavy processes towards Python and SQL-based analysis.

  • Compare forecasts with monthly actuals and thoroughly investigate variances across the business's book.


    • What you'll need

  • Strong proficiency in SQL to extract, manipulate, and transform complex commercial data.

  • Experience using Python for data analysis, automation, or financial modeling.

  • A minimum of 3 years experience of using data and coding to solve commercial, pricing, or financial problems.

  • A proven track record of untangling complex, legacy spreadsheet processes and replacing them with streamlined, automated solutions.

  • Strong financial acumen, particularly with reporting margins, forecasting, and variance analysis.

jobs.title: Partner Account Manager, Solution Partners
jobs.description:
Partner Account Manager, Solution Partners

About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

This Role

France's solution partner ecosystem is an important lever for Dust's growth. As Partner Account Manager, Solution Partners (France), you'll own activation and follow-through for assigned new and existing Tier 1 solution partners that are not yet strategic. You'll turn those relationships into qualified opportunities and repeatable commercial motions, working closely with Dust's Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partnerships teams.

This is a hands-on, commercially accountable role. You'll help assigned partners identify the right customer problems, shape clear joint propositions, and move opportunities forward. You'll enable partner teams to explain Dust and support customers effectively, drawing on Dust's technical and delivery teams where needed. Your focus is activation and follow-through for your assigned French solution partner portfolio, in coordination with colleagues who own strategic partner relationships and broader ecosystem programs.

Key Responsibilities

Grow and activate the partner portfolio

  • Own activation and follow-through for assigned new and existing Tier 1 solution partners in France that are not yet strategic, including digital transformation and AI consultancies, systems integrators, and implementation partners

  • Agree on focused joint plans with each priority partner, including target accounts, customer problems, sellable offers, measurable outcomes, owners, and next steps

  • Identify promising new solution partner relationships and qualify them on customer access, strategic fit, delivery capability, and willingness to invest in a joint motion

  • Help partners turn their existing expertise and customer relationships into a clear path to working with Dust

Generate and progress partner-led opportunities

  • Work with partners and Dust Account Executives to identify, qualify, and advance partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities

  • Map stakeholders and account entry points, clarify the partner's role, and coordinate next steps across the customer, partner, and Dust teams

  • Support deal strategy, value articulation, and partner participation in sales cycles, escalating product, commercial, or delivery questions to the right teams

  • Maintain a reliable view of partner pipeline, deal progress, risks, and expected contribution in Dust's CRM and reporting processes

Enable partners to sell and support Dust

  • Run practical partner onboarding and enablement so partner teams can explain Dust, identify relevant use cases, and participate confidently in customer conversations

  • Coordinate product, sales, and deployment guidance with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partner Delivery; help partners become increasingly self-sufficient without taking on delivery ownership

  • Share relevant customer stories, use cases, and sales materials, and identify gaps in the enablement partners need to move opportunities forward

  • Help partners understand how Dust connects to customer systems and supports teams using multiple AI models and agents

Build a repeatable solution partner motion

  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm with partners, including pipeline reviews, business reviews, action tracking, and timely escalation of blockers

  • Monitor partner activation, qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, closed revenue, and partner readiness; use the evidence to focus time and investment

  • Identify patterns in successful partner-led deals and feed practical recommendations into the broader Partnerships and GTM teams

  • Surface customer and partner feedback from the French market to inform positioning, offers, enablement, and go-to-market priorities

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, channel sales, business development, or commercial account management in B2B SaaS or a related technology business

  • A track record of creating measurable commercial outcomes through partners, such as qualified pipeline, co-sell opportunities, partner activation, or revenue

  • Strong understanding of the French B2B partner ecosystem, including consultancies, systems integrators, and implementation partners, with the ability to qualify them on customer access and fit

  • Fluent French and professional English, with the ability to lead partner and customer conversations in both languages

  • Commercial judgment and operating discipline: you can prioritize a partner portfolio, build actionable joint plans, manage a pipeline, and maintain clear follow-through

  • Confidence coordinating multi-party sales opportunities and aligning external partners with internal sales and technical teams

  • Strong communication and enablement skills: you can make a technical product understandable and help others present its value credibly

  • A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, takes ownership, raises risks early, and builds practical processes as the motion develops

  • Curiosity about AI and a willingness to use agents and AI tools to improve how you work

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with digital transformation agencies, AI consultancies, regional systems integrators, or implementation partners

  • Experience activating solution partners and progressing partner-sourced or partner-influenced opportunities in France

  • Familiarity with AI agents, enterprise software, SaaS integrations, or technology-enabled consulting and delivery

  • Existing relationships with relevant French solution partner firms

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct commercial impact: Your work will contribute to qualified pipeline, partner-led opportunities, and revenue in France

  • A focused growth mandate: Activate assigned new and existing French Tier 1 solution partners that are not yet strategic, with clear prioritization and commercial accountability

  • Cross-functional ownership: Connect partners with the right Dust commercial, technical, and delivery teams to make joint opportunities actionable

  • Room to build: Help shape a repeatable way for partners to introduce, sell, and support Dust as the ecosystem grows

  • A fast-moving category: Work with a product and market that are evolving quickly, alongside a team that values customer outcomes, accountability, and practical execution

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Theodo x BPI France
jobs.description:
Account Manager - Theodo x BPI France
L’histoire de Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.

Le poste

Partenaire de Bpifrance depuis 2019, Theodo accompagne ses équipes digitales, IT et métiers sur des projets de développement logiciel, Data, IA et Cloud. Aujourd'hui, le compte représente :

  • 20 M€ de chiffre d'affaires annuel en moyenne sur les trois dernières années, soit environ 20 % de l'activité de Theodo.
  • 100 à 120 Theodoers, répartis dans une vingtaine d'équipes.
  • Des projets variés : plateformes digitales, outils métiers, Data, Cloud et IA, dont la construction d'une usine agentique.

La relation entre Theodo et Bpifrance entre dans une nouvelle phase, avec un contrat de trois ans en cours de finalisation et trois priorités :

  • Développer le compte auprès de nouveaux interlocuteurs, notamment dans les métiers du financement, de l'investissement et de l'innovation.
  • Élargir nos interventions, notamment sur les sujets Data et IA.
  • Structurer les opérations commerciales pour mieux anticiper les besoins, piloter le staffing et suivre la performance du compte.


Tes missions

1. Développer le business chez Bpifrance

  • Rencontrer les interlocuteurs des équipes digitales, IT et métiers pour comprendre leurs enjeux et identifier de nouvelles opportunités.
  • Développer ton réseau au sein de Bpifrance, en coordination avec les relations commerciales existantes.
  • Transformer les besoins identifiés en propositions commerciales, avec la KAM et les équipes techniques.
  • Participer aux ventes de bout en bout : qualification, construction de l'offre, négociation et closing.

    • 2. Piloter et développer ton périmètre client

  • Devenir l'interlocuteur commercial de référence de plusieurs équipes Bpifrance.

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer (NL)
jobs.description:
Reliability Engineer (NL)

Functie  Reliability engineer

 

Beschrijving functie

 

De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets.  De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden.

 

De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. 



Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken.

 

  • Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem

  • Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn.

  • Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf.

  • Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren.

  • Foutenboom analyse: onderzoek van een systeem fout door naar de kleinere voorafgaande gebeurtenissen te kijken die hebben bijgedragen aan de systeem fout



    • Taken

    1. Trouble shooting

      1. Faciliteren van root cause analyse in geval van complexe, multidisciplinaire afwijkingen/storingen waar de uitvoerende teams niet uitkomen

      2. Daily problem solving

    2. Continue verbeteren

      1. Periodieke analyse op performance killers en cost drivers om van daaruit middels verbetervoorstellen bij te dragen aan een maximale beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid van installaties tegen minimale kosten

      2. Innovatief denken m.b.t. het verlagen van de kosten en verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid

      3. Leiden/faciliteren van verbeterteams c.q. verbeterprojecten

    3. Change Management

      1. Beoordelen van wijzigingen op technische haalbaarheid met het bestaande machinepark. Vanuit procurement komen verzoeken op het gebied van grondstof wijzigingen ( andere leverancier, andere specificaties ed.) 

      2. Begeleiden van proeven vanuit de technische kant op de machines

      3. Installatie nieuwe machines / introductie nieuwe producten 

    4. Technische beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid

      1. Evalueren van preventief onderhoud en voorstellen doen ter verbetering met als doel het verhogen van de beschikbaarheid van het machinepark

      2. Het verlagen van onderhoudskosten door het optimaliseren van onderhoudsconcepten en doorvoeren van technische verbeteringen.

    5. Investeringsprojecten

      1. Participeren in investeringsprojecten om de onderhoudbaarheid te borgen en het inregelen van onderhoud en spare parts.

      2. Inbrengen van technische kennis en ervaringen.

      3. Toezien op naleving van de standaard op gebied van onderdelen en installaties.

    6. Onderhoudsstrategie bepalen

      1. Opstellen van effectieve onderhoudsconcepten zodat onderhoud van de installaties op de meest efficiënte en effectieve manier kan worden gerealiseerd tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten

      2. Borgen van compliance; het inregelen van wettelijke inspecties en keuringen  en toezien op tijdige uitvoering daarvan.

    7. Beheren van de Standard Operating Procedures voor de installaties (SOP)

      1. Schrijven van nieuwe SOP’s, inclusief autonoom onderhoud

      2. Herzien van SOP’s als gevolg van proces verbeteringen en aanpassingen

    8. Bewaken standaarden voor veiligheid en kwaliteit

      1. Uitvoeren van risico assessments

      2. Borgen dat processen voldoen aan veiligheids standaarden en kwaliteits standaarden.

      3. Uitvoeren van optimalisatie testen.

      4. Ontwikkelen van best practice  die de productkwaliteit borgen

jobs.title: Afstudeerstage technische bedrijfskunde: energietransitie en energie-armoede
jobs.description:
Afstudeerstage technische bedrijfskunde: energietransitie en energie-armoede

Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer.

Eindelijk kun je de theorie in de praktijk toepassen: jij hebt er zin in, en wij ook! Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam krijg jij de kans om midden in de actie te staan. Geen koffie halen of papierwerk, jij duikt samen met onze projectleider in de praktijk van energietransitie en energie-armoede. Of het nu gaat om het uitvoeren van inspecties of meedenken over interventies: jij maakt impact.

Dit wordt jouw stage 

Wil jij meedenken over een maatschappelijk vraagstuk dat steeds urgenter wordt? Tijdens deze stage duik je in het thema energiearmoede: wat is het precies, waar speelt het en wat betekent dit voor ons als organisatie? Je werkt op het snijvlak van sociaal en technisch en helpt ons om richting te bepalen: hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Je werkt mee binnen één van onze teams en wordt begeleid door een ervaren collega. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om echt impact te maken. Op dit moment hebben wij één afstudeerstageplek rondom het thema energietransitie en energie-armoede 

 

Wat ga je doen? 
Je gaat onderzoeken wat energiearmoede inhoudt en hoe dit zich uit in de praktijk, met name in stedelijke gebieden zoals Amsterdam waar veel (sociale) huurwoningen zijn. 

Je houdt je bezig met: 

  • Het in kaart brengen van wat energiearmoede betekent;  

  • Inzicht krijgen in waar het speelt en welke doelgroepen geraakt worden; 

  • Gesprekken voeren met corporaties en marktpartijen (interviews, ophalen van ervaringen en data); 

  • Onderzoeken welke oplossingen er zijn, zoals passief bouwen, minder installaties of slimme energieoplossingen; 

  • Vertalen van jouw inzichten naar een duidelijke visie: waar moeten wij ons op richten en hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? 

 

Het gaat hierbij niet om de techniek alleen, maar juist om de combinatie van sociale impact, marktontwikkelingen en strategie. 

Dit is jouw team

Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam is een ontwikkelende bouwer met zo'n 220 enthousiaste collega’s. Wij zijn onderdeel van de Divisie Bouw en Vastgoed en herkenbaar in groen en geel. Onze ambitie is groot en met veel enthousiasme ontwikkelen en bouwen we gezonde en fijne leefomgevingen, waar mensen zich thuis voelen. Benieuwd waar wij ons mee bezig houden? Bekijk hier een paar van onze huidige projecten: Projecten Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam


Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week;

  • Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven;

  • Tijd voor je schoolopdrachten/examens;

  • De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer;

  • Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan!

 

Dit breng je mee 

  • Je doet een hbo- of wo-studie in de richting van bouwkunde, built environment, duurzaamheid, technische bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare studie; 

  • Nieuwsgierigheid naar veiligheid in de praktijk, vooral in de bouwsector;

  • Niet bang om je handen uit de mouwen te steken;

  • Proactief, sociaal en je werkt graag samen, maar weet ook zelfstandig je weg te vinden;

  • Beschikbaar vanaf februari 2027 voor minimaal 4 dagen per week.

 

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijnvisie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze Campus recruiter!

Heb je nog overige vragen? Schroom niet om contact op te nemen met Sanne Jonk via 06 34955966 of  

Hopelijk spreken we elkaar snel!

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Security Engineer

Security Engineer - Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Security Engineer. Iemand die veel energie krijgt van het opbouwen van een nieuw technisch securitydomein. Een gedreven specialist die graag zelf de regie neemt over de inrichting van moderne tooling en veilige architectuur.

Jouw rol

Als Security Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de technische beveiliging van onze infrastructuur, interne werkplekken en cloudomgevingen. Je bouwt het securitydomein verder uit en selecteert de juiste tooling voor Dawn. Je beheert de gekozen systemen en richt deze tot in de puntjes in. Daarbij vertaal je complexe techniek naar een gedegen en onderbouwd advies voor verschillende afdelingen. Je vormt hiermee de verbindende brug tussen tech leads, hostingteams en Interne IT. Beleid en compliance pakt het ISO-team op, zo kun jij je volledig op de techniek focussen.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Je werkt mee aan en verbetert centrale security-tooling zoals EDR en SIEM.

  • Je werkt hands-on aan kwetsbaarhedenbeheer, actieve detectie, monitoring en het ontwerpen van hardening-standaarden.

  • Je adviseert tech leads en hostingteams over veilige architectuur en helpt hen bij security-initiatieven.

  • Je fungeert als het vaste technische aanspreekpunt voor het SOC en beoordeelt samen escalaties.

  • Je draait mee in de technische analyse bij incidenten en bewaart de rust binnen het crisisteam.


Wie ben jij?

Je hebt een hbo-denkniveau en bij voorkeur een achtergrond in Cyber Security of Informatica. Je brengt een stevige basis mee in security engineering of infrastructuurbeveiliging. Je bezit hands-on ervaring met moderne security controls, IAM, secure configuration en kwetsbaarhedenmanagement. Kennis van cloudomgevingen zoals AWS en affiniteit met netwerkarchitectuur is een grote pré.

Je bent zeer leergierig naar nieuwe technieken en toetst gemaakte keuzes altijd scherp en kritisch. Je zoekt actief de verbinding met collega's om samen de beveiliging naar een hoger niveau te brengen. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels en bent bereid om (hybride) te werken op onze kantoren in Geldermalsen en Hilversum.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: Je beveiligt cruciale systemen voor Dawn Technology en haar klanten.

  • Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.500,- en €6.000,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om volop te ontspannen.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Gezellige werksfeer, flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en verzorgde lunch op kantoor (verschillende locaties maar je bent voornamelijk te vinden in Geldermalsen en Hilversum).

  • Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding en een fiscaal fietsplan.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen, van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit op deze rol, nodigen we je juist uit om te solliciteren. We denken namelijk graag met je mee! Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment om de match met de rol objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.

jobs.title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support (Detachering / ZZP)
jobs.description:
Product Owner Werkplek & Support (Detachering / ZZP)

Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. 

Wie ben jij

Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.

 
Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.

 
Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.

 
Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.

 
Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers.


Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat.

Wat ga je doen

Wat breng je mee?
Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen.

•    Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;   

Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen;
•    Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn;
•    Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee;
•    Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren;
•    Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn;
•    Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving;
•    Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is;
•    Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré.

Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening.

Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is?

We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.

 
•    ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support;
•    prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen;
•    vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten;
•    richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening;
•    sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid;
•    onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen;
•    afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams;
•    samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren;
•    signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren;
•    richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur;
•    kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;
•    organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.
 

Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan.

Wat bieden wij

Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie.

Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf.

Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie.

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. 


IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.
Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner.
Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken.

Director, Client Analytics Partnerships

StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

The Director, Client Analytics Partnerships is responsible for shaping the future of strategic measurement at StackAdapt. This leader will transform client analytics from a reporting function into a strategic advisory organization that helps clients make better business decisions before, during, and after every campaign.

This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, analytics, product innovation, and organizational leadership. You'll partner directly with executive stakeholders, influence the direction of our measurement capabilities, and build a team recognized for its expertise, curiosity, and ability to solve complex business problems.

You'll also lead analytics strategy across StackAdapt's priority growth verticals, including B2B, Commerce, Political, Enterprise, and HoldCos. That means becoming an expert in how these industries measure success, anticipating where they're headed, and helping both clients and internal teams stay ahead of those changes.

StackAdapt is a remote-first company; however, for this position, we are prioritizing candidates based in the Eastern or Central US to allow for regular, in-person collaboration with key clients.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Lead and grow a team of Client Analytics Partners, setting the vision for how strategic measurement is delivered across the organization.
  • Evolve the team from a reporting function into a trusted advisory practice that helps clients make smarter business decisions through measurement, experimentation, and analytics.
  • Partner with executive stakeholders, internally and externally, to develop long-term measurement strategies that align business objectives, marketing investments, and platform capabilities.
  • Help clients establish measurement strategies at the beginning of engagements by defining success metrics, testing plans, learning agendas, and business outcomes before campaigns launch.
  • Develop scalable frameworks that increase measurement maturity, helping clients evolve from foundational reporting to advanced optimization and business impact.
  • Define how success is measured for the organization through client adoption, strategic influence, business outcomes, executive engagement, retention, and meaningful product feedback.
  • Own analytics strategy for StackAdapt's priority verticals by developing deep expertise, staying ahead of industry changes, and translating those insights into practical guidance for clients and internal teams.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive client stakeholders, balancing StackAdapt's perspective with industry trends to help clients make confident, informed decisions.
  • Invest in the growth of your team through coaching, mentorship, and hands-on partnership. Lead by example, sharing knowledge openly and helping others build confidence in both technical expertise and executive consulting.
  • Build repeatable frameworks, playbooks, and best practices that allow the team to deliver consistently high-quality strategic guidance at scale.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Reporting Architecture, Data Architecture, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to influence future measurement capabilities and improve how we support clients.
  • Lead the team in adopting AI as a natural part of everyday work, using it to improve research, insight generation, communication, documentation, and operational efficiency while reserving human expertise for the moments where it matters most.
  • Continuously improve how the organization operates by identifying opportunities to simplify work, remove friction, automate repetitive tasks, and create more capacity for strategic thinking.
  • Anticipate what's next by evaluating industry trends, evolving client needs, emerging technologies, and organizational priorities to help the team stay ahead of the market.

What You'll Bring to the Table

  • 10+ years of experience leading analytics, measurement, consulting, or client strategy teams.
  • Experience building and scaling high-performing organizations through thoughtful leadership, clear vision, and a commitment to developing people.
  • Deep expertise in digital measurement, experimentation, attribution, marketing analytics, and performance measurement.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect analytics to meaningful business decisions and executive conversations.
  • Experience partnering directly with senior executives and becoming a trusted advisor on complex business challenges.
  • Expertise in Enterprise, B2B, Commerce, Ecommerce, HoldCos, or similar industries, or a demonstrated ability to quickly become a subject matter expert.
  • Demonstrated success building frameworks, methodologies, or consulting approaches that improve client outcomes and organizational effectiveness.
  • AI fluency. You naturally incorporate AI into how you research, solve problems, communicate, and lead teams. You're excited to experiment with new capabilities, share what works, and help others become more effective without losing sight of the human relationships that define great consulting.
  • A builder's mindset. You enjoy creating new capabilities, improving how work gets done, and leaving teams stronger than you found them.
  • A collaborative leadership style. You build trust through action, invite different perspectives, give credit generously, and raise the quality of work by making the people around you better.

jobs.title: Sales & Operations Specialist, RC Capital
jobs.description:
Sales & Operations Specialist, RC Capital

RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The Role

RC Capital is RevenueCat's first move into financial services. Our first product, Early Payouts, gives developers access to App Store proceeds without waiting the usual 30 to 60 days for Apple and Google to pay them.

As Sales & Operations Specialist, RC Capital, you will own the customer lifecycle end-to-end - from identifying and qualifying suitable prospects through screening, onboarding, activation, ongoing support, account operations, and portfolio health. You will combine commercial judgment, customer care, operational discipline, and risk awareness to help RC Capital acquire and serve more healthy customers.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role on a small founding team. You might move from a discovery call to an onboarding issue, a portfolio review, and a workflow improvement in the same day. You will work closely with Sales, Support, Product, Data, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and GTM Operations, and report to the VP of Strategy & Operations. You will also help build the playbook and systems future teammates inherit.

What You'll Own:

  • Sales and qualification. Manage a portfolio of inbound and targeted outbound opportunities. Run discovery, assess product and customer fit, coordinate screening, handle objections, maintain momentum, and guide suitable prospects to a clear decision.

  • Onboarding and activation. Lead approved customers from decision to activated. Ensure customers understand how to use Early Payouts successfully.

  • Customer support and portfolio operations. Serve as a reliable point of contact for customers, including questions, disputes, and operational issues. Coordinate with RevenueCat Support and specialist teams, and own follow-through through resolution.

  • Risk-aware execution. Apply documented customer, fraud, and risk policies consistently; investigate issues; document decisions; monitor emerging patterns; and make sound recommendations. Escalate exceptions and regulated or high-impact decisions to the appropriate risk, legal, finance, or leadership owner.

  • Lifecycle performance and insight. Maintain a reliable view of pipeline, onboarding, support demand, usage, and portfolio health. Turn data into recommendations on funnel quality, conversion, time to activation, drop-off, retention, customer experience, and risk indicators. Bring structured customer insight to Product to inform roadmaps.

  • Systems, automation, and playbooks. Improve CRM, support workflows, internal handoffs, reporting, documentation, and automation. Use AI thoughtfully to reduce manual work and response times without weakening controls or customer trust. Partner with Marketing, Operations, Data, and Product on durable implementations.

  • Customer and growth. Partner with Marketing on focused acquisition and lifecycle experiments. Support marketing efforts like campaign execution, competitive analysis, and content that drives demand.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years in a high-ownership, customer-facing commercial or operations role spanning sales, account management, customer success, customer support, or customer operations.

  • A track record of moving opportunities through a commercial process and managing a meaningful volume of customer relationships with strong follow-through.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, lending, factoring, embedded finance, or another environment where customer growth and operational risk are closely connected.

  • 1-2 years of marketing or growth experience running campaigns or managing CRM-driven outreach.

  • Strong operational judgment: you clarify ownership, define next steps, document decisions, apply policy consistently, and recognize when an issue needs specialist review.

  • Analytical fluency across CRM, support, and analytics tools, with the ability to diagnose funnel or portfolio performance and recommend action.

  • Practical experience improving workflows with automation and AI, including judgment about where automation introduces unacceptable risk or a poor customer experience.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication: persuasive with prospects, clear during onboarding, calm in disputes, and concise with executives and cross-functional partners.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity on a small, autonomous team and working hours that meaningfully overlap with US time zones.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience with payment operations, underwriting, fraud and risk workflows, disputes, or compliance-adjacent processes.

  • Experience launching a new product, business line, or operating motion before the playbook was written.

  • Knowledge of mobile apps, developer products, subscriptions, or App Store economics.

  • Experience contributing to CRM or lifecycle campaigns, customer-facing content, or growth experiments.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Notion, Linear, Intercom or Zendesk, Slack, Zoom, and product analytics platforms.

What success looks like

In your first 30 days

  • Understand RC Capital's product, customers, unit economics, risk model, and role within RevenueCat.

  • Map the lifecycle from first signal through activation and live-account support.

  • Establish baseline reporting for pipeline quality, conversion, time to decision, time to activation, support demand, repeat usage, and portfolio health.

  • Shadow sales, onboarding, support, risk, and account reviews; then handle initial customer interactions with support.

  • Ship one concrete improvement to a workflow, report, playbook, or automation.

By 90 days

  • Independently own a portfolio from qualification and screening through onboarding and ongoing operations, escalating genuine exceptions appropriately.

  • Give the team a reliable view of pipeline, onboarding, support, usage, and portfolio performance, with recommendations rather than reporting alone.

  • Run a consistent cadence for opportunity follow-up, onboarding, live-account reviews, and issue resolution.

  • Ship workflow or automation improvements that reduce manual work or customer wait time without weakening controls.

jobs.description:
Technical Product Manager

About Keyfactor

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!

Title: Technical Product Manager, AgileSec

Location: United States; Remote

Experience: Mid-Level

Job Function: Product Management

Employment Type: Full-time

Industry: Computer and Network Security

About the position

The Product Manager will be responsible for owning designated AgileSec product domains across discovery, planning, execution, release readiness, adoption, and continuous improvement. This role works closely with customers, engineering, design, support, sales, alliances, and product leadership to identify opportunities, define requirements, deliver customer value, and measure business outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines strong product execution skills with customer empathy, analytical thinking, and a passion for creating intuitive user experiences within complex enterprise security environments. This individual will develop deep expertise in cryptographic posture management, enterprise cybersecurity, and emerging post-quantum cryptography initiatives while helping shape the future direction of the AgileSec platform.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Job Responsibilities

Product Management

  • Own assigned AgileSec capabilities through the full product lifecycle, from discovery and planning through release and adoption.
  • Gather and synthesize customer feedback, market trends, competitive intelligence, and product usage insights to identify opportunities and prioritize investments.
  • Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
  • Maintain and prioritize the product backlog in collaboration with engineering and product leadership.
  • Partner with engineering teams to evaluate feasibility, manage delivery risks, and ensure successful execution.
  • Monitor product adoption, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes to guide future roadmap decisions.

User Experience & Customer Engagement

  • Champion customer-centric design and usability across AgileSec workflows and experiences.
  • Partner with UX and engineering teams to simplify complex security workflows and improve overall user experience.
  • Participate in customer meetings, discovery sessions, design reviews, and roadmap discussions to validate customer needs and proposed solutions.
  • Ensure customer-facing communications accurately reflect product capabilities, lifecycle status, and approved commitments.

Product Launch & Ecosystem

  • Support release readiness, documentation reviews, product launches, and go-to-market activities.
  • Collaborate with partner and alliance teams on integrations with leading enterprise security platforms.
  • Contribute to AgileSec's cryptographic risk management and post-quantum cryptography initiatives.

Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Product Manager or in a similar role in product management.
  • Strong understanding of product development processes and agile methodologies.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to think strategically and make data-driven decisions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated ability to learn new tools, technologies, and concepts independently.
  • Comfort engaging with technical concepts such as PKI, cryptography, or enterprise security software, and working across Linux, Windows, and Kubernetes environments.
  • Experience with product management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, or similar.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience in PKI, cryptography, cybersecurity, or enterprise security software.
  • Experience using AI tools to drive measurable outcomes, such as backlog grooming, synthesizing customer feedback, or drafting PRDs/User Stories.

Travel Requirements.

Up to 10% travel time required.

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience. 

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas. 

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:  

  • Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.
  • Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.
  • Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support.
  • Competitive time off globally.
  • Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees.
  • DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology.
  • The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts.
  • Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays.
  • Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.
  • Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development.
  • Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings.

Our Core Values

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  

Trust is paramount.  

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.  

Customers are core.  

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.  

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.  

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.  

We deliver with agility.   

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.  

United by respect.   

Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.  

Teams make “it” happen.  

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.  

Keyfactor is a proud equal opportunity employer including but not limited to veterans and individuals with disabilities.

jobs.description:
Senior Renewal Manager - EMEA/APJ

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

As a Senior Renewal Manager, Enterprise at Chainguard, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the retention and long-term success of our largest and most strategic customers. You will own the renewal process for a defined book of high-value accounts, managing complex, multi-year, multi-product renewals from early planning through close while delivering a thoughtful, value-driven customer experience.

This role sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Sales, and Ops. You will partner closely with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers on every account: you own the renewal, CSMs own adoption and outcomes, and AEs lead expansion. Your work ensures renewal conversations start early, are grounded in the value customers have realized, and support Chainguard’s broader revenue and retention goals.

You will act as a trusted partner to customers, guiding renewal conversations with procurement, security leaders, and executives with clarity, empathy, and confidence. Strong business acumen, comfort with complex negotiation, and cross-functional leadership are essential, as each renewal carries significant revenue and requires coordination across many stakeholders.

What you’ll do:

  • Renewal Management: Own the end-to-end renewal process for a portfolio of enterprise customers, starting renewal planning 120+ days out and driving on-time renewals through account strategy, stakeholder engagement, and negotiation.
  • Value & Business Case: Partner with CSMs to build renewal business cases grounded in adoption, CVE reduction, and engineering time saved, and present them to economic buyers and executives.
  • Commercial Execution: Structure and negotiate multi-year terms, ramps, co-terms, and pricing changes, and coordinate with Finance, Legal, customer Procurement, and Deal Desk to ensure accurate and timely contract execution.
  • Account Team Partnership: Work with AEs to align renewals with expansion opportunities, so renewal and growth motions move together rather than compete.
  • Forecasting & CRM Hygiene: Maintain accurate renewal data in CRM, including forecasts, risks, and renewal status, to provide clear visibility and predictable outcomes.
  • Risk & Retention Strategy: Identify renewal risks early, including budget pressure, adoption gaps, stakeholder changes, and competitive threats, and lead cross-functional plans to mitigate churn and protect gross retention.
  • Process & Playbooks: Develop and refine enterprise renewal playbooks, including executive engagement and procurement navigation, to increase efficiency and improve on-time renewal rates.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as the escalation point for the most complex renewals, mentor other Renewal Managers, and help shape how the function scales across segments.

What we're looking for:

  • 7+ years of experience in B2B SaaS in renewals, account management, or sales, with direct ownership of six-figure customer contracts.
  • Track record of renewing large, multi-year enterprise agreements at or above value, including through competitive displacement attempts and budget pressure.
  • Proven ability to drive complex renewals with predictability and deliver against gross retention targets.
  • Experience negotiating multi-year agreements, pricing, and contract terms with enterprise procurement teams while maintaining strong customer relationships.
  • Comfort engaging senior stakeholders, including security, engineering, and procurement leaders.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex renewal cycles simultaneously.
  • Comfort generating quotes, preparing order forms, and maintaining CRM hygiene, ideally in Salesforce.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • High emotional intelligence, strong communication skills, and a proactive, problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to operate with full autonomy in a fast-paced, evolving environment and lead the build-out of new processes where needed.

Strongly Preferred:

  • Experience working with large enterprises in regulated industries such as financial services or healthcare
  • Experience in a high-growth or early-stage startup environment
  • Familiarity with security, DevSecOps, or developer-focused products
  • Passion for technology and cybersecurity

Pay Range: Up to 144,286 GBP 70/30 OTE

If your experience is close, but doesn’t fulfill all requirements, please apply. Chainguard is on a mission to build the best team. To achieve our goal, we are focused on hiring Chainguardians with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
  • We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
  • We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

  • Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
  • 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
  • ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
  • 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with Chainguard's Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Application Security Engineer - Agents platform
jobs.description:
Application Security Engineer - Agents platform

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenAgents is our platform for building and running conversational AI agents at scale. As our first Application Security Engineer embedded in the Agents team, you’ll make the secure way the easy way. You’ll build the security tooling and reusable primitives that let engineers ship securely by default.

This is a builder role. Expect to spend about 70% of your time building tools and internal systems, and the rest working with engineers, staying in sync with Core Security, and doing security research. More than half of the work is greenfield and most of it starts with you, you’ll spot the problems worth solving and own each solution from idea to production.

You will:

  • Build security primitives that are easy for engineers to adopt, starting from what you find when you audit the Agents codebase

  • Review new product work for security and feed what you learn back into shared tooling

  • Lead the major security improvements to the Agents platform, working closely with Core Security

  • Make sure Agents platform uses authn and authz controls correctly and building the guardrails that keep the platform from compromising on security best practices

  • Set the security bar for the Agents platform and make meeting it the easy path for product engineers

  • Work with engineers daily to help them ship fast and safely

Requirements

  • 5+ years in application security engineering at scale, covering secure design, vulnerability management and security tooling

  • Strong software engineering skills: you have built and shipped products end to end, in production-quality code

  • Fluency in Python, our main language. Golang or another language is fine if you can pick up Python quickly

  • Hands-on experience with authentication and authorization. Experience securing cross-service communication is a bonus

  • Experience with large-scale, customer-facing backend systems and enterprise-grade security

  • Clear communication and a real enjoyment of working with developers

  • A track record of owning delivery end to end

Bonus:

  • Security for AI and LLM applications

  • Cloud-native experience (AWS or GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, IAM, networking, Linux internals)

  • Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI, HIPAA)

  • Not required: Compliance certifications, incident response experience, a traditional security background, or prior domain knowledge. We care about what you have built and shipped, and open source work or conference talks are welcome evidence of that.

Location

jobs.title: Product Manager, Network & Accounts
jobs.description:
Product Manager, Network & Accounts

Product Manager; Network & Accounts

Location: Remote - United Kingdom United States, and Europe (France, Germany, Portugal)

About Worldly

Worldly is the world’s most comprehensive impact intelligence platform — delivering real data to businesses on impacts within their supply chain. Worldly is trusted by 40,000 global brands, retailers, and manufacturers to provide the single source of ESG intelligence they need to accelerate business and industry transformation.

Through strategic and meaningful customer relationships, Worldly provides key insights around supplier performance, product impact, trends analysis, and compliance. When a company wants to change how business is done, we enable that systemic shift.

Backed by a dedicated global team of individuals aligned by values, Worldly proudly operates as a public benefit corporation with backing from mission-aligned investors. Want to learn more? Read our story.

About the Role

Worldly's Network connects the brands and retailers who source goods, the suppliers who make them, and the verifiers who confirm the accuracy of supplier assessments. Brands use it to find and connect with their suppliers, and suppliers join to share assessments with the brands they work with. Every Worldly product, including the Higg Index, depends on the Network being accurate, because an assessment is only useful when it's attached to the right facility and visible to the right brand. The Network is also the foundation of Worldly's transparency and traceability work: a brand can only trace what it sources if every supplier and facility in the chain appears in the Network once, correctly.

This is a technical product role with a customer problem at the center of it. You will own the experiences that bring customers into the Network and keep them there:

  • Getting in: finding a company or facility, joining or claiming it for their Worldly account, and resolving duplicates and conflicting claims so each real-world entity has one trusted record.

  • Buying in: purchase, checkout and subscriptions.

  • Managing: accounts, users and access once a customer is in.

You will spend real time with brands, sourcing teams, suppliers, and our internal Customer Success teams to understand where these experiences help them achieve their goals and where they fall short, and you will set the measures that show whether they're improving.

You'll collaborate with product managers across Platform and Traceability, turning what customers need into clear requirements for the shared services behind the Network.

What You'll Do

  • Align teams and cross-functional partners so everyone understands what is being built (and why)

  • Translate product vision into initiatives, epics and stories

  • Run discovery with brands, suppliers, and Customer Success on how the Network is used; set and track KPIs

  • Cultivate backlog prioritization for your areas of focus

  • Write clear specs and plain-language definitions that engineers, CS, and customers can all use; support release planning and change management.

We'd Like to See

  • 5+ years of product management experience on technical or platform products

  • You can reason about data as a graph: entities, identifiers, and relationships. You have shipped onboarding, identity or account experiences where users must find, claim or de-duplicate records, and you know what it takes for a customer to trust a record

  • Comfortable reading data models and API contracts well enough to write precise requirements for platform teams and judge the trade-offs they propose

  • Deep customer focus: you spend time with the people who build and use supplier networks, you can explain a technical concept to a sourcing manager in plain language, and you decide from what customers do, not only what they say

  • Strong analytical skills; you define conversion, adoption and data quality metrics for the experiences you own and use them to prioritize

It Helps If You Have

  • Experience with entity resolution, de-duplication or master data products

  • Experience in apparel, footwear, or consumer goods supply chains: how brands source, who sits at each tier, and what brands and suppliers each need from a shared platform

  • Exposure to sustainability data such as the Higg Index, or to supplier registries and third-party entity data.

What We Can Offer You

  • Comprehensive benefits offerings. 90% employee premium and 75% spouse/dependent premium covered by Worldly.

  • Company-sponsored 401k with up to 4% match.

  • Incentive Stock Options

  • 100% Parental Paid Leave

  • Unlimited PTO

  • 13 company holidays

Life at Worldly

Our team is motivated to transform the way products are made. By helping our customers succeed in a new era of sustainable production, we are able to build technology that makes a difference on a planetary level.

Our team represents over 15 countries, and brings unique experiences from technology to farming to the table. Surround yourself with kind, enthusiastic, and dedicated people who put collaboration and growth at the center of our shared goals.

Benefits and Perks

  • Earn a competitive salary and performance-based bonuses. Get healthcare, retirement matching, and equity for US employees.

  • Use the office stipend to get the supplies you need. Combat zoom fatigue with no-meeting Fridays.

  • Flexible time off. Take the time you need to recharge. Our culture encourages team members to explore and rest to be their best selves.

  • We're remote, not lonely. Join the culture committee, coffee chats, or a variety of other interest groups.

Travel Notice

Roles at Worldly may require occasional travel to support business needs, including but not limited to team collaboration, customer engagement, or company events.

Equity Statement

We believe it’s essential to reflect the diversity of those we strive to serve. True innovation happens when everyone has room at the table, including the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. We’re dedicated to building a culturally and experientially diverse team that leads and works with empathy and respect.

Compensation Information

  • €86,000 - €105,000 Annually (EU/UK Range)

  • $120,000 -$135,000 USD Annually (US Range)

10% Annual Bonus Potential

Incentive Stock Option Package (for approved countries)

Work-From-Home Stipends

*Final compensation figures will be determined based on a wide variety of factors, including experience and location. These factors will be evaluated and considered by Worldly throughout the entirety of this process.

**For candidates located outside the U.S., the salary range listed in USD will be paid in the local currency equivalent at the time of offer using the then-current exchange rate.
