jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
Accounting Manager

At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses.

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.

Who We Are

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Accounting Manager is responsible for overseeing the daily accounting operations, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of financial data, and managing the accounting team. This role plays a critical part in ensuring financial integrity, compliance with relevant regulations, and timely financial reporting. The Accounting Manager will also work closely with senior management to provide insightful financial analysis and support strategic decision-making.

JOB DUTIES

  • Oversee general ledger activities, including month-end and year-end close processes, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.

  • Prepare and review monthly financial statements, management reports, and financial forecasts to provide actionable insights to senior management.

  • Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal regulations, including audits and adherence to Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).

  • Conduct research on complex accounting issues, including new accounting pronouncements, and assess their impact on the company’s financial statements. Provide guidance and recommendations for implementation of new standards (e.g., lease accounting, revenue recognition, etc.).

  • Implement and maintain a strong system of internal controls, ensuring accurate financial data and mitigating risks of fraud or error.

  • Prepare the accurate and timely recognition of revenue, ensuring compliance with revenue recognition standards (ASC 606).

  • Partner with sales and operations to ensure correct recording of revenue transactions.

  • Oversee AP/AR processes, ensuring timely and accurate invoicing, collections, and payments.

  • Oversee and monitor inventory accounting processes, including physical inventory counts, inventory reconciliations, and valuation methods.

  • Ensure proper cost of goods sold (COGS) calculations and reporting of inventory levels.

  • Ensure compliance with lease accounting standards (ASC 842), including maintaining accurate records of leases, calculating right-of-use assets, and lease liabilities, and ensuring proper amortization schedules.

  • Coordinate external audits and provide necessary documentation and support for the completion of audits.

  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation within accounting systems to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS

Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

  • 6+ years of total accounting experience preferably at a mid-sized or large public company

  • 4+ years public accounting experience

  • 2-3 years managing a team and/or multiple Accounting functions

  • Proficiency with accounting software (e.g., Netsuite) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Strong understanding of GAAP, particularly in areas like revenue recognition (ASC 606), lease accounting (ASC 842), and equity accounting.

  • Excellent organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

  • Strong analytical skills with a high level of accuracy in financial reporting and data management.

  • Ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve accounting discrepancies and process inefficiencies.

Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • CPA certified.

  • Experience with robotics or manufacturing companies.

  • Experience working in a newly public company is a significant plus.

  • Familiarity with SOX compliance and financial reporting for public companies is highly desirable.

Additional Information:

Location: Remote - San Francisco, Los Angeles, Denver, Austin Preferred

Full-Time USA

What Makes You Stand Out

jobs.title: Sr Manager, Enterprise Data Platform & Governance
jobs.description:
Sr Manager, Enterprise Data Platform & Governance

The Kestra team has over 400 years of experience in the external and internal cardiac medical device markets. The company was founded in 2014 by industry leaders inspired by the opportunity to unite modern wearable technologies with proven device therapies. Kestra’s solutions combine high quality and technical performance with a wearable design that provides the greatest regard for patient comfort and dignity. Innovating versatile new ways to deliver care, Kestra is helping patients and their care teams harmoniously monitor, manage, and protect life.

The Senior Manager, Enterprise Data Platform & Governance owns Kestra’s enterprise data platform and the standards that govern how data is used across the company. Reporting to the CIO, this role leads the transition to Microsoft Fabric, defines the enterprise data architecture, and operationalizes the Master Data Management (MDM) program. The role sets the rules, certified data models, and guardrails that allow analysts embedded in business functions to build their own reports and insights safely and consistently. This is a platform and governance leadership role, not a report development role. The Senior Manager directs outsourced engineering, administration, and development resources today, with the opportunity to build an internal team as the platform matures and serves as a trusted advisor to functional leaders as Kestra builds the governed data foundation required for AI, automation, and its evolving enterprise systems.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES:
Data Platform and Architecture

  • Own the design, implementation, and operation of the enterprise data platform, including the Microsoft Fabric transition plan from the current Azure-based environment.
  • Define and maintain the enterprise data architecture, including Lakehouse design, semantic models, data ingestion patterns, and environment strategy across development, test, and production.
  • Manage platform capacity, performance, reliability, and cost, and recommend licensing and capacity adjustments to the CIO.
  • Maintain continuity of enterprise analytics as source systems evolve, including Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and Bonafide, and retire legacy custom reports as they are rebuilt on certified models by functional analysts or delivery resources.
  • Prepare the data platform for AI and automation use cases, including Microsoft Copilot experiences, such as Copilot in Fabric and Power BI and Microsoft 365 Copilot, on governed semantic models, and data products that support embedded insights within business workflows.

Master Data Management

  • Operationalize the MDM program, including master data domains, ownership, stewardship processes, data quality rules, and supporting tools.
  • Partner with functional data owners to establish and sustain stewardship roles and data quality metrics.
  • This role sets enterprise data standards, definitions, quality rules, and controls; data owners decide on the content, quality thresholds, and access for their domains within those standards.

Data Governance and Self-Service Enablement

Embedded Software Engineer

About us

Salience Labs is developing optical circuit switching technology for AI infrastructure, aimed at significantly reducing latency and cost in data centre networks. As we move towards real-world deployment, you’ll have genuine ownership of your area, working alongside a highly technical team of physicists, engineers and software specialists on one of the hardest problems in AI infrastructure.

Job Overview

As an Embedded Software Engineer at Salience Labs, you’ll be right at the centre of our photonics product development. This role spans low-level firmware, rapid prototyping, and systems integration, giving you the chance to influence everything from proof-of-concept devices to our commercial platforms. You’ll collaborate across hardware, photonics, and FPGA teams to ensure smooth, efficient embedded software development, right down to the register level and all the way up to application-facing tools.

This is a full-stack embedded role, where versatility and curiosity are just as important as technical depth. We’re looking for engineers who enjoy working close to the metal, but can just as easily contribute to user-facing tools and test infrastructure. You’ll be part of a small, fast-paced team where autonomy is encouraged and impact is tangible.

What you’ll be doing

  • Design, implement, and document embedded software across a variety of project scales

  • Work closely with hardware and FPGA teams to build robust embedded systems

  • Use off-the-shelf development kits for rapid prototyping and system testing

  • Select, tailor, and integrate open-source applications and embedded frameworks

  • Collaborate with the Systems Test team to support test automation and data capture

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience developing embedded software in C or C++

  • Strong problem-solver with clear analytical thinking and communication skills

This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives on building, testing, and iterating in real hardware environments. jobs.title: Photonics Design Engineer - III/V Components
jobs.description:
Photonics Design Engineer - III/V Components

About us

Salience Labs is developing optical circuit switching technology for AI infrastructure, aimed at reducing latency and cost in data centre networks. As we move towards deployment, you’ll have real ownership of your area and work alongside a highly technical team on a hard problem in AI infrastructure.

The role

You’ll join a multi-disciplinary research team in the UK to contribute to the development of III-V active components for integration with silicon photonics. You will help take devices from epitaxial stack and device design through fabrication with external partners, to characterisation, reliability and qualification.

What you’ll be doing

  • Contribute to the design and modelling of III-V active devices, including epitaxial layer structure, gain and power modelling, optical mode design, and electrical and thermal design

  • Help define device specifications for your area, translating system requirements into device design and integration targets

  • Contribute to mask design and tape-outs, including GDS layouts, test structures and design-of-experiment splits

  • Support fabrication runs with external epitaxy and foundry partners: follow process flows, review process and in-line data, and help resolve yield issues as the technology scales

  • Contribute to the characterisation strategy at wafer, chip and integrated-PIC level, including building and automating test setups

  • Analyse test data, correlate measured performance with design and process variations, and support design iterations to close performance gaps

  • Work with packaging and reliability engineers on burn-in, accelerated ageing, failure analysis and qualification

  • Share knowledge with colleagues and support the onboarding of new team members as the team grows

Essential requirements

  • PhD in physics, photonics, electrical engineering, optical engineering or a related subject with 2+ years’ relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 4+ years’ relevant experience, including at least 2 years’ hands-on development of III-V optical amplifiers or semiconductor lasers, preferably in industry

  • Experience contributing to taking III-V devices from concept through design, fabrication and test, ideally including exposure to qualification

  • Good understanding of semiconductor laser and amplifier physics: optical gain, carrier dynamics, quantum-well design, noise, gain saturation and nonlinearities, thermal effects and polarisation dependence

  • Hands-on knowledge of III-V epitaxy and fabrication processes (e.g. MOCVD/MBE growth, lithography, etching, passivation, metallisation, facet/AR coating), and experience working with external foundries

  • Experience characterising amplifiers or lasers, including optical spectrum analysis, gain and noise measurement, wafer-level probing, temperature-controlled testing and test automation

  • Experience with simulation and layout tools for photonic devices, such as Lumerical, Photon Design, Crosslight, RSoft, COMSOL, KLayout, L-Edit or Cadence Virtuoso

  • Ability to work effectively with colleagues across design, process, test and packaging functions

  • Excellent communication skills, critical thinking, attention to detail and self-motivation

Nice to have

  • Experience integrating III-V active devices with silicon photonics, including coupling design between III-V and silicon waveguides

  • Experience mentoring or supervising junior engineers or students

  • Experience with reliability testing and failure analysis of III-V devices

  • Experience developing PDK building blocks or compact models for active devices

  • Programming experience (Python, MATLAB or C++) for simulation, test automation and data analysis

  • Knowledge of photonic packaging, including fibre coupling, thermal design and TEC control

  • A track record of high-quality patents and research papers

Art Director, Brand & Marketing Design

Art Director, Brand & Marketing Design

About the Role

Finom is building a brand that European entrepreneurs recognise and trust, and right now the visual side of that brand needs an owner.

We are looking for an Art Director to lead our Marketing Design team and take ownership of Finom's visual identity end to end. Not marketing design in isolation: the brand system itself, the guidelines behind it, and how consistently it shows up everywhere Finom appears.

You are joining at a genuine inflection point. Finom is growing fast, helping entrepreneurs around Europe take their businesses to the next level. We have over 200k users with ambition for millions more. Meanwhile, our customers rate us 4.8 on Trustpilot, the only business banking app above 4.7.

Our ambition brings with it a unique set of challenges. Your job will be twofold: raise the creative bar, and build the system that lets a team deliver at volume without the quality dropping.

Your first months will be as much about diagnosis as creation: auditing the existing identity, understanding where the current team and workflows are working or falling short, and putting the foundations in place for what comes next. From there, you'll help determine and lead the next evolution of Finom's visual identity.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will direct and mentor, and you will also design, setting the visual benchmark yourself, not just reviewing other people's work against it. You will work in close partnership with our VP of Product Design, so that the brand reads as one across marketing, product, and the entire brand experience.

Finom is building an AI-native production pipeline, and we want a creative leader who is already fluent in it. Not someone curious about AI, someone who has shipped with it and can design the workflows, quality gates and brand guardrails that make AI output genuinely good rather than merely fast.

What You Will Be Doing

•  Own Finom's visual identity (the brand system, guidelines, design systems and documentation) and drive consistent adoption across every team and touchpoint, including teams that produce assets outside your own

•  Set and hold the creative bar. Shape visual direction across channels and make consistency and quality non-negotiable

•  Lead and develop the existing Marketing Design team, assess its capabilities and future shape, and determine where additional permanent, freelance or AI-enabled capacity is needed

•  Define the design requirements for intake, briefing, prioritisation, SLAs and review, working with Brand Operations and Marketing Operations to turn them into scalable processes

•  Design and direct high-quality visual and motion assets that bring the brand to life, personally setting the benchmark for the wider team

•  Build the AI-native production pipeline: define where AI accelerates the work, where it doesn't, and what quality and brand-integrity gates it has to pass. Create the templates, systems and tools that let both designers and AI workflows execute independently

•  Provide creative direction at the front of significant projects (the creative kickoff, the concept, the narrative) rather than reviewing work once it's already been produced

•  Direct the creation of mood boards, design references, scamps, storyboards and animatics to communicate creative intent

•  Partner with Marketing, Product, copywriters and strategists to develop campaigns across digital-first channels (social, web, video), with the ability to stretch into ATL where the moment calls for it

•  Own projects from concept through delivery, and run multiple parallel workstreams without letting standards slip

•  Build and present creative work to senior stakeholders, articulating rationale clearly enough to guide decisions

•  Manage a flexible pool of freelance and external creative partners to absorb peaks in demand

•  Act as guardian of the visual identity while continuously pushing where the brand can be braver

Who You Are

•  A genuinely strong designer. Other designers respect your work and want to learn from you; that's the bar, and it isn't optional for this role

•  Strong design taste, and able to articulate how it impacts the business. You can tell excellent from generic and explain precisely why, in terms a non-designer can act on

•  A builder of process as much as a maker of work. You believe high volume and high quality are compatible, and you have the systems thinking to prove it

•  Customer-obsessed in how you approach brand: your creative decisions trace back to what the audience actually responds to, not to internal taste

•  Comfortable with ambiguity. Finom is moving fast, the setup is being built as you go, and you find that energising rather than exhausting

•  A generous leader who elevates people, gives direct feedback, and turns good work into exceptional work

•  Confident with senior stakeholders without becoming a bottleneck for them

Must-Haves

•  8+ years as a graphic or brand designer, ideally in fast-moving, brand-led environments

•  4+ years as a design leader with direct responsibility for a team of three or more

•  Experience building customer-facing technology brands or consumer digital products at scale. Your portfolio should show how strong visual craft works alongside usability, clarity and commercial objectives

•  A track record of building and evolving brand systems across campaigns, products or businesses, including ownership of key visual directions

•  A standout portfolio showing strategic thinking, creativity and polished execution across visual design, motion, editorial, digital and social formats

•  Clear examples of work where you led or directed other creatives

•  Demonstrated AI design fluency, with evidence of AI-native production rather than occasional AI assistance: workflows you built, quality standards you set, output you shipped

Nice-to-Haves

•  Experience with sponsorship, partnership or event-led brand work at scale

•  Motion design depth, or experience directing motion specialists

•  Experience partnering closely with a product design function on a shared brand system

A Place for Mom (APFM) is seeking a strategic, results-driven Principal Account Executive, Home Care to drive growth within the home care segment by developing and expanding partnerships with large home care franchise systems, multi-location operators, and corporate organizations that own or manage multiple home care agencies. In this enterprise sales “hunter” role, the Account Executive builds the APFM value story to win the corporate order top-down. This role is responsible for engaging executive-level stakeholders to secure corporate partnerships and large-scale orders while increasing agency participation, referral volume, and network capacity across affiliated locations.

The Principal Account Executive will take a consultative, enterprise-focused approach to selling, navigating complex organizational structures, and influencing stakeholders across corporate leadership, franchise business coaches, and individual franchise agencies. Success in this role is defined by establishing APFM’s value with strategic franchise accounts and landing corporate orders, which in turn grow APFM’s network capacity, participating agency penetration, and referral volume. To support the corporate sale, this individual will also work closely with Home Care Acquisition Managers (HCAMs), who drive grassroots adoption and agency-level sales, and Customer Success Managers (CSMs), who lead agency-level onboarding, enablement, and retention, to accelerate selling velocity, align corporate and local strategies, and expand APFM’s penetration across franchise and corporate networks.

The ideal candidate is a proven enterprise seller who combines a demonstrated history of consultative sales success with strong executive presence, analytical rigor, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams toward shared commercial objectives.

Responsibilities

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

Our VAIB team⭐

Making money work for everyone is what we do at Monzo, but it only counts if it works for the people who need support the most. Our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) team is dedicated to breaking down barriers across the bank. We make sure that whether a customer is vulnerable, disabled, excluded, or experiencing a bereavement, they get a product and a service that is empathetic, accessible, and built entirely with them in mind.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

As VAIB Strategy Analyst, you will play a critical role in fulfilling Monzo's mission to make money work for everyone by driving meaningful improvements for customers requiring additional support. Working collaboratively, you will leverage data, customer insights, and operational expertise to seamlessly embed vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion, and bereavement considerations into product and service design. You will take proactive ownership of complex strategic projects and use independent judgement to navigate ambiguous escalations, shape treatment strategies, and identify emerging risks. Ultimately, you will ensure that changes deliver equitable customer outcomes while maintaining strong standards of risk management, governance, and regulatory compliance.

  • Lead Strategic Delivery: Take ownership of complex VAIB workstreams, translating strategic priorities into clear delivery plans and driving improvements that balance customer needs, regulatory expectations, and operational goals.
  • Drive Data-Led Improvements: Analyze quantitative data, customer feedback, and operational insights to identify systemic barriers, proactively monitor outcomes, and develop evidence-based recommendations for strategic change.
  • Champion Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner seamlessly across Product, Engineering, and Operations to build VAIB awareness, influence decision-making, and embed inclusive considerations into the design of customer journeys and internal processes.
  • Navigate Complex Escalations: Act as the escalation point for complex, ambiguous customer or operational issues, applying strong independent judgement to recommend proportionate solutions when clear policy guidance is unavailable.
  • Own Governance and Risk: Manage control requirements for all strategic changes, ensuring work is rigorously assessed, documented, and governed to support informed decision-making and mitigate regulatory risk.
  • Coach and Build Capability: Strengthen the wider VAIB team by proactively sharing specialist knowledge, mentoring less experienced colleagues, and elevating overall analytical and strategic ways of working.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

VAIB experience is preferable but we'd also love to hear from you if you have any other regulatory background.
  • You have a proven ability to independently manage and deliver complex strategic initiatives, utilising quantitative data, customer insights, and operational feedback to investigate ambiguous challenges, resolve blockers, and implement practical solutions.

  • You are highly skilled in stakeholder management and communication, with the ability to clearly convey sensitive information, constructively challenge existing approaches, and drive alignment across Operations, Product, Risk, Data, and Engineering.

Senior Photonics Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Photonics Design Engineer

About us

Salience Labs is developing optical circuit switching technology for AI infrastructure, aimed at significantly reducing latency and cost in data centre networks. As we move towards real-world deployment, you’ll have genuine ownership of your area, working alongside a highly technical team of physicists, engineers and software specialists on one of the hardest problems in AI infrastructure.

Job Overview

This role will focus on the design, optimisation, and development of high performance photonic components for next generation Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs), contributing directly to our future tape-outs and core IP roadmap.

You will work closely with photonics designers, layout engineers, and testing teams to improve the performance of integrated photonic devices through theoretical analysis, simulation, modelling, and design innovation.

This is a highly technical role suited to someone who enjoys solving difficult physics and engineering problems in a collaborative deep-tech environment. You will take a lead role in the development of key building blocks within our optical switching and photonic systems roadmap, and other integrated photonic components critical to future high port count architectures.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the design and optimisation of integrated photonic components for silicon photonics and related PIC platforms

  • Perform electromagnetic simulations, modelling, and theoretical analysis to improve device performance

  • Validate simulation results against experimental measurement data

  • Develop innovative component designs informed by current research and emerging techniques

  • Collaborate with layout engineers to integrate components into PDK libraries and tape-out flows

  • Work closely with fabrication and testing teams to iterate on device performance

  • Lead the development roadmap for future photonic components and architectures

  • Drive long term improvements in PIC loss, manufacturability, and scalability

  • Lead technical discussions, design reviews, and cross functional problem solving

  • Mentor and guide other engineers in photonic design and simulation practice

  • Stay current with advances in integrated photonics through research literature and conferences

What we’re looking for

  • PhD, or equivalent industry experience, in Photonics, Physics, Optical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field

  • Typically 5+ years of relevant experience in integrated photonic device design, including taking designs through to tape-out and measurement

  • Strong theoretical understanding of guided optics and photonic device physics

  • Hands-on experience designing and simulating integrated photonic components

  • Experience working with silicon photonics or InP photonic platforms

  • Strong analytical and mathematical problem solving capability

  • A track record of meaningful technical contributions, whether through publications, patents, or shipped technology

  • Experience using photonic simulation tools and modelling workflows

  • Python programming experience for simulation, analysis, or automation

  • Deep understanding of Photonic IC design and fabrication flows

  • Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes

  • Experience working in commercial R&D or product development environments

  • Experience mentoring or technically guiding other engineers

  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail

  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary engineering teams

You will join a highly ambitious deep-tech company operating at the intersection of AI infrastructure, semiconductors, and photonics. We are building foundational technology with the potential to reshape the performance envelope of future AI systems.

Alongside a collaborative and research-driven environment, you will have the opportunity to work on genuinely difficult engineering problems with direct impact on product direction and company growth.

If you’re excited by integrated photonics, advanced device design, and solving hard engineering problems at the frontier of AI infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Photonics Characterisation Engineer
jobs.description:
Photonics Characterisation Engineer

The role

We are looking for a Photonic Characterisation Engineer to join our Photonics team and play a key role in the experimental characterisation of advanced integrated photonic devices.

This is a highly hands-on position where you will design and run experiments, operate optical test equipment, analyse measurement data and help turn experimental results into clear engineering insight. Your work will support teams across photonic design, manufacturing and system testing, helping ensure technical decisions are grounded in high-quality, repeatable data.

You will work across both die-level and wafer-level characterisation, combining practical laboratory work with Python-based data analysis and experimental automation. Over time, you will take increasing ownership of characterisation activities, from defining test approaches through to delivering results and communicating conclusions to stakeholders.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys being in the lab, working through difficult experimental problems and moving comfortably between optics, software and data.

What you'll be doing

  • Design and execute experiments to characterise integrated photonic devices and structures

  • Operate optical and photonic laboratory equipment across a range of measurement setups

  • Carry out die-level and wafer-level testing

  • Analyse experimental data using Python and relevant scientific computing tools

  • Develop scripts and workflows to automate data collection and analysis

  • Translate experimental requirements into practical, repeatable test methodologies

  • Identify measurement issues, investigate unexpected results and troubleshoot experimental setups

  • Validate data quality before results are used by wider engineering teams

  • Produce clear technical reports, analysis and summaries from experimental work

  • Collaborate closely with photonic design, manufacturing and system testing teams

  • Support the development and improvement of laboratory processes, test methods and automation

  • Take ownership of characterisation tasks and provide realistic timelines for delivery

As you develop in the role, you will be expected to work increasingly independently, building new test methods where required and taking experiments from initial planning through execution, analysis and communication of results.

What we're looking for

  • An MSc, PhD or equivalent practical experience in Physics, Photonics, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, or a closely related discipline

  • A strong understanding of optics and photonics fundamentals

  • Hands-on experience designing and running experiments

  • Experience working in an optics, photonics or similarly technical laboratory environment

  • Experience analysing real-world experimental data using Python

  • Familiarity with scientific Python libraries such as NumPy, SciPy or pandas

  • A practical understanding of experimental uncertainty, noisy data and measurement quality

  • Strong fault-finding and troubleshooting skills

  • The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team

  • Strong attention to detail and critical thinking

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills

  • The ability to present technical results clearly to different audiences

You should be comfortable spending a significant proportion of your time working physically in the laboratory. This is not primarily a theoretical or simulation-focused position.

Even better if you have

  • Experience working with photonic wafer-level test systems or probe stations

  • Experience with integrated photonic devices and their characterisation

  • Experience automating experimental setups or measurement equipment using Python

  • Familiarity with optical alignment, calibration and measurement techniques

  • Experience with free-space optics

  • Knowledge of photonic integrated circuit fabrication or semiconductor processes

  • Experience developing reusable experimental or data-analysis tools

  • Previous experience in an R&D or product development environment

  • Experience working in a startup or another environment where processes are still evolving

  • Familiarity with Agile ways of working, Jira or similar project-management tools

  • Experience communicating the same technical results to both specialist and non-specialist audiences

Relevant backgrounds might include photonics or optics R&D laboratories, integrated photonics research, experimental physics, electrical engineering, semiconductor development or related fields. The common thread is strong experimental judgement and the ability to turn physical measurements into trustworthy engineering conclusions.

This is an opportunity to work on genuinely challenging experimental problems in photonics while helping shape how characterisation is carried out as our engineering capability grows.

You will have access to advanced laboratory equipment, work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams and have meaningful ownership over both the experiments you run and how the wider characterisation capability develops.

The role is UK-based and predominantly on site, with a minimum of four days per week in the lab.

jobs.title: Senior Security Platform Engineer - Secure Delivery
jobs.description:
Senior Security Platform Engineer - Secure Delivery

Hi 👋🏻 I’m Louis, Head of Security. You’ll report directly to me.

What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you contribute to useful projects, make practical decisions, and work in an almost-no-meeting culture. The product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: tens of thousands of daily users who depend on our software, and customers whose trust your work will help us earn.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet.

You’ll join our Security team, a single team with multiple specializations overseeing security across the business. I report to Abhik, our Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re bubbling with ideas on how to support Talent Acquisition through software, and we’ve started the journey of building products beyond Talent Acquisition. We read every application and aim to respond to yours within 3-4 days (often sooner).

Role Overview

We’re looking for a platform engineer to build the secure-delivery capabilities other engineers use every day. You’ll turn security requirements into reliable integrations, useful feedback, and self-service workflows that work across our production repositories.

You’ll treat engineers as your users and own the operation of what you ship. You’ll use existing tools where they fit and build the capabilities that materially improve our delivery workflow.

About the Role and How We Work

We’re also advertising this opening as Senior DevSecOps Engineer. Both titles describe the same position; please apply once using the title that best reflects your experience.

Your mission is to make our delivery pipeline secure by default across application code, infrastructure, dependencies, containers, and product configuration. You’ll own the technical implementation and operation of delivery-security tooling and controls, including integration, configuration, tuning, reliability, and coverage.

Product Engineering teams own triage and remediation for the features they maintain. Application Security provides specialist analysis and defines product-security test requirements. Infrastructure retains ownership of the underlying cloud platform. You’ll work with those teams to make agreed checks and policies run reliably in the delivery workflow.

In practice, you’ll:

  • Deploy, configure, integrate, and tune static analysis, dependency, secret, container, and Infrastructure as Code scanning in our CI/CD workflows.

  • Inventory production repositories and delivery paths, including prompts and model configuration. Make scanner coverage distinct from application-specific tests of AI behavior; AppSec defines those tests, and you operate agreed delivery checks.

  • Start new checks in report-only mode where appropriate, then implement agreed warn and block policies using exploitability, exposure, and compensating controls.

  • Give engineers self-service exceptions within documented rules, with an owner, justification, expiry, and audit trail. Escalate decisions outside those rules to Security leadership with the relevant specialist analysis.

  • Build automation and AI-assisted workflows that enrich findings, propose fixes, and support Product Engineering’s triage under documented criteria. Preserve required checks, review, and rollback for automated patch changes.

  • Make coverage, integration failures, finding age by risk, time to triage and remediate, false blocks, build delay, and bypasses visible. Record mitigations separately from completed fixes and connect useful telemetry to GRC evidence.

  • Work with Infrastructure on cloud-posture monitoring, useful critical-misconfiguration alerts, and bounded remediation automation.

  • Extend into shared-image hardening and artifact provenance as the delivery foundations mature.

To ground it with examples, you could:

  • Roll out secret scanning with push protection and make a blocked push understandable and actionable for an engineer.

  • Turn a repeated scanner-exception request into a PR workflow with a reason, expiry, and evidence for revisiting it.

  • Reproduce a dependency issue in the application, add a regression check, and build a workflow that proposes a patch with useful evidence.

  • Show which delivery paths are covered, where checks fail, and whether enforcement is addressing risk while keeping build delays reasonable.

Why You Should and Shouldn’t Apply

You’ve built and operated CI/CD, developer tooling, or infrastructure automation used by other engineers. You can write maintainable code, explain the failure modes of what you shipped, and use security evidence to make a practical rollout decision. Supply-chain and scanner experience is useful; you can learn individual tools as part of the work.

You’ve applied AI in engineering and can explain how you check its outputs and permissions. You enjoy treating engineers as users, making build-versus-buy decisions, and improving adoption and reliability after launch.

You might not enjoy the role if:

  • You prefer to deliver a prototype and hand off its operation. Reliability, tuning, and existing integrations are part of the work.

  • You prefer a prescribed backlog to investigating an ambiguous problem, writing a proposal, and bringing partners into the work.

  • You want standalone assessments to be your main output. This role centers on working delivery capabilities and their adoption.

Interview Process

If this also sounds exciting to you, please apply. We review every application and aim to get back to candidates within 2-3 days. For candidates who advance to the interview process, here is what you can expect:

  • Recruiter Screen - 30 mins

  • Hiring Manager Intro Call - 20 mins

  • Past Projects Deep Dive - 45 mins

  • Founder Screening - 45 mins

  • Take-Home Assessment + Practical Assessment Review - 1 hr (2-3 spent on take-home assignment)

  • Cross-Functional Stakeholder Interview - 45 mins

Role-Specific Technology and Tools

For this role, CI/CD and infrastructure automation experience matter more than familiarity with a particular scanner. GitHub Actions or comparable systems, Terraform, containers, and cloud controls are relevant. You should be comfortable writing production automation in TypeScript, Python, Go, or a comparable language. Tool choices and individual scanner integrations are part of the work.

Your First Three Months at Ashby

Your early changes will give you a tour of our codebase, infrastructure, and best practices, increasing in scope and ambiguity as you learn how we work. You’ll pair program with your onboarding peer as you learn the delivery workflows.

Your initial focus will be to:

  • Map production delivery paths and gaps across code, infrastructure, prompts, configuration, and evals, with clear ownership of the different checks.

  • Deliver a bounded scanning integration, such as secret push protection or report-only static analysis, with a usable finding workflow.

  • Establish initial warn, block, and self-service exception rules with the relevant partners and make Product Engineering ownership visible.

  • Baseline coverage, integration failures, false blocks, and build delay so the next rollout has evidence to build on.

Early progress means engineers can use the selected checks, act on their findings, and handle routine exceptions. Broader rollout follows the agreed risk policy and what the first integration teaches us.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO, and we will encourage you to take it.

  • A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, covered by Ashby. The actual number may increase to satisfy local requirements.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • If you’re in the US, we offer top-tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high-quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.

Closing

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

jobs.title: Developer Relations Engineer
jobs.description:
Developer Relations Engineer

Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

Tailscale is looking for a Developer Relations Engineer to own and improve the developer experience across Tailscale’s expanding product portfolio. You’ll help developers understand, adopt, extend, and build with our core VPN/connectivity product, while also shaping how that experience evolves as Tailscale expands into new product areas like secure AI access (Aperture), privileged access management (PAM), and whatever comes next.

You’re a builder, investigator, and storyteller. You write code, chase technical curiosities all the way down, and turn what you learn into things other developers can use like demos, docs, talks, blog posts, sample apps, workshops, videos, tools, and open source contributions. You build things, break things, explain things, and keep going until the thing you’re working on has a name.

You’re comfortable speaking at conferences and just as comfortable digging through an API, a GitHub issue, or a weird networking edge case until it makes sense. You’re probably the kind of person who runs a local AI model in your homelab and can explain exactly why. You ask “why does it work that way?” often, and your instinct is to make the answer clearer, simpler, and better for the next developer.

Requirements

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with demonstrated experience building, debugging, and shipping real projects through professional work, open source, self-directed learning, or ambitious personal projects.
  • Ability to create clear, useful developer-facing materials, including code samples, demos, tutorials, docs, blog posts, videos, talks, and workshops.
  • Deep curiosity about how systems work, especially across networking, infrastructure, security, identity, cloud, open source, AI, or developer tooling.
  • A track record of building and explaining technical systems, such as production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, homelabs, local AI setups, networking experiments, or open source contributions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly, creatively, and practically.
  • Experience presenting to technical audiences, whether through conferences, meetups, livestreams, workshops, podcasts, videos, or internal engineering forums.
  • Comfortable working in public through GitHub issues, pull requests, community forums, social channels, open source projects, and developer feedback loops.
  • Strong developer empathy, emotional intelligence, and product sense; you notice friction, understand why it matters, and help translate it into better docs, APIs, examples, workflows, and product experiences.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing, support, community, and other technical stakeholders while operating independently and driving high-impact projects from idea to execution.
  • Comfortable managing multiple workstreams, meeting regular publishing, event, or launch deadlines, discussing technical tradeoffs in detail, and traveling for events, conferences, and community moments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Go, networking, VPNs, WireGuard, identity, access controls, infrastructure automation, or security products.
  • Experience building developer education programs, sample apps, workshops, technical video content, or conference talks.
  • A visible history of technical writing, talks, demos, open source contributions, or community work.
  • Experience with homelabs, self-hosting, local AI models, infrastructure experiments, or other “I wanted to understand how this works, so I built it” projects.
  • Familiarity with secure AI access, privileged access management, zero trust, or modern infrastructure security patterns.
  • Familiarity with open source contribution workflows and technical collaboration in public.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, whether gained through formal education, professional experience, open source work, self-directed learning, or building ambitious projects on your own.
  • A track record of building and explaining technical systems. This could include production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, open source contributions, homelab experiments, local AI setups, networking projects, or anything else that shows how you think.
  • If your background is less conventional, we still want to hear from you. Bring us your GitHub repos, blog posts, diagrams, configs, talks, demos, lab notes, or the deeply specific story of why your homelab is built the way it is.
  • Comfort discussing technical tradeoffs in detail such as explaining what you built, why you built it, what broke, what you learned, and what you would do differently next time.

jobs.description:
Marketing Manager, Integrated Search & Google Media

Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc

Your Role:

We are seeking an expert, data-driven Manager, Integrated Search & Google Media to own our paid search and Google media ecosystem while managing essential SEO and GEO strategies. In this role, you will also drive the strategy and execution across Google Ads, Bing Ads, YouTube and YouTube TV ads, and broader Google advertising properties.

As our primary Paid Search authority, you live and breathe Google Ads, master modern AI-driven campaign structures (Performance Max, Smart Bidding, AI creatives), and stay at the forefront of search evolution. You bring a deeply curious, proactive personality and a passion for experimentation - constantly testing new ideas, interrogating performance data, and willing to try bold new approaches to stay ahead of trends.

In addition to scaling our paid search and improving our ROI, you will manage critical SEO/GEO initiatives with direction and guidance from our Senior Manager, SEO/GEO and partner closely with our Performance Marketing Theater Leads - translating theater-based goals into execution-ready search strategies to generate awareness, create and capture demand that turns into pipeline, and holding accountability for regional numbers.

Your Opportunity:

Paid Search, Bing and Google Ecosystem

  • End-to-End Media Management: Own the strategy, launch, optimization, and scaling of high-ROI performance campaigns across Google Search, Bing Ads, YouTube and YouTube TV ads, and Google Display/Discovery.
  • AI & Platform Innovation: Master advanced ad features (Smart Bidding, auto-generated assets, AI bidding algorithms) to continually scale performance and improve audience targeting.
  • Theater Collaboration & Numbers Accountability: Partner hand-in-hand with Performance Marketing Theater Leads to understand regional goals, revenue targets, and market considerations. Deliver actionable paid search strategies that generate pipeline and directly meet theater targets.
  • Paid Search Experimentation & Optimization: Lead end-to-end campaign and post-click experimentation across paid search. Build structured testing frameworks to optimize ad performance, landing page experiences, and alternative lead capture mechanisms - driving continuous improvement in message alignment and conversion.

Technical SEO & GEO

  • Technical SEO & Metadata Management: Perform ongoing technical SEO optimizations, site audit reporting and prioritization, meta tag creation, and optimization to ensure high crawlability, indexability, and keyword alignment.

Integrated Search Strategy, Analytics & Reporting

  • Incremental Lift & Shared Reporting: Partner with Senior Manager, SEO/GEO on incremental lift analysis and reporting (Paid + Organic) to prove total search performance, identify cannibalization risks, and maximize incremental pipeline.
  • Keyword & Competitive Intelligence: Conduct regular keyword tracking, reporting, and competitive insights analysis to map competitor SERP dominance, keyword gaps, and prompt share across both paid and organic environments.
  • Tracking & Data Quality: Perform continuous UTM and URL cleanup/optimization across paid landing pages, organic pages, and tracking scripts to guarantee clean attribution, accurate reporting, and frictionless landing page experiences.

What You'll Need:

  • 5+ Years of Hands-On Experience: Proven track record managing complex, multi-region paid search and video budgets across Google Ads, Bing Ads, YouTube and YouTube TV ads.
  • Google Ads / AdWords Mastery: Expert-level fluency across the Google Ads platform- Search, Video, PMax, Audience targeting, and automated bid management.
  • Hands-On Technical SEO & GEO Capabilities: Demonstrated ability to perform technical site audits, meta tag optimizations, keyword tracking, and modern GEO/Prompt tracking across AI search platforms.
  • Theater/Regional Business Alignment: Experience working directly with regional theater or growth leads to turn market-specific targets into conversion-driven campaign tactics with direct revenue accountability.
  • Analytics & Attribution Expertise: Advanced skills in GA4, Google Tag Manager, dashboard tools (Looker Studio, Tableau), and multi-touch attribution modeling.
  • AI-Forward Search Mindset: Strong understanding of how search behavior is shifting toward generative AI and how to leverage modern AI tools to accelerate copy generation, landing page strategies, and performance insights.
  • Able to work in a hybrid/on-site capacity at our office in Columbia MD or Boston MA. This position is US-based only.
  • May perform other duties and responsibilities that management may deem necessary from time to time.

And Ideally:

  • Google Ads Certifications (Search, Video, Display) & GA4 Certification.
  • Experience with SEO/GEO monitoring software (e.g., SEMrush, Conductor, Amplitude).
  • Experience working in global B2B performance marketing environments with matrixed theater structures.
